- Bar seating often available even when tables are committed.

Insider:
- Nedah — confirmed coverage on her insider list.
- Escalation backup: Colleen via #colleen-notification-channel (VVIP only).

Name: Locanda Verde
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in Tribeca’s Greenwich Hotel, this spirited Italian taverna is the work of chef Andrew Carmellini and partners including Robert De Niro.
The space functions as a refined neighborhood canteen, offering a menu of rustic, soul-satisfying plates within a warm, high-ceilinged room.
Regulars invariably start with the sheep’s milk ricotta with truffle honey and burnt orange toast, a fixture of the Roman and Williams–designed dining room.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours before the reservation time to avoid a cancellation fee.

Name: Sushi Noz
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on the Upper East Side, this two-Michelin-starred restaurant from Chef Nozomu Abe presents a traditional Edomae-style omakase.
The Sukiya-style interior is modeled after an ancient Kyoto temple, featuring intricate joinery constructed without a single nail.
Service at the 200-year-old hinoki wood counter highlights a traditional ice chest used to preserve fish without modern refrigeration.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We can not allow a cancellation or rescheduling within 72 hours of the reservation time. A cancellation within that window will result in a full surrender of the deposit, with no exceptions. Requests to cancel or reschedule can be accommodated outside of 72 hours, including a full refund, minus a 3% card processing fee.
Manual Price: Prepaid: $550 per person, billed upon booking. Gratuity not included. 72-hour cancellation. 3% cancellation fee on refunds. Aurora CXL: $100/person, 48-hour.
Fulfillment Steps:
1. Sign member up to the Sushi Noz mailing list for release alerts.
2. Monitor SevenRooms for the release window once confirmed by the venue's release email.
3. Set SevenRooms waitlist for the preferred date.
4. Before any outreach, confirm with the member that their timeframe and date flexibility are finalised, that they agree to the prepaid omakase ($550 pp) and 72-hour cancellation policy, and that they understand the counter format and seating times.
5. Have member's payment details ready for the $550 pp charged at booking.
6. Escalate to Colleen via #colleen-notification-channel for VVIP.
7. Offer Sushi Sho or Atomix as omakase / counter-format alternatives.
Master_notes:
Key notes:
- Cuisine: Edomae Sushi Omakase. Michelin: 2 Stars.
- Platform: SevenRooms (via sushinoz.com).
- Format: Signature omakase served at the 6-seat Ash Room Counter (principal sushi chef) and the Hinoki Counter. For Chef Noz, refer to the 6 PM and 9 PM Hinoki Counter slots. Same omakase menu in both rooms.
- Mailing list signs members up for release alerts.

Venue contacts:
- reservations@sushinoz.com / 917-338-1792.

Escalation:
- Colleen (placeholder) — flag for CK to add insider contact.

Name: Polo Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Midtown, Ralph Lauren’s first New York restaurant is a clubby dining room designed by Alfredo Paredes with the brand's signature equestrian aesthetic.
The space evokes a classic private club through mahogany paneling, brass accents, and leather banquettes, serving American standards favored by the designer himself.
Meals begin with a ritual of warm popovers, followed by hearty classics like the corned beef sandwich or the signature Polo Bar burger.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations require a credit card to book. A cancellation fee of $50 per person is charged for cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance or for no-shows.
Manual Price: Aurora CXL: $100/person, 48-hour.
Fulfillment Steps:
1. Before any outreach, confirm with the member that their timeframe and date flexibility are finalised and that they agree to the cancellation policy.
2. Call 212-207-8562 — budget 45–60 minutes of hold time. Call early in the day.
3. Email reservations@polobarralphlauren.com.
4. If no response within 48 hours or for VVIP, escalate to April first (strongest relationship), then Nedah.
5. For VVIP, Colleen as tertiary escalation.
Master_notes:
Key notes:
- Cuisine: American. Operator: Ralph Lauren.
- Platform: Resy (phone number required for Resy profile).
- Release: 30 days in advance by date — NOT bookable online, must call.
- Dress code: Smart/elegant. No athleticwear, t-shirts, hoodies, ripped jeans, hats. Jackets appreciated but not required.
- Large parties (5–8): only sat at first/last seatings (5–6 PM and 8 PM+). Requests between 6–8 PM for 5+ guests not possible.
- First-time diners: much harder to secure 6-tops. Recommend reducing party size to 4 if possible.
- 15-minute grace period on arrival.
- TPB does not book far outside their booking window (a few days at most).

Contacts:
- Reservations phone: 212-207-8562 (10 AM–10 PM daily). Expect 45–60 min wait.
- Email: reservations@polobarralphlauren.com.

Insiders:
- April — strongest relationship.
- Nedah — has contacts. Previous GM left but team is responsive.
- Escalation backup: Colleen as tertiary (VVIP only).

Name: Marea
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Anchoring Central Park South, this polished Italian seafood destination from the Altamarea Group is a definitive fixture of New York’s power-dining circuit.
The sophisticated dining room sets the stage for a menu that treats coastal Italian cuisine with exacting precision and depth.
Its most enduring dish, the house-made fusilli with red wine-braised octopus and bone marrow, remains an essential order.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: To ensure a seamless experience for all guests, any cancellations made after 5:00 PM MST on the day prior to your reservation will incur a $75 per guest cancellation fee. By confirming your reservation, you acknowledge and agree to these terms and waive the right to dispute or submit chargebacks related to cancellation or no-show fees on the credit or debit card provided.

Name: Gramercy Tavern
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Established by Danny Meyer and helmed by Chef Michael Anthony, this Flatiron fixture holds a Michelin star and a reputation for defining contemporary American hospitality.
The space features a dual-concept layout that pairs a spirited, walk-in tavern with a formal dining room dedicated to seasonal, market-driven menus.
Beyond the wood-burning grill, the kitchen is renowned for its signature tavern burger and the enduring chocolate salted caramel tart.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Nick & Toni's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 1988 by Toni Ross and Jeff Salaway, this East Hampton institution serves seasonally driven Italian-Mediterranean cuisine in a warm, bustling atmosphere.
The kitchen centers on a wood-burning oven, producing rustic dishes like whole roasted fish that prioritize high-quality regional ingredients.
A menu staple remains the Penne alla Vecchia Bettola, featuring a spicy oven-roasted tomato sauce finished with vodka and cream.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We ask that any cancellation to your reservation be made no less than six hours prior. For no shows or late cancellations, you will be subject to a fee of $50 per person.

Name: Atomix
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by husband-and-wife team Junghyun and Ellia Park, this two-Michelin-starred destination in NoMad specializes in contemporary Korean cuisine.
The subterranean chef’s counter features a multi-course tasting menu that applies traditional fermentation techniques to seasonal ingredients.
In a signature ritual, every course arrives with a custom-designed card detailing the ingredients, inspiration, and cultural history behind the dish.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations are prepaid and non-refundable. However, purchased experiences are transferable to another guest via Tock.
Manual Price: Prepaid: full menu cost at booking (~$395–$420 per person). Aurora CXL: $100/person, 48-hour.
Fulfillment Steps:
1. Before any outreach, confirm with the member that their timeframe and date flexibility are finalised and that they agree to the cancellation policy.
2. Set calendar reminder for the 1st of the month at 2:55 PM EST. Be logged into Tock with member's payment details ready.
3. If missed or sold out, monitor Tock daily for cancellation releases. Cancellations release tickets back into the pool.
4. No strong escalation route. Online monitoring is more effective than any contact for this venue.
5. For extreme VVIP, escalate to Colleen — the only option.
6. Manage expectations early: 'Atomix releases monthly and sells out in minutes. We will attempt on the release date and actively monitor for cancellations.'
7. Flag to any active escalation contact if availability is found online.
Master_notes:
Key notes:
- Cuisine: Korean (Tasting Menu). Michelin: 2 Stars.
- Platform: Tock ONLY (exploretock.com/atomixnyc).
- Release: 1st of each month at 3:00 PM EST for the following month's dates. Sells out within minutes.
- Prepaid model: full tasting menu charged at booking (~$395–$420/person depending on season).
- Capacity: very small (counter seating), typically 2 pax.

Contacts:
- info@atomixnyc.com (inquiries only, not for booking).

Escalation:
- No strong escalation route. Online monitoring is more effective than any contact for this venue.
- For extreme VVIP: Colleen — the only option.

Name: Si Si
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set on Three Mile Harbor within Heath Freeman’s EHP Resort & Marina, this open-air venue channels the coastal vibrancy of the Mediterranean.
The atmosphere is defined by its deck-side setting, where "sun-kissed" flavors and shareable plates mimic the ease of a European summer.
A standout feature is the unobstructed sunset view over the water, best enjoyed with the kitchen’s signature spicy tuna tartare.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Fish Cheeks
Master_Aurora_Insights: Founded by chefs Ohm and Chat Suansilphong, this seafood-centric NoHo destination appears on Eater’s list of essential New York restaurants. The kitchen serves family-style plates inspired by Thailand’s coastal regions, prioritizing unapologetic heat and complex spice over compromise. A meal here culminates with the signature steamed fish with Thai herbs, a whole fish drenched in a broth of lime, garlic, and bird’s-eye chili.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Meduza Mediterrania
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Meatpacking District, this high-energy Mediterranean destination is the work of Noble 33 Hospitality Group and Executive Chef James Atkinson.
The sprawling space, designed by Monochrome Concept, channels an elevated bohemian vibe with a glass-enclosed atrium and earthy, organic textures.
Recently named Yelp’s Best New Restaurant of 2024, the venue features a private VIP dining room and signature plates like the seafood towers.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We ask that you arrive no earlier than 15 mins prior to your reservation time. In addition, we have a 15 minute grace period. Please call us if you are running late so that we do not cancel your reservation. A credit card is required to secure the reservation.

Name: Chef's Table at Brooklyn Fare
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Hidden within a Hell's Kitchen grocery store, this three-Michelin-starred counter is led by co-executive chefs Max Natmessnig and Marco Prins.
The industrial, stainless-steel dining room sets the stage for a precise tasting menu blending French technique with Japanese ingredients.
Guests at the U-shaped communal counter are served signatures like Hokkaido sea urchin on toasted brioche directly by the chefs.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations require a non-refundable deposit of $200 per person. Parties 15 minutes late or more may miss courses or risk cancellation.

Name: Manhatta
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched on the 60th floor of 28 Liberty Street, this restaurant from Danny Meyer’s Union Square Hospitality Group is helmed by Executive Chef Michele Brogioni.
The Woods Bagot interiors temper the drama of 360-degree city views with warm, midcentury-inspired domestic cues.
Beyond the floor-to-ceiling vistas of the harbor, the kitchen serves refined plates such as beef tartare with pearl onions and smoked mustard aioli.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations or modifications made less than 24 hours in advance are subject to a fee of $50 per person. A credit card is required to secure the reservation.

Name: Oxomoco
Master_Aurora_Insights:
This Michelin-starred Mexican destination in Greenpoint is the work of chef Justin Bazdarich, formerly of Jean-Georges.
The airy, plant-filled space channels a breezy West Coast energy, centering its menu around a massive wood-burning oven.
A standout offering is the beet "chorizo" taco, a vegetarian signature featuring crispy potatoes and avocado that sits alongside wood-fired lamb barbacoa.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Lunch: $10 per person fee for cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Dinner: $25 per person fee for cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Large parties/events may be subject to a 48-hour cancellation window and a charge of 50% of the estimated food and beverage amount.

Name: Avra
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated across from Radio City Music Hall, this sprawling three-story estiatorio was designed by the Rockwell Group to evoke an open-air courtyard.
The airy, limestone-clad interior sets a relaxed tone for a menu centered on fresh seafood flown in from the Mediterranean.
Guests are invited to select whole fish from a signature ice display, which is then charcoal-grilled and finished with lemon and olive oil.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations must be cancelled at least 24 hours in advance to avoid a fee of $50 per person. No-shows are subject to the same fee. A credit card is required to secure the reservation.

Name: Semma
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the West Village, this Michelin-starred restaurant from Unapologetic Foods showcases the rural Tamil Nadu heritage of Chef Vijay Kumar.
The kitchen prioritizes regional specificity over adaptation, delivering bold flavors from the chef’s childhood that are rarely found in Manhattan.
A standout detail is the Gunpowder Dosa, a crisp, cone-shaped crepe filled with potato masala that arrives spanning the width of the table.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Please note that the deposit remains non-refundable in cases of either unspent per person deposit or reservation cancellation within 48 hours of the scheduled visit.
Fulfillment Steps:
1. Before any outreach, confirm with the member that their timeframe and date flexibility are finalised and that they agree to the cancellation policy.
2. Book via Resy (~30 days out).
3. If unavailable, set Resy Notify alert + calendar reminders.
4. Ensure member understands $50/person non-refundable deposit and 48-hour cancellation window before booking.
5. Escalate via Colleen for VVIP/last-minute.

Name: Via Carota
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Anchoring the West Village, this bustling gastroteca is the shared vision of James Beard Award-winning chefs Jody Williams and Rita Sodi.
The wood-lined dining room evokes a 17th-century Florentine home, setting the stage for a vegetable-forward menu rooted in rustic Tuscan simplicity.
Most meals feature the Insalata Verde, a towering, architectural stack of sherry-dressed lettuces that serves as the kitchen's most recognizable dish.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Via Carota charges a late cancellation or no-show fee of $50 per person. Reservations can be cancelled without penalty if done before the specified deadline (typically 24 hours in advance or by a specific time on the day of the reservation, e.g., 6:00 PM). A non-refundable deposit may be required for certain bookings.
Manual Price: Aurora CXL: $100/person, 48-hour (where a Resy reservation is held). Venue deposit / cancellation not publicly listed. Bespoke chef experience: quote on request via Colleen — high price point, VVIP only.
Fulfillment Steps:
1. Check Resy for any available advance slots.
2. If unavailable, set Resy Notify alert for the preferred time.
3. Before any outreach, confirm with the member that their timeframe and date flexibility are finalised and that they agree to the cancellation policy (where a Resy reservation is held).
4. Escalate to Colleen via #colleen-notification-channel for VVIP. For ultra-VVIP, surface the chef-coming-to-you bespoke option if the member's spend tolerance and occasion fit.
5. Walk-in is the dominant route — advise member to arrive before 5:00 PM to put their name in.
6. Offer I Sodi (same operators, April covers) or Lilia as backups.
Master_notes:
Key notes:
- Cuisine: Italian. Operators: Jody Williams and Rita Sodi (also operate I Sodi).
- Platform: Resy (limited release inventory) + phone + walk-ins (significant).
- Walk-ins: tables held for walk-ins. Arrive before 5:00 PM; name is taken at 5:00 PM and waits run through restaurant turnover.

Escalation:
- Colleen (placeholder) — confirmed no warm contact at April for standard reservations. Flag for CK to add insider contact.
- VVIP bespoke route: Colleen can broker a chef-coming-to-you private experience — Via Carota chef prepares the food at the member's location with a server. Verbatim from Colleen: 'Would be expensive AF tho.' Use only for VVIP, must align with member spend tolerance.

Name: Barbuto
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by James Beard Award-winning chef Jonathan Waxman, this West Village institution translates the breezy spirit of California into a rustic Italian vernacular.
The industrial space features an open kitchen and floor-to-ceiling windows, maintaining the signature connection between the dining room and the street.
Regulars return for the roast chicken, served with a bright salsa verde that remains one of the city’s most enduring culinary signatures.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance are subject to a fee of $50 per person.

Name: Four Horsemen
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Co-founded by LCD Soundsystem’s James Murphy, this Williamsburg destination holds a Michelin star for its focused approach to dining and drinking.
Chef Nick Curtola pairs a rigorous selection of natural wines with a seasonally evolving menu of precise New American small plates.
The intimate room features sound-dampening cedar slats and burlap walls, a deliberate acoustic design that encourages conversation.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Credit card hold required. A cancellation fee of $25 per person is charged for cancellations made after 12 PM on the day of the reservation. Reservations are held for 15 minutes.
Manual Price: Aurora CXL: $100/person, 48-hour. Venue deposit / cancellation not publicly listed.
Fulfillment Steps:
1. Check Resy at 7:00 AM ET on the 29–30 day release for the target date.
2. If unavailable, set Resy Notify alert for the preferred time.
3. Before any outreach, confirm with the member that their timeframe and date flexibility are finalised and that they agree to the cancellation policy.
4. Escalate to Colleen via #colleen-notification-channel for VVIP. Same team also runs I Cavallini.
5. Bar walk-in (10 seats) is a viable fallback — advise member to arrive at door open.
6. For groups, brief member on the 45-day lead time required.
Master_notes:
Key notes:
- Cuisine: Wine Bar / European. Michelin: 1 Star.
- Co-owner: James Murphy (LCD Soundsystem).
- Platform: Resy (table reservations). Release: ~29–30 days out at 7:00 AM ET.
- Capacity: 40 seats total; max party of 6. 10 bar seats reserved for walk-ins.
- Group bookings: 45 days notice for groups.

Escalation:
- Colleen (placeholder) — confirmed no warm contact at Nedah or April. Flag for CK to add insider contact. Same team also runs I Cavallini.

Name: Bungalow
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Michelin-starred chef Vikas Khanna leads this East Village destination, a personal homage to the vintage social clubs of India.
The atmosphere evokes a bygone era of conviviality, pairing a nostalgic, members-only aesthetic with a warm, community-centric ethos.
Amidst pale pink walls and hand-painted murals, the kitchen delivers standout heritage dishes, including the signature spice-roasted pineapple and crispy yogurt kebabs.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: To confirm your reservation, a non-refundable deposit of $25 per person is required on Resy. This deposit will be applied as a credit towards your final check at Bungalow.

Name: Raoul's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 1975 by Alsatian brothers Guy and Serge Raoul, this SoHo destination was recently the subject of a Tribeca Film Festival documentary.
The intimate, tin-ceilinged dining room maintains the bustling atmosphere of a classic French bistro, drawing a mix of locals and visiting creatives.
Beyond the signature steak au poivre, the restaurant features a resident tarot reader stationed at the top of its iron spiral staircase.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: No-showing or cancelling your reservation within 12 hours of the reservation time will incur a non-refundable and non-transferable $50 per guest cancellation fee. Reservations are unable to be modified within 12 hours of the reservation time.

Name: Le Bernardin
Raw Text: Le Bernadin New York
Master_Source_text: Le Bernadin New York
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by chef Eric Ripert and co-owner Maguy Le Coze, this Midtown dining room holds three Michelin stars for its disciplined focus on seafood.
The kitchen organizes plates not by course but by preparation—Almost Raw to Lightly Cooked—allowing the primary ingredient to dictate the experience.
A consistent highlight is the pounded yellowfin tuna, served simply atop a crisp baguette with a layer of foie gras.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations must be made at least 48 hours in advance to avoid a fee of $150 per person. This fee also applies to no-shows. A credit card is required to secure the reservation.
Intake Table: New York Le Bernardin Restaurant
Manual Price: Venue CXL fee: $150/person + tax if canceled after deadline (~48 hours before). No fee if canceled before cutoff. Waiver at sole discretion of restaurant. Aurora CXL: $100/person, 48-hour.

1. Before any outreach, confirm with the member that their timeframe and date flexibility are finalised and that they agree to the cancellation policy.
2. Call (212) 554-1515 on the 1st of the month for the following month's dates.
3. Check Resy for any online availability.
4. Email reservations@le-bernardin.com with member details and preferred dates.
5. For VVIP, escalate to Colleen.
6. Nedah does not have a warm contact here.

- Cuisine: French Seafood. Michelin: 3 Stars.
- Primary booking method: phone — (212) 554-1515.
- Release: 1st of each month for the entire following month, via phone only.
- Also on Resy (some availability may appear online).

Contacts:
- Reservations phone: (212) 554-1515.
- Email: reservations@le-bernardin.com.

Escalation:
- Colleen for VVIP. Nedah does NOT have a warm contact here.
Master address: 155 W 51st St, The Equitable Bldg, New York, NY 10019

Name: Ogawa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in a standalone building in Kyoto’s Nakagyo-ku ward, this intimate kappo counter is the domain of chef-owner Yosuke Ogawa.
The kitchen specializes in dashi-rich Kyoto cuisine that balances technical precision with a playful, unpretentious atmosphere.
Meals conclude with a memorable signature ritual: seasonal rice cooked in a clay pot, served alongside accompaniments like dried mullet roe and young sardines with sansho pepper.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We require at least 72 hours notice prior to the reservation time for any modifications or cancellations for a full refund. A deposit of $395 per person is required.

Name: Klaw
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the historic Miami Women’s Club in Edgewater, this surf-and-turf destination is the work of entrepreneurs Sasha Krilov and Misha Zelman, with interiors by Martin Brudnizki.
The venue channels a refined Spanish Renaissance aesthetic, balancing a grand, heritage-rich dining room with a breezy rooftop bar overlooking Biscayne Bay.
A dedicated tank room houses the signature live Norwegian King Crab, served whole alongside a curated selection of heritage beef cuts.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72 hour cancellation window.

Name: Sunny's Steakhouse
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in Miami’s Little River district, this permanent outpost from the Jaguar Sun team evolves a beloved pop-up into a sophisticated dining destination.
The indoor-outdoor setting blends a chic, old-meets-new Florida aesthetic with a refreshed, less rigid approach to the traditional American steakhouse genre.
Beyond the steaks paired with bone marrow vinaigrette, the menu features standout sides like schmaltz-fried russet potatoes and a decadent kouign-amann ice cream sandwich.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations can be canceled without penalty until noon on the day of the reservation. Late cancellations or no-shows are subject to a fee of $25 per person. Larger parties are subject to a 72-hour cancellation policy.

Name: Pastis
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Restaurateurs Keith McNally and Stephen Starr operate this revived Meatpacking District bistro, which faithfully recreates the original’s Parisian interior.
The design features subway tiles, mosaic floors, and antique mirrors, centering on a bustling dining room lined with red banquettes.
While the menu offers standard French classics, the steak frites—accompanied by a generous heap of crisp potatoes—remains a perennial favorite.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72-hour cancellation policy.

Name: Conca del Sogno
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by the Tizzani family in the secluded Bay of Recommone, this institution is a favored stop for the Amalfi Coast’s maritime crowd.
The venue operates as both a beach club and restaurant, where refined service complements a menu driven entirely by the daily catch.
Diners select their meal directly from live seawater basins before enjoying the house specialty, Spaghetti alla Nerano, on a terrace overlooking the sea.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If you cancel within 24h before the reservation day there won’t be any charges on your credit card. We will charge 100,00 € per person only in case of no show or cancellation later than 24h before the reservation day. We guarantee the table up to 15 minutes after the reservation’s time slot. By completing the booking, your credit card will be saved, but NO amount will be charged; the credit card will be used as a guarantee and used in case of cancellation.

Name: Delilah
Master_Aurora_Insights:
The h.wood Group’s modern-day supper club evokes the roaring twenties with a seductive atmosphere that nods to the golden age of Hollywood.
Plush banquettes, Art Deco detailing, and a strict no-photos policy define the interiors, where dinner transitions seamlessly into a night of live jazz.
While the menu offers decadent American fare, the true insider order is the famous chicken tenders, served alongside custom illustrations by artist Blue Logan.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Delilah has a 15 minute grace period for each reservation. Each reservation is allotted 2 hours. Please note, should we not get confirmation by 4pm on the day of your reservation, your table may be released.

Name: Stubborn Seed
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Miami Beach’s South of Fifth neighborhood, this Michelin-starred destination is the flagship of Top Chef winner Jeremy Ford.
The kitchen presents an ambitious seasonal tasting menu that marries technical precision with bold flavors in a handsome, industrial-chic space.
It holds a rare Michelin Green Star, recognizing a rigorous commitment to sustainability that extends from local sourcing to zero-waste composting.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A cancellation fee of $50 per person will incur if cancelled within 24 hours of the reservation. On holidays and special occasions, cancellations fees will be $100 per person.

Name: Shingo
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in the historic La Palma building in Coral Gables, this 14-seat omakase counter is led by Michelin-starred Chef Shingo Akikuni.
The multi-course menu emphasizes traditional Japanese hospitality, presenting seasonal fish imported weekly from Japan alongside ingredients sourced locally in Florida.
Service centers on a 19-foot counter handcrafted from rare Hinoki wood, built entirely without nails using the ancient Miya-daiku carpentry method.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations within 72 hours of the reservation and no-shows will be charged the full tasting menu price per person.

Name: Omakai (Coconut Grove)
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by brothers Diego and Pedro Quijada with Nicolas Sayavedra, this Coconut Grove outpost brings accessible omakase to a neighborhood defined by its lush canopy.
The "fine casual" philosophy strips away pretension, presenting high-quality fish in set menus that encourage diners to simply trust the chef.
Interiors by Oldenburg Studio mimic the area’s oak trees with layered, curved wood panels, a warm backdrop for the signature Oma Deluxe tasting.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For parties of 5 or more, a credit card is required. If reservations are canceled with less than a 24-hour notice, there will be a $10 charge per person. All reservations have a 10-minute grace period; failing to contact the restaurant if running late may result in a cancellation.

Name: Amazonico
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in Brickell, Amazónico Miami is the U.S. debut from Madrid-based restaurateurs Sandro Silva and Marta Seco.
The three-story venue functions as a rainforest-themed playground, combining Latin American dining with a club-like atmosphere and rooftop lounge.
Interiors by Lázaro Rosa Violán feature volcanic stone and a mirrored staircase leading to a dedicated sushi counter and open-air terrace.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations require a credit card guarantee. A cancellation fee of £50 per person applies if the booking is cancelled with less than 24 hours' notice or in the event of a no-show.

Name: MILA Omakase
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Hidden within the Mila rooftop complex in Miami Beach, this intimate 10-seat enclave is helmed by Michelin-starred chef Michaël Michaelidis and executive chef Reiji Yoshizawa.
The space is defined by a 500-year-old hinoki wood counter and a cherry blossom tree, offering a serene contrast to the main venue.
The menu blends Japanese and Mediterranean flavors, featuring a signature akami rose layered with beetroot and makrut lime.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: 100% deposit required. All sales are final and non-refundable. Late arrivals will not be accepted.

Name: Hiden
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Concealed behind a taco stand in Miami’s Wynwood district, this intimate eight-seat omakase counter is a Michelin-starred destination for purists.
The kitchen delivers a strictly traditional tasting menu, utilizing seasonal ingredients flown in directly from Japan for a focused, multi-course experience.
Entry requires a passcode to slip past the taco shop front, revealing a serene, wood-paneled interior dedicated to the ritual of edomae sushi.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations and changes will only be accepted if requested up to 48 hours prior to your reservation. After this period all sales are considered final and non-refundable. Please note that any special menu request and private dining will follow different cancellation policies.

Name: Jon & Vinny's
Master_Aurora_Insights: Created by James Beard Award-winning chefs Jon Shook and Vinny Dotolo, this all-day Italian-American diner operates multiple locations across Los Angeles. The interiors, designed by architect Jeff Guga, feature pale wood banquettes and skylights that establish a clean, modern aesthetic distinct from traditional trattorias. A standout order is the spicy fusilli with vodka sauce, often paired with a bottle from the integrated shop, Helen’s Wines.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A credit card is required to secure reservations. Tables are held for 15 minutes; arrivals after this time result in forfeiture. A cancellation fee of $25 per person is charged for no-shows or cancellations made within 12 hours of the reservation time (policies may vary by location).

Name: L'Atelier de Joël Robuchon Saint-Germain
Master_Aurora_Insights: L'Atelier de Joël Robuchon is a Michelin-starred Paris dining institution that transformed traditional French fine dining through its iconic counter-seating concept, where guests watch chefs prepare each dish in an intimate open kitchen. Blending haute cuisine with the energy of a contemporary sushi bar, the Saint-Germain location is celebrated for its precision-driven small plates, signature Robuchon mashed potatoes, and sleek red-and-black interiors that make the experience feel both theatrical and deeply personal.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations within 24 hours of the reservation time are subject to a fee of $75 per person. A credit card is required to secure the reservation.

Name: Il Gabbiano
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Overlooking Biscayne Bay in downtown Miami, this refined Northern Italian institution is orchestrated by the Masci brothers, originally behind New York’s Il Mulino.
The experience is unapologetically old-school, characterized by white-jacketed waiters, a bustling power-lunch crowd, and a commitment to service over trends.
Meals begin with a signature ritual of complimentary antipasti, including fried zucchini, bruschetta, and jagged chunks of Parmigiano-Reggiano carved from a massive wheel.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Omakai (Wynwood)
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by brothers Diego and Pedro Quijada with Chef Aaron Pate, this Wynwood destination offers an accessible take on the traditional omakase experience.
The concept strips away pretension, presenting tiered tasting menus that educate diners on fish quality without the expected high price point.
Diners navigate the menu through set progressions like the "Oma Deluxe," or opt for specialty nigiri such as the O-Toro topped with uni and caviar.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For Omakai Sushi, reservations have a 10-minute grace period; failing to contact the restaurant may result in cancellation. For parties of 5 or more, a credit card is required to book. If reservations are canceled with less than 24 hours' notice, there is a fee of $10 per person. Omakai Hand Roll Bar does not accept reservations.

Name: COTE
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Proprietor Simon Kim and chef David Shim lead this Michelin-starred steakhouse, a concept that bridges Korean barbecue traditions with American chophouse culture.
Servers cook prime cuts on smokeless in-table grills, combining the interactive nature of barbecue with the structure of fine dining.
The signature Butcher’s Feast features four cuts of USDA Prime and American Wagyu beef, accompanied by savory egg soufflés and spicy stews.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We ask that all cancellations be made with at least 24 hours notice. We charge a $50 per person late cancellation and no-show fee in the event that a reservation is cancelled within 24 hours to the reservation date, or no-showed.

Name: Le Jardinier
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Michelin-starred chef Alain Verzeroli, a longtime protégé of Joël Robuchon, helms this vegetable-forward French dining concept.
The light-filled, greenhouse-inspired setting prioritizes seasonality, offering a refined menu where sustainable proteins play a supporting role to vibrant produce.
Meals begin with a restorative juice shot instead of a traditional amuse-bouche, followed by intricate vegetable compositions and the kitchen’s signature gluten-free breads.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Should you cancel within 24 hours of the booking, a $50/pp cancellation fee will incur.

Name: Tâm Tâm
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by Tam Pham and Harrison Ramhofer, this Michelin Bib Gourmand recipient in Downtown Miami channels the energy of a Saigon *quán nhậu*.
The kitchen eschews standard pho for bold plates like fish-sauce caramel wings and betel leaf-wrapped lamb, served in a compact, repurposed Cuban café.
Beyond the frozen cocktails, the venue’s most spirited feature is tucked away in the restroom, which houses a hidden karaoke machine.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Guests must cancel at least 6 hours before the reservation to avoid a cancellation fee. Parties larger than 8 guests require a full restaurant buyout.

Name: Boia De
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Hidden inside a nondescript Little Haiti strip mall, this Michelin-starred bistro is helmed by chefs Luciana Giangrandi and Alex Meyer.
The narrow, forest-green dining room sets the stage for inventive, Italian-leaning plates that defy strict categorization.
Look for the neon exclamation point above the door before settling in for the signature crispy potato skins with stracciatella and caviar.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Guests have up to 3 hours before their reservation time to cancel without penalty. Cancellations made within 3 hours of the reservation time will incur a cancellation charge of $20 per person. A credit card is required to secure the reservation.

Name: Torno Subito
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Conceived by three-Michelin-starred chef Massimo Bottura, this whimsical Italian dining concept channels the nostalgic spirit of the 1960s Riviera.
The vibrant, retro-inspired interiors serve as a colorful backdrop for a menu that reimagines traditional recipes with playful creativity.
A signature highlight is the handmade tortellini served in a creamy Parmigiano Reggiano sauce, a comforting dish directly inspired by the chef’s childhood memories.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For the Singapore location: A credit card hold is required to secure the reservation. A fee of S$50 per person is charged for no-shows or late cancellations (typically within 24 hours).

Name: Rosemary's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Anchoring a prime West Village corner, this airy Italian trattoria is the work of restaurateur Carlos Suarez, who named the venue after his mother.
The interior evokes a Tuscan farmhouse with high timber ceilings and rustic finishes, serving a straightforward menu of handmade pastas and seasonal plates.
A productive rooftop garden supplies the kitchen with fresh herbs and vegetables, a rare functional green space visible from the street below.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Shiso
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Miami’s Wynwood neighborhood, this Asian smokehouse is the work of Chef Raheem Sealey.
The rooftop destination merges Japanese precision with Caribbean soul, focusing its menu on wood-fired barbecue and sushi.
A 35-seat racetrack-style bar anchors the lush open-air terrace, serving dishes like Chilean sea bass with coconut curry and miso butter.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For reservations of 4 people and up, a credit card is required. Cancellations must be made at least 4 hours in advance to avoid a cancellation penalty (typically $25 per person).

Name: Mika
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in The Plaza Coral Gables, Mika marks the first standalone Florida project from chef Michael White.
The Riviera-style dining room and terrace offer a menu grounded in Mediterranean traditions and fresh seafood.
Interiors by Bishop Design provide the setting for signature dishes like the crab and caviar spaghetti.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Dinner reservations are subject to a $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72-hour cancellation policy.

Name: Elastika
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Anchoring the atrium of the Miami Design District’s Moore Building, this site-specific installation is the work of Pritzker Prize laureate Zaha Hadid.
The design transforms the four-story arcade, juxtaposing the venue's 1921 geometry with fluid, biomorphic connectivity.
Signature white, oblique forms stretch across the void like taut elastic, bridging the levels of the vertical space.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Lunch: $10 per person fee for cancellations within 12 hours. Dinner: $25 per person fee for cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72-hour cancellation policy.

Name: Claudie
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Miami’s Brickell district, this French-Mediterranean restaurant from Riviera Dining Group founder Gregory Galy and Chef Michaël Michaelidis channels the spirit of the Côte d’Azur.
The interiors soften the surrounding concrete with a transportive design that blends European brasserie elegance with the warmth of a Provençal village.
A grand terrace fountain inspired by French diamond jewelry anchors the space, while the kitchen serves sun-drenched plates like langoustines and truffles.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: $25 per person fee for cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Special events are non-refundable.

Name: Uchi
Master_Aurora_Insights:
James Beard Award-winning chef Tyson Cole leads this contemporary Japanese destination, which first opened in a converted home in Austin.
The kitchen serves a rotating selection of hot and cold tastings, blending global ingredients with Japanese precision to create a distinct, non-traditional experience.
A standout example is the Machi Cure, a signature dish featuring smoked yellowtail, yucca chips, and marcona almonds.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Uchi requires a credit card to secure reservations. A fee of $25 per person is charged for cancellations made within 24 hours of the reservation time or for no-shows. Reservations may be rescheduled in the event of inclement weather.

Name: Gaia
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Gaia is an upscale Mediterranean restaurant located at 42 West 35th Street in Herald Square, Manhattan, opened in November 2024.
Specializes in Mediterranean cuisine with dishes including sesame crusted feta, wild mushroom truffle pasta, grilled branzino filet, ribeye, and duck breast preparations.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND
Manual Price: Aurora CXL: $100/person, 48-hour. Venue deposit / cancellation not publicly listed.

Name: NAOE
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Miami’s Brickell Key, this Forbes Five-Star sanctuary is the five-seat omakase counter of chef-owner Kevin Cory.
The operation serves a nightly changing menu to just five guests per seating, ensuring an atmosphere of intense focus.
Distinctive details include the use of the chef’s ancestral Naogen soy sauce and family sake, brewed in Japan since 1825.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: All sales are final and non-refundable. Full prepayment is required at the time of booking.

Name: Mother Wolf
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Chef Evan Funke’s dedication to Roman culinary heritage drives this high-energy dining concept with locations in Los Angeles, Las Vegas, and Miami.
The kitchen strictly adheres to the traditions of the Eternal City, serving wafer-thin wood-fired pizzas and regional classics rather than general Italian fare.
A glass-enclosed pasta laboratory serves as the visual centerpiece, allowing diners to watch the production of signature shapes like *mezze maniche*.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Mother Wolf accepts reservations 14 days in advance. We offer a 15 minute grace period for late arrivals and only seat complete parties. A credit card is required to secure a reservation. A cancellation fee applies for no-shows or cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance.

Name: Catch
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Overseen by Catch Hospitality Group’s Mark Birnbaum and Eugene Remm, this dining concept operates in key hubs like New York, Los Angeles, and Las Vegas.
The offering merges Asian-influenced seafood with a spirited social scene, often set within lush, open-air rooftop environments.
A signature finale is the "Hit Me" chocolate cake, a structural dessert that releases a liquid center when struck.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: You may Cancel/Adjust Guest Count without penalty as late as 10am the day of your reservation. Catch Hospitality Group offers a 15 minute grace period for reservations.

Name: Carbone Vino
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in the Dallas Design District, this Italian-American outpost from Major Food Group and Chef Mario Carbone operates adjacent to its celebrated sibling.
The kitchen focuses on Roman-style pizzas and handmade pastas, supported by a thousand-bottle wine list in a room designed for conviviality.
Diners often conclude with the Cannoli Sundae, an elaborate construction of gelato, crushed shells, Sicilian pistachios, and cherries.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellation fee kicks in after noon day-of. Reservations can be made through Resy or via email up to 30 days in advance.

Name: Lafayette Grand Café & Bakery
Master_Aurora_Insights:
In San Diego’s North Park, this 1946 landmark was recently overhauled by hospitality group CH Projects and design firm Post Company.
The interiors reject coastal minimalism in favor of a saturated, maximalist aesthetic blending Victorian, Tudor, and Gothic influences.
A two-lane bowling alley anchors the cocktail bar, while the central pool remains a focal point originally designed by Johnny Weissmuller.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Lunch reservations incur a fee of $10 per person if cancelled within 12 hours. Dinner reservations incur a fee of $25 per person if cancelled within 12 hours or for no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72-hour cancellation policy.

Name: Mandolin Aegean Bistro
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Ahmet Erkaya and Anastasia Koutsioukis, this Aegean bistro occupies a restored 1940s bungalow in Miami’s Design District.
The kitchen bridges Greece and Turkey with rustic, seasonal plates served in a whitewashed garden courtyard shaded by mature trees.
Diners gather at blue-tiled tables for signature grilled octopus and manti dumplings, surrounded by blooming bougainvillea and lantern light.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations for our dining rooms are available 60 days in advance and can be cancelled without penalty.

Name: The Den at Azabu
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Concealed behind the main dining room of Azabu in the Stanton South Beach, this Michelin-starred counter is helmed by chef Atsushi Okawara.
The kitchen serves strictly Edomae-style sushi, utilizing seasonal seafood flown in from Japan that is cured, aged, or marinated.
A signature detail is the house-made uni soy sauce, which the chef uses to brush specific pieces of nigiri.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Due to limited seating and product availability, The Den has a strict 24-hour cancellation policy. Any cancellation or reservation change must be made at least 24 hours before the reservation. Changes or cancellations made within 24 hours will result in a full charge of the omakase price to the credit card on file. There is a 15-minute grace period for late arrivals. After 15 minutes, the party is considered a no-show, and the full omakase price will be charged with no exceptions.

Name: Mila
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched on a rooftop above Lincoln Road, this Miami Beach venue is the flagship project of Riviera Dining Group founder Gregory Galy.
The "MediterrAsian" concept merges Cycladic earthiness with Japanese wabi-sabi, creating a holistic space that shifts from refined dining to spirited nightlife.
A 3,000-square-foot water feature anchors the Olya Volkova-designed terrace, providing a dramatic backdrop for nightly fire performances and theatrical tableside service.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: MILA requires a credit card to hold reservations. If canceled less than 6 hours from the reservation time or for no show reservations, there is a fee of $25 per guest. Cancellations will only be accepted via telephone at 786-706-0744.

Name: Mimi Chinese
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Executive chef David Schwartz leads this Toronto and Miami Beach destination, presenting a modern exploration of regional Chinese cuisine from Guangdong to Sichuan.
The dining room features lipstick-red banquettes and moody lighting, while servers in sharp suits deliver spicy, sharing-style plates.
A standout dish is the Hidden Chicken, where crispy bites arrive submerged under a mountain of dried red chilies.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: C$50 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations or no-shows. Credit card required for reservation.

Name: Queen Miami Beach
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the restored 1945 Paris Theater, this ambitious Japanese supper club is the latest project from restaurateur Mathieu Massa and designer Carlos Rodriguez.
The multi-level space channels mid-century glamour with a dining-as-theater concept, pairing French-inflected Japanese dishes with live aerialist performances.
A twenty-foot teak and gold-leaf "Iris" structure dominates the ceiling, hovering above a central stage that hosts nightly entertainment.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A cancellation fee of $50 per person will be incurred if cancelled within 24 hours of the reservation.

Name: Aviv
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within Miami’s 1 Hotel South Beach, this Israeli dining room is the work of James Beard Award-winning chef Michael Solomonov and restaurateur Steve Cook.
The interior blends warm timber and verdant alcoves to evoke Tel Aviv, while the kitchen focuses on charcoal-grilled meats and handmade breads.
A distinct highlight is the savory haloumi baklava, layering salty cheese with quince and pistachio in crisp phyllo dough.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72 hour cancellation window.

Name: Chateau ZZ's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a 1931 chateau on Brickell Avenue, this Mexican venue is the first such concept from Major Food Group.
The heritage site contrasts French architecture with a comprehensive agave library and a menu of raw bar standards.
Signature Wagyu and truffle tostadas are served alongside a cellar collection of over 1,000 tequilas and mezcals.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellation within 24 hours of the reservation will incur a charge of $15 per guest as a no show/cancellation fee.

Name: Casa Neos
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on the Miami River, this multi-concept destination from Riviera Dining Group combines a restaurant, beach club, and boutique hotel into a modern Mediterranean agora.
The venue channels the spirit of the Aegean Islands with a laid-back atmosphere, featuring modern cuisine under the direction of Michelin-starred Chef Michaël Michaelidis.
A signature "jardin suspendu" and private dockage for yachts anchor the design, while daily sunset rituals set the rhythm for evenings by the water.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A cancellation fee of $50 per person will be charged for cancellations made within 24 hours of the reservation time. This fee also applies to no-shows.

Name: Sparrow
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by the Grand Group, this boutique hotel in Stockholm’s Östermalm district offers a colorful, intimate alternative to its historic sister property, the Grand Hôtel.
The interiors depart from Scandinavian minimalism, featuring a Parisian-inspired aesthetic with bold wallpapers and velvet furnishings in deep, rich tones.
Its popular French bistro, overseen by chef Mathias Dahlgren, anchors the ground floor and opens onto a lively courtyard during the warmer months.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: There is a fee of $15 per person for no-shows and cancellations within 24 hours of your reservation. For special events/holidays the fee is $50 per person for no-shows and cancellations within 48 hours of your reservation.

Name: Makoto
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in the Bal Harbour Shops, this modern Japanese venue is led by chef Makoto Okuwa in partnership with restaurateur Stephen Starr.
The India Mahdavi–designed space frames a menu that merges traditional Edomae-style sushi with contemporary techniques and robata specialties.
Order the signature frosty wagyu fried rice, which arrives in a hot stone bowl and is mixed tableside with jidori egg and XO sauce.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Sadelle's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
A partnership between Major Food Group and lifestyle brand Kith, this dining concept is seamlessly integrated into the retailer’s Design District flagship.
The light-filled, white-washed interior mirrors the store's minimalism, serving as a polished backdrop for a curated selection of New York brunch staples.
Menu highlights include the signature sliced-to-order house salmon and location-exclusive breakfast sandwiches served on fresh bagels.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: To confirm or cancel your reservation, please email us at reservations@sadelles.com. Reservations for parties of up to five guests can be made via Resy or email up to 30 days in advance. Some locations, such as Coconut Grove, may charge a fee (e.g. $50 per person) for cancellations made after a certain time (e.g. 6 am) on the day of the reservation.

Name: Ariete
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Coconut Grove, this Michelin-starred outpost is the work of Chef Michael Beltran, who translates his Miami upbringing into a refined culinary vision.
The kitchen merges Cuban ingredients with French technique, creating a "New Miami" style that feels both personal and precise.
For a memorable finish, the signature *Canard à la Presse* is a dry-aged duck prepared tableside, exemplifying the restaurant's dedication to old-world craft.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Dinner reservations require a credit card to book. A cancellation fee of $25 per person applies to no-shows or cancellations made within 12 hours of the reservation time. Larger parties are subject to a 72-hour cancellation policy.

Name: Uchiko
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by James Beard Award-winner Tyson Cole as the rustic sibling to Uchi, this non-traditional Japanese concept centers on fire-driven flavors and warm hospitality.
Distinguished by a central hearth that imparts smoke and char, the kitchen balances fresh sashimi with robust, roasted textures in a space defined by reclaimed wood.
Signature dishes like the crispy Brussels sprouts with fish caramel are best enjoyed beneath the dining room’s striking, tree-limb-inspired paper art installation.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We require a credit card number to hold this reservation. A fee of $25 per person will be charged for cancellations made with less than 24 hours' notice or no-shows. Patio seating is weather permitting and reservations may be rescheduled in the event of inclement weather.

Name: Pavyllon
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Four Seasons Hotel London at Park Lane, this Michelin-starred restaurant is the British debut of French chef Yannick Alléno.
The dining room centers on a sweeping custom counter facing the open kitchen, creating an interactive experience that merges gastronomy with a social atmosphere.
Menus highlight Alléno’s modern extraction technique for sauces, anchoring dishes like the "Badaboum" egg with caviar and the steamed Comté cheese soufflé.lon
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We kindly request that if you need to cancel your reservation, please do so at least 24 hours in advance. Please note that a fee of £85 per person will be charged for no-shows or cancellations made later than this.

Name: Bonheur by Matt Abé
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the former Le Gavroche site in Mayfair, this solo debut from chef Matt Abé has already earned two Michelin stars.
The intimate, ingredient-led dining room balances classical French roots with modern precision through its "Journey" and "Dream" tasting menus.
The "Petit Bonheur" chef's table offers a direct view of the kitchen, where signature dishes like the celeriac royale highlight Abé's technical mastery.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If a booking is not honoured in full or in part, including any reduction in guest numbers, or is cancelled with less than 72 hours’ notice, a cancellation fee of £165 will be charged to the card provided. We kindly ask for your understanding that this policy applies to all reservations and is not discretionary.

Name: Murano Ristorante
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Murano Ristorante is a Venetian Italian restaurant at 120 East 56th Street in Midtown East Manhattan, reviving the 1980s nameplate opened by founder Milan Licul over 50 years ago.
Features full bar with cocktails including limoncello margarita and martinis, private room for events, gluten-free options, wheelchair accessibility, and banquet facilities for anniversaries and business functions.
Executive Chef Cesar Dutan leads the kitchen, having worked at Jean George, Delmonico's Steakhouse, Bobby Vans, and Felice; specializes in homemade pasta, grilled octopus, shrimp scampi, and veal chop.

Name: China Tang
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by the late Sir David Tang, this Art Deco jewel within The Dorchester serves authentic Cantonese cuisine in a setting evoking 1930s Shanghai.
The theatrical interior defines the experience, featuring intricate latticework, plush seating, and a romantic, low-lit atmosphere that feels like a glamorous time warp.
A standout detail is the bespoke tableware commissioned by Tang himself, including silver-plated chopsticks and embroidered napkins that accompany the signature Peking duck.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Outlaw's at The Capital
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in Knightsbridge’s Capital Hotel, this seafood destination brings the Cornish coast to London under the guidance of chef Nathan Outlaw.
The kitchen champions sustainable catches from the South West, executing dishes with a restraint that highlights the natural quality of the ingredients.
Signature plates often feature Porthilly oysters or cured monkfish, enjoyed in an intimate dining room paired with selections from the hotel's notable wine cellar.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: La Bodega Negra
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Concealed within a Soho basement, this Mexican cantina is the brainchild of restaurateur Will Ricker and nightlife designer Serge Becker.
The windowless, candlelit interior evokes a decaying hacienda, serving refined street food in a space charged with speakeasy allure.
A neon-lit sex shop frontage marks the entrance, leading to a dining room known for its BBQ octopus and extensive tequila list.

Name: Bar Antoine
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the Four Seasons Hotel London at Park Lane, this venue serves as the lounge counterpart to Chef Yannick Alléno’s Pavyllon restaurant.
The interior combines an oblong central bar and low copper tables with an outdoor terrace, offering a menu of sushi and small plates.
The cocktail program utilizes Alléno’s signature extraction technique to concentrate ingredient flavors for both alcoholic and non-alcoholic serves.

Name: Caractère
Master_Aurora_Insights:
This independent Michelin-starred restaurant in Notting Hill is the creation of Emily Roux and her husband, chef Diego Ferrari.
The kitchen delivers a refined blend of French and Italian cuisine in a setting that balances casual warmth with contemporary polish.
In a departure from tradition, the menu is organized by "character traits" such as Curious, Subtle, and Robust rather than standard courses.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We operate a 48-hour cancellation policy for parties up to 6 and a 72-hour cancellation policy for parties of 6 or more. Late cancellation or no shows will incur a fee of £115 per person. Any charges will be taken from the credit/debit card provided at the time of the booking.

Name: Berenjak Borough
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a Borough Market townhouse, this Persian outpost from founder Kian Samyani and JKS Restaurants evokes the rural foothills of the Alborz mountains.
The kitchen focuses on charcoal-grilled meats and sharing-style mazeh, providing a spacious, feasting-oriented counterpoint to the group’s original Soho location.
Order the Feast menu to sample signatures like the coal-cooked aubergine and lamb shoulder kabab, accompanied by fresh clay-baked breads.

Name: Daphne's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 1964 by theatre agent Daphne Rye, this South Kensington fixture remains a definitive destination for refined Italian dining.
Martin Brudnizki’s interiors evoke a vibrant Venetian palazzo, anchored by a pink marble bar and Murano glass chandeliers.
The conservatory features a retractable roof and immersive seasonal installations, creating a theatrical backdrop for classics like the veal Milanese.

Name: Petersham Nurseries
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by the Boglione family in Richmond, this destination combines a working garden center with a restaurant housed in a glasshouse.
The kitchen serves seasonal Italian-influenced dishes in a space defined by antique furniture and natural light.
A recipient of a Michelin Green Star, the venue is distinguished by its commitment to sustainability and a dining room filled with trailing plants and chandeliers.

Name: Kai
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Kai Mayfair is a fine dining Chinese restaurant at 65 South Audley Street in Mayfair, opened in 1993 and formerly Michelin starred 2009 to 2024.
Features glitzy interior with tropical fish tank, laser patterned leather walls, gold leaf ceilings, two floors with ground and basement dining areas.
Offers liberated Nanyang Chinese cooking including signature 18 hour slow cooked pork belly, wasabi prawns, Peking duck, and Chinese Whispers Afternoon Tea
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Any no-shows, cancellations of booking or changes to the date of booking made inside 24 hours of your booking will therefore result in a charge of £60 / person.

Name: Jean-Georges at The Connaught
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Overlooking Mount Street in Mayfair, this light-filled restaurant at The Connaught is helmed by chef Jean-Georges Vongerichten.
The kitchen integrates Southeast Asian flavours with British ingredients, served in a conservatory space designed by interior architect John Heah.
Floor-to-ceiling windows feature stained glass by artist Jean-Michel Othoniel, framing signature plates like the black truffle and fontina pizza.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Credit/debit card details are required to secure the booking; no deposit is processed. A charge will be incurred if you fail to arrive without notice or cancel within 24 hours of the reservation. The charge is £65 per person for lunch and dinner bookings and the full amount per person for afternoon tea. Adjustments to booking numbers can be made at any time at no extra charge, subject to availability. If the reservation is not confirmed 24 hours before booking, the restaurant reserves the right to cancel the reservation.

Name: Brasserie of Light
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within Selfridges, this all-day dining destination is the work of Caprice Holdings and features interiors by Martin Brudnizki.
The light-filled space features high-gloss, mirror-lined interiors and serves a versatile menu spanning British classics and Asian-influenced dishes.
A 24-foot crystal-encrusted Pegasus by Damien Hirst soars above the main dining room, serving as the restaurant’s central anchor.

Name: Da Terra
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in the former Bethnal Green Town Hall, this two-Michelin-starred restaurant is the work of Brazilian-Italian chef Rafael Cagali.
The kitchen serves blind tasting menus that apply modern European techniques to the chef's background, blending Latin American flavours with Italian culinary roots.
A consistent highlight is the signature Moqueca, a refined interpretation of the Brazilian fish stew served with farofa that exemplifies this cross-cultural approach.

Name: Counter 71
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a converted Shoreditch pub, this intimate chef’s table marks the solo debut of chef Joe Laker.
The experience centers on a sixteen-seat counter where a seasonal, multi-course tasting menu champions produce from the British Isles.
Dinner begins promptly at 7:15pm for all guests, a communal ritual that often concludes in the Deep South-inspired Lowcountry bar downstairs.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We operate a strict 48-hour cancellation policy. Cancellations or changes must be made at least 48 hours before your booking to avoid a charge. Cancellations within 48 hours will incur a fee of £130 per guest.

Name: Bar des Prés
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by French chef Cyril Lignac, this cosmopolitan address bridges the gap between a Parisian bistro and a Tokyo sushi bar.
The kitchen applies French technique to Japanese ingredients, serving refined raw seafood and fusion plates in a moody, sophisticated setting.
A definitive highlight is the Galette Craquette, a crispy crab and avocado tart topped with Madras curry that anchors the menu.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations can be booked up to 60 days in advance. Last reservation at 11pm and 10pm on Sundays. We do not take reservations for drinks only and all tables are for the full A La Carte dining experience. Children under 10 years old will not be permitted in the restaurant for any bookings after 7.00pm. Pass 15 min late, your table will not be guaranteed.

Name: Club Gascon
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Chef Pascal Aussignac’s acclaimed restaurant occupies a former Lyons tea house adjacent to London’s Smithfield Market.
The kitchen celebrates the culinary heritage of Gascony, elevating regional staples like foie gras and duck into refined, contemporary plates.
A signature indulgence is the "Tipsy Duck," a whole roast bird glazed with Armagnac, served amidst the dining room’s original marble walls and Art Nouveau features.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We kindly ask for a minimum of 48 hours notice to cancel an evening booking. Please note that for all bookings of six persons or more a £50pp pre-payment is required.

Name: Jamavar (Mayfair)
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Samyukta Nair, this Michelin-starred Mayfair outpost brings the legacy of The Leela Palaces to London under executive chef Surender Mohan.
The kitchen delivers a polished exploration of pan-Indian cuisine, balancing royal northern recipes with the vibrant, spice-led coastal dishes of the south.
Interiors evoking New Delhi’s Viceroy’s House provide a handsome backdrop for signature plates like the Malabar prawns with white turmeric.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Bookings will only be secured and confirmed through a valid credit or debit card. A fee of £50 per person will apply for late cancellation within 48 hours before the booking or no-show.

Name: Cornus
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the top floor of a former power station in Belgravia’s Eccleston Yards, this restaurant is led by the team behind Medlar and executive chef Gary Foulkes.
The dining room combines floor-to-ceiling windows with starched white tablecloths, offering a classic setting for a menu grounded in French technique.
Notable dishes include hand-rolled spaghetti with native lobster and oscietra caviar, followed by pastry chef Kelly Cullen’s raspberry millefeuille.

Name: Nobu Portman Square
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Now I have sufficient information to write the description. Key facts:
- Nobu Hotel London Portman Square, located in Marylebone, London
- Opened December 2020
- 249 rooms and suites
- Interiors by David Collins Studio, architecture by MAKE Architects
- Founded by Chef Nobu Matsuhisa (with Robert De Niro and Meir Teper)
- Facilities: Nobu Pilates studio (first of its kind, created by Marsha Lindsay), fitness centre, spa/wellness treatments including IV therapies
- Dining: Nobu Restaurant (Chef Nobu Matsuhisa), Nobu Bar, Nobu Terrace, The Lounge (afternoon tea)

Nobu Hotel London Portman Square is a 249-room hotel in Marylebone, opened in December 2020, with interiors by David Collins Studio and architecture by MAKE Architects.
Facilities include a Reformer Pilates studio, fitness centre, and wellness treatments including IV therapies.
The Nobu Restaurant serves Chef Nobu Matsuhisa's Japanese-Peruvian cuisine; Nobu Bar and Nobu Terrace offer cocktails; The Lounge serves afternoon tea.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations must be cancelled by 3:00 pm (local time) one day prior to arrival date to avoid a penalty of one night’s stay including taxes. Cancellation policy may vary by rate. A no-show fee of one night’s stay will apply, and early departure fees may apply. We require a deposit for all room and suite reservations and pre-authorisation will be taken on your credit card at check-in to cover room and incidental costs (£200 per night, to a maximum of three nights).

Name: Park Chinois
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Conceived by restaurateur Alan Yau, this Mayfair address pays homage to the dinner-dance culture of 1930s Shanghai.
The dual-level interior features a refined ground-floor salon and a subterranean dining room hosting nightly live jazz and cabaret.
A signature Duck de Chine, roasted to order and requiring 72 hours of preparation, serves as the culinary centerpiece.

Name: Lahpet Shoreditch
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Dan Anton and Head Chef Zaw Mahesh, this London destination offers a refined introduction to the complex heritage of Myanmar.
The kitchen elevates rustic regional staples with contemporary precision, establishing the venue as a definitive reference point for modern Burmese cooking.
Essential to the experience is the eponymous lahpet thohk, a textured salad of pickled tea leaves that delivers a distinct balance of sour, salty, and savory notes.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: OMA
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched above Borough Market, this Michelin-starred Greek destination is the latest opening from Manteca founder David Carter.
Head chef Jorge Paredes steers the kitchen away from taverna clichés, delivering precise, fire-driven cooking in a space defined by beachy minimalism.
A dedicated crudo bar and open hearth produce standouts like coal-braised clay pots, best enjoyed in the sun-drenched dining room.

Name: Humo
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Humo is a wood-fired restaurant in London’s Mayfair, currently led by Head Chef Robbie Jameson under the Creative Restaurant Group.
The culinary concept eschews electricity and gas, relying entirely on a four-metre grill and specific timber varieties to flavour each course.
A signature presentation sees Orkney scallops cooked over Glenfiddich whisky barrels, infusing the seafood with a unique, smoky depth.

Name: Restaurant Gordon Ramsay
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Royal Hospital Road, this three-Michelin-starred flagship is the original venue of Gordon Ramsay’s group, directed by Chef Patron Matt Abé.
The intimate dining room seats just 45 guests, serving modern French cuisine defined by technical precision and seasonal ingredients.
A long-standing signature course is the ravioli of lobster, langoustine, and salmon, finished with a bisque and sorrel sauce.

Name: Fonda
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Chef Santiago Lastra, the creative force behind KOL, brings his second London concept to Mayfair with this contemporary ode to Mexico’s informal family-run eateries.
Designed by A-nrd Studio with warm terracotta tones, the space reimagines the rustic tradition through a refined lens that champions British ingredients.
A clay comal serves as the kitchen’s beating heart, turning out signature dishes like the rich pumpkin seed sikil pak and ribeye costras.

Name: BiBi
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Mayfair, this contemporary Indian dining room is the debut project from chef-patron Chet Sharma, an alumnus of The Ledbury, backed by JKS Restaurants.
The kitchen applies modern technique to subcontinental heritage, drawing inspiration from the recipes of Sharma’s grandmothers, the restaurant’s namesakes.
Interiors feature paisley motifs referenced from his grandmother’s shawls, while the menu highlights a signature take on cheese poppadoms using Wookey Hole Cheddar.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Please note, our cancellation policies vary in line with the time and size of your reservation, and the corresponding menus. Details of these are given in the next step of the booking process and your confirmation email.

Name: Brawn
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on East London’s Columbia Road, this neighbourhood staple is the work of chef-owner Ed Wilson, earning a nod from the Michelin Guide.
The daily changing menu champions seasonal Mediterranean cooking and natural wines, anchored by the nose-to-tail pork dishes that inspired its name.
Interiors are defined by a relaxed, wabi-sabi aesthetic, while the signature pork and prune terrine remains a standout on the blackboard menu.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We require credit card details for all reservations to protect against no-shows and cancellations with less than 24 hours notice. We will always do our best to rebook your table but in case this is not possible you may be charged a cancellation fee.

Name: 42 Cocktail Lounge
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Mayfair, this cocktail lounge from JKS Restaurants occupies the first floor above the two-Michelin-starred Gymkhana on Albemarle Street.
The intimate space evokes a colonial Indian club’s captain’s quarters, decorated with ornate antiques, plush velvet, and refurbished Kashmiri wall hangings.
Signature cocktails like the Bagheera and Bhang Lassi showcase Indian spices and spirits, served alongside a curated menu of bar snacks.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: In the event that the reservation is not honoured in whole, or is cancelled with less than 24 hours notice, there will be a charge of £50 per person.

Name: Kitchen W8
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Kensington, this Michelin-starred restaurant is a partnership between restaurateur Rebecca Mascarenhas and chef Philip Howard, with Mark Kempson leading the kitchen.
The understated dining room provides a relaxed backdrop for modern European dishes defined by technical precision and seasonal British ingredients.
Its expertise in game is particularly notable, having secured the title of Best Restaurant at the Eat Game Awards.

Name: Hoppers (Soho)
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Backed by JKS Restaurants and Karan Gokani, this Soho canteen channels Sri Lankan roadside shacks and holds a Michelin Bib Gourmand.
The interior mimics a village toddy shop with patterned tiles and wood paneling, creating a spirited backdrop for the spice-heavy cuisine.
The menu highlights the namesake egg hopper, a bowl-shaped coconut milk crêpe, served alongside the bone marrow varuval.
Master_Cancellation_Policy:
Bookings require debit card details to secure the booking. Cancellations can be made using the 'Cancel Reservation' link found in your confirmation email; cancellations are not accepted via phone or email.

Hoppers Soho:
1–7 guests: Cancellations accepted up to 3 hours prior. Late cancellations or no-shows will incur a charge of £10 per person.
8–12 guests: Cancellations accepted up to 10 hours prior. Late cancellations or no-shows will incur a charge of £120.

Hoppers Marylebone:
1–4 guests: Cancellations accepted up to 3 hours prior. Late cancellations or no-shows will incur a charge of £10 per person.
5–11 guests: Cancellations accepted up to 10 hours prior. Late cancellations or no-shows will incur a charge of £120.
12–16 guests: Cancellations accepted up to 24 hours prior. Late cancellations or no-shows will incur a charge of £120.

Hoppers King’s Cross:
1–5 guests: Cancellations accepted up to 3 hours prior. Late cancellations or no-shows will incur a charge of £10 per person.
6–8 guests: Cancellations accepted up to 10 hours prior. Late cancellations or no-shows will incur a charge of £120.
9–18 guests: Cancellations accepted up to 24 hours prior. Late cancellations or no-shows will incur a charge of £120.

Hoppers Shoreditch:
1–4 guests: Cancellations accepted up to 3 hours prior. Late cancellations or no-shows will incur a charge of £10 per person.
5–12 guests: Cancellations accepted up to 10 hours prior. Late cancellations or no-shows will incur a charge of £120 per person.

Name: Cycene
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within Shoreditch’s Blue Mountain School, this Michelin-starred restaurant is led by head chef Taz Sarhane.
The intimate venue serves a multi-course tasting menu to just 15 guests, designed to emulate the atmosphere of a private dinner party.
The evening begins with a broth and bread course in the ground-floor bar before diners move upstairs to the dining room.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Arlington
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Restaurateur Jeremy King has reclaimed his former territory in St James’s, reviving the legendary Le Caprice site as a polished, contemporary brasserie.
The space retains its clubby, monochrome Art Deco allure, serving as a spirited social hub for London’s media and fashion elite.
Nostalgia anchors the menu, best experienced through signature comforts like the bang bang chicken or the salmon fishcakes with sorrel sauce.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We ask that any cancellation or modification to your reservation be made no less than 24 hours prior. Failure to arrive for your reservation or late cancellations will result in a charge of £40 per person applied to the credit card on file.

Name: Bistrotheque
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Pablo Flack and David Waddington in 2004, this Bethnal Green stalwart occupies a converted warehouse in London’s East End.
The vast, whitewashed industrial space serves as a reliable hub for the city's creative class, offering a menu of consistent French-bistro staples.
A defining ritual occurs during weekend brunch, when resident pianist Xavior performs pop covers on the central baby grand.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A late cancellation fee of £10 per person for lunch and £25 per person for dinner applies if the reservation is cancelled within 12 hours of the booking time. These fees also apply to no-shows. For Private Dining Room (PDR) bookings, a non-refundable deposit of £500 is required, and cancellations within 7 days of the event incur the full minimum spend.

Name: Luca
Master_Aurora_Insights:
From the team behind The Clove Club, this Michelin-starred Clerkenwell staple applies precise Italian technique to the finest seasonal British produce.
The Alexander Waterworth interiors are a study in understated warmth, featuring reclaimed brick, floor-to-ceiling glass, and a light-filled dining room.
Essential orders include the signature parmesan fries, ideally enjoyed by the open fire on the secluded, foliage-filled terrace.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: AngloThai
Master_Aurora_Insights:
AngloThai is the Michelin-starred Marylebone home of husband-and-wife team John and Desiree Chantarasak, established after years of acclaimed pop-ups.
The kitchen applies bold Thai techniques to strictly seasonal British produce, eschewing jasmine rice for domestic grains like barley.
Interiors by May Redding feature chamchuri wood chairs and Lampang Province ceramics, a refined backdrop for the signature bread with shrimp butter.

Name: Endo at The Rotunda
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched atop the Television Centre in White City, this intimate omakase counter is the domain of third-generation sushi master Endo Kazutoshi.
Designed by Kengo Kuma, the space centers on a two-hundred-year-old Hinoki wood stage where guests engage directly with the chef’s precise, theatrical craftsmanship.
Uncompromising attention to detail extends to the rice, which is cooked exclusively with water imported from the chef’s home village in Japan.
