Name: Sorrel
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Based in the 300-year-old Little Dudley House in Dorking, this Michelin-starred destination is the brainchild of chef Steve Drake.
The experience marries a historic setting of exposed beams and wonky floors with a fiercely modern, seasonal approach to British fine dining.
A standout moment is the signature "Green, Green, Green" dish, a textural study of broccoli with kiwi and capers that exemplifies the kitchen's creativity.

Name: Liholiho Yacht Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Chef Ravi Kapur leads this San Francisco destination, blending his Hawaiian heritage with a Northern Californian sensibility.
The kitchen applies rigorous technique to family recipes, merging Chinese and Indian flavors with regional produce.
A meal typically begins with the tuna poke, which arrives on a single, large nori cracker intended to be snapped and shared.

Name: The Progress
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in San Francisco’s Fillmore district, this airy restaurant is the sophomore project from James Beard Award-winning duo Stuart Brioza and Nicole Krasinski.
The menu encourages a communal approach, offering a customizable banquet where tables select multiple savory courses to share.
The high-ceilinged space features distinctive curving plaster walls and serves dishes on custom pottery by local artist Mary Mar Keenan.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations within 5 days of the reservation will be subject to a charge of half the food and beverage minimum. Day of cancellations will be subject to the full food and beverage minimum.

Name: Lazy Bear
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in San Francisco’s Mission District, this two-Michelin-starred venue from chef David Barzelay evolved from an underground pop-up into a permanent culinary fixture.
The experience functions as a modern American dinner party, where chefs present nostalgic, foraging-focused courses with detailed storytelling in a mid-century space.
A signature serving is the whipped scrambled eggs with maple syrup and hot sauce, presented in a jar as a savory-sweet starter.

Name: State Bird Provisions
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by chefs Stuart Brioza and Nicole Krasinski, this Michelin-starred San Francisco restaurant applies a dynamic dim-sum format to modern Californian cuisine.
Servers circulate the room with rolling carts and trays, offering a spontaneous, ever-changing selection of small plates directly to diners.
The signature buttermilk-fried quail is the menu’s constant, ideally paired with the duck liver mousse served with warm almond biscuits.

Name: Chez Panisse
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Alice Waters’s Berkeley restaurant is widely credited with pioneering the farm-to-table movement and defining modern California cuisine.
Housed in a timbered Arts and Crafts building, the dining room offers a single, daily-changing prix fixe menu based strictly on local, organic harvests.
The experience centers on a copper-hooded open kitchen and famously concludes with a pristine bowl of seasonal fruit rather than an elaborate confection.

Name: Benu
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in San Francisco’s SoMa district, this three-Michelin-starred destination is the independent flagship of chef Corey Lee, a French Laundry alumnus.
The kitchen applies exacting Western technique to East Asian flavors, serving a tasting menu that explores texture through fermentation and aging.
A perennial signature is the thousand-year-old quail egg, served with a ginger potage that exemplifies the team's precise, minimalist approach.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If you would like to cancel, please contact us at least 72 hours in advance and we will issue a full refund. Cancelling or rescheduling within 24-72 hours of the booking will incur a 50% cancellation fee, and within 24 hours will incur a 100% fee. Please note that the same policy also applies to any COVID-related cancellations. You are welcome to transfer your reservation to another guest at any time.

Name: Rich Table
Master_Aurora_Insights:
In San Francisco’s Hayes Valley, James Beard Award-nominated chefs Evan and Sarah Rich helm this lively, wood-paneled neighborhood favorite.
The kitchen presents inventive, market-driven Californian fare in a relaxed setting defined by salvaged barn wood and an open kitchen.
For a memorable start, order the signature sardine chips, featuring delicate sardines threaded through crisp potato slices.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We require a credit card to reserve all tables in the restaurant. There is a 48-Hour Cancellation policy for each reservation. Should you need to cancel within 48 Hours of your reservation, please call or email us and we will attempt to reseat the table. If you are unable to rebook the table, a charge of $45 per person will be applied to the card on file.

Name: Nari
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in San Francisco’s Hotel Kabuki, this Michelin-starred restaurant is the second project from chef Pim Techamuanvivit.
The name translates to "women" in Thai, a tribute reflected in a heritage-driven menu that bridges traditional techniques with Northern California’s seasonal bounty.
Meals are served family-style in a light-filled, plant-lined space, featuring complex dishes like the signature betel leaf miang.

Name: The Happy Crane
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in San Francisco’s Hayes Valley, this modern Cantonese destination is the brick-and-mortar evolution of a pop-up from chef James Yeun Leong Parry.
The kitchen balances authentic Chinese flavors with contemporary technique, creating a menu that feels both rooted in tradition and distinctly fresh.
A small center bar anchors the space, while the dining room highlights inventive share plates like a signature crab rice roll.

Name: Son's & Daughters
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Relocated to the Mission, this two-Michelin-starred restaurant is led by executive chef Harrison Cheney, who presents a focused New Nordic tasting menu.
The kitchen prioritizes preservation, applying fermentation and curing to Northern California produce to create a structured, seasonal progression.
A meal here is highlighted by the signature sourdough course, served warm with cultured butter in a dining room centered around an open kitchen.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations become final, non-refundable, and cannot be modified, rescheduled or cancelled within 72 hours of the reservation for Parties of 3 or less and after 7 days for parties of 4 or more. Cancellations made with at least 72 hours’ notice are eligible for a credit for a future visit or a full refund. Seating cannot be guaranteed beyond a 15-minute grace period; refunds and reschedules are not offered if guests cannot be seated after this window.

Name: Californios
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by Chef Val Cantú in San Francisco, this two-Michelin-starred destination presents a sophisticated evolution of Mexican cuisine within a dark, gallery-like space.
The nightly tasting menu applies classical technique to heirloom ingredients, deconstructing familiar profiles into a progression of precise, texture-rich courses.
A defining detail is the house-made sourdough tortilla, a pillowy canvas for seasonal fillings that perfectly bridges Cantú’s heritage with the region’s identity.

Name: Acquerello
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in San Francisco’s Nob Hill, this two-Michelin-starred Italian restaurant has been directed by Giancarlo Paterlini and Chef Suzette Gresham since 1989.
The dining room occupies a former chapel, defined by high vaulted wood-beam ceilings and classic white tablecloths.
A tableside cheese cart and the signature ridged pasta with truffles are enduring highlights of the tasting menu.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: All reservations must be guaranteed with a pre-paid deposit of $100 per person. The deposit collected on booking will be credited to the final bill. All deposits are final and non-refundable. To cancel an existing reservation, please call us at (415) 567-5432 Tuesday-Saturday between 2pm to 10pm.

Name: Dalida
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set on the Main Parade Lawn of San Francisco’s Presidio, this Eastern Mediterranean destination is led by chefs Laura and Sayat Ozyilmaz.
The kitchen channels the diverse culinary heritage of Istanbul, balancing traditional Ottoman recipes with contemporary Californian sensibilities.
Diners should not miss the signature bread service, which pairs an assortment of spreads with pillowy pita baked to order in the open hearth.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Lunch: $10 per person fee for cancellations within 12 hours. Dinner: $25 per person fee for cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72-hour cancellation window.

Name: Rintaro
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in San Francisco, this izakaya is the work of chef Sylvan Mishima Brackett, a Kyoto-born alum of Chez Panisse.
The kitchen pairs California ingredients with Japanese technique, grilling pasture-raised chicken over binchotan charcoal behind a hand-hewn cedar bar.
A standout dish is the handmade udon, served alongside teba no karaage, crispy chicken wings seasoned with soy and sansho pepper.

Name: The Shota
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within a Financial District office building, this Michelin-starred sushi counter is the namesake destination of Chef Ingi “Shota” Son.
The industrial-chic space presents a seasonal omakase that blends traditional Edomae style with modern kaiseki flourishes.
The menu features precise bites like jewel-skinned kasugo nigiri and a signature chawanmushi studded with fava beans and borage flowers.

Name: Saison
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a historic industrial building in San Francisco, this two-Michelin-starred destination is currently helmed by executive chef Richard Lee.
The kitchen’s philosophy revolves entirely around an open wood-burning hearth, where Northern Californian ingredients are transformed by fire and smoke.
A restorative herbal tea ritual begins the meal, setting the stage for signature courses like the sea urchin on grilled bread.

Name: Noodle in a Haystack
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by self-taught duo Clint and Yoko Tan, this Inner Richmond destination evolved from a cult pop-up into a World Ramen Grand Prix finalist.
The intimate counter defies genre conventions with a multi-course tasting menu that elevates ramen into a refined culinary art form.
Expect inventive preludes like an A5 Wagyu sando on a milk-bread donut before the meal culminates in a signature double-broth ramen bowl.

Name: Mister Jiu's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a historic banquet hall in San Francisco’s Chinatown, this Michelin-starred dining room is led by chef Brandon Jew.
The kitchen reinterprets Cantonese recipes through a Californian lens, utilizing local produce to update traditional techniques.
Beneath restored gold lotus chandeliers, diners share the signature Peking-style roast duck, served whole with pancakes and condiments.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A deposit of $25 per guest for A La Carte reservations and $50 per guest for Banquet Menu reservations is required. Deposits are fully refundable up to four days before your visit. After this time, there are no refunds or credits. If you arrive with fewer guests than listed on your reservation, the deposit for your missing guests will not be refunded.

Name: Kokkari Estiatorio
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Highlighted by the Michelin Guide, this San Francisco destination serves modern Hellenic cuisine inspired by its namesake Greek fishing village.
The warm interior evokes a rustic Mediterranean tavern with exposed wood beams, woven tapestries, and a large stone fireplace.
A central wood-burning hearth anchors the dining room, turning out signature dishes like wood-grilled octopus and tender lamb chops.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations are accepted up to 24 hours prior to the reservation without penalty. Late cancellations or no-shows are subject to a fee (reported as $10 per person for lunch, potentially higher for dinner). Credit card required for booking.

Name: House of Prime Rib
Master_Aurora_Insights:
House of Prime Rib is a San Francisco landmark at 1906 Van Ness Avenue, established in 1949, featuring 21-day-aged prime rib carved tableside from stainless-steel carts. Serves prime rib in multiple cuts, including City Cut, House Cut, English Cut, and King Henry VIII Cut, plus fresh fish and a cocktail lounge. 
The menu offers five prime rib sizes ranging from City Cut to King Henry VIII, with tableside salad and Yorkshire pudding included with each dinner. Recognized as a 2022 James Beard Award finalist for Outstanding Hospitality and featured on Anthony Bourdain's No Reservations and Food Network programming.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Madcap
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by acclaimed chef Ron Siegel, this intimate San Anselmo destination stands as Marin County’s only Michelin-starred restaurant.
The kitchen delivers a refined yet approachable interpretation of modern American cuisine, blending French technique with Japanese simplicity.
The dining room features mid-century modern furniture and contemporary art, setting a warm stage for the vegetable-focused tasting menu.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations require a deposit of $50 per person which is applied to the final bill. Cancellations made within 48 hours of the reservation time are non-refundable unless the table can be rebooked.

Name: Penny Roma
Master_Aurora_Insights:
From the Flour + Water Hospitality Group, this Mission District destination presents regional Italian cuisine under the direction of co-chefs Thomas McNaughton and Ryan Pollnow.
The atmosphere is defined by a bustling open kitchen and a plant-filled courtyard that creates a seamless indoor-outdoor flow.
A wood-burning hearth powers the menu of crudi and fresh pastas, anchored by a signature cacio e pepe.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We understand things happen and are happy to permit cancellations up to 2 days prior to your reservation with us. Reservations cancelled within 48 hours will accrue a $35 cancellation fee per person.

Name: Robin
Master_Aurora_Insights:
In San Francisco’s Hayes Valley, chef Adam Tortosa leads this contemporary omakase spot that pairs Japanese precision with California produce.
The interior features pink terrazzo walls and local art, while a hip-hop soundtrack sets a relaxed, modern tone.
A meal often includes the signature potato chip topped with caviar or A5 wagyu finished with a dusting of frozen foie gras.

Name: Bamford Wellness Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by organic pioneer Carole Bamford, this holistic sanctuary within the eco-conscious 1 Hotel brings the restorative spirit of the English countryside to the city.
The ethos centers on nature, featuring biophilic interiors and treatments that employ pure, ethically sourced ingredients to nurture the body and mind.
A highlight is the B Silent ritual, a therapeutic massage designed to improve sleep using products crafted from the Daylesford Organic Farm.

Name: Moongate Lounge
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located above Mister Jiu’s in San Francisco’s Chinatown, this listening lounge is the creation of chef Brandon Jew and designer Anna Lee.
The room operates as a low-lit salon where a high-fidelity Meyer Sound system underscores a cocktail program rooted in the Chinese agrarian calendar.
Beneath original redwood beams, the menu rotates every two weeks to align with the twenty-four solar terms of the lunar year.

Name: Jyzen
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in Mill Valley, this advanced medical and performance hub is helmed by integrative physician Dr. Beth McDougall.
The practice bridges the gap between functional medicine and high-tech bio-optimization, offering data-driven protocols for longevity.
Signature tools include the Vasper system, which fuses compression and cooling with interval training for efficient metabolic conditioning.

Name: Cavaña
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched atop the Luma Hotel in Mission Bay, this Latin American cocktail destination comes from restaurateur John Park and the team behind Kaiyo.
The terrace offers wrap-around skyline views, setting the stage for a menu of regional spirits and shareable plates like aguachiles and arepas.
A distinctive ritual is the tableside bottle service, featuring rotating mezcals and rums paired with fruit, aguas frescas, and flavored salts.

Name: April Jean
Master_Aurora_Insights: Located at the historic intersection of Grant and Green in North Beach, this neighborhood cocktail bar comes from the team behind Peacekeeper. The space is designed as a comforting homage to the owners' mothers, featuring a warm interior of wood, marble, and leather. A standout on the childhood-memory-themed menu is the sparkling April Jean, a lemon-bar-inspired mix of vodka, spiced citrus oil, and amaro.

Name: 1015 Folsom
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Established by Ira Sandler in 1989, this San Francisco nightlife institution anchors the SoMa district with a sprawling multi-level warehouse layout.
The 20,000-square-foot venue divides into five distinct rooms across three floors, allowing for a versatile mix of electronic genres and live performances.
A 400-square-foot illuminated water wall serves as a visual centerpiece, complemented by a high-fidelity d&b audiotechnik sound system and projection mapping.

Name: The Hawthorn Grill
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by Executive Chef Eric Lhuillier, Hawthorn Grill is an American steakhouse situated within the JW Marriott Las Vegas Resort and Spa in Summerlin.
The menu balances traditional steakhouse fare and classic regional dishes with an extensive wine and cocktail program.
Beyond the main dining room, an outdoor patio provides a serene environment anchored by a cascading waterfall and a fire pit.

Name: Trestle
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located where North Beach meets Jackson Square, this Bib Gourmand-recognized restaurant from Hi Neighbor Hospitality Group occupies a historic brick building.
The kitchen delivers a daily-changing prix-fixe menu of contemporary American fare, prioritizing seasonal ingredients and technical precision over elaborate presentation.
Guests select from two dishes per course, often highlighting staples like house-made pasta or braised short rib against a backdrop of original timber framing.

Name: Bund Lounge
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched on the 28th floor of the London Hilton on Park Lane, this rooftop lounge from the creators of Shanghai Me evokes the glamour of 1930s Shanghai.
The cinematic interior blends Art Deco geometry, deep teal velvet, and mirrored walls to create an intimate atmosphere high above Mayfair.
A standout feature is the "Lunar Antipodes" cocktail menu, offering twelve signature drinks artfully crafted to represent the Chinese zodiac.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We will hold your reservation for 15 minutes from the confirmed time. After this, seating will be subject to availability.

Name: La Dame de Pic
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by Anne-Sophie Pic, the world’s most decorated female chef, this Michelin-starred destination in Paris presents her distinctive botanical cuisine.
The kitchen blends French tradition with Japanese influences, creating dishes characterized by complex aromatic pairings and precise, artistic plating.
A signature highlight is the Berlingots, pyramid-shaped pasta parcels filled with lightly smoked cheese and served in a seasonal, herb-infused consommé.

Name: Galaxy Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Tucked within Dubai’s DIFC, this intimate lounge is the late-night counterpart to Avli by Tashas, created by restaurateur Natasha Sideris.
The venue distinguishes itself with a high-concept cocktail program that has consistently earned it a place on The World’s 50 Best Bars list.
Dark velvet interiors set the mood, anchored by a signature ceiling where hundreds of lights replicate the constellations of the Athens night sky.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Free cancellations are accepted up to 24 hours in advance. A no-show or late cancellation fee of AED 150 per person applies. For 5+ guests, card confirmation details are required to confirm the reservation. Tables are held for 20 minutes after the agreed booking time.

Name: Nobu By The Beach
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within Atlantis The Royal, this is the world's first Nobu-branded pool and beach club, led by Chef Nobu Matsuhisa.
The GA Group-designed space merges Japanese minimalism with a coastal setting, featuring private cabanas and an open-air layout.
A menu of beach-specific small plates, such as grilled langoustine with shiso salsa, complements the deep house soundtrack and ocean views.

Name: Anantara Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on the Palm Jumeirah’s crescent, this award-winning spa is the wellness anchor of Anantara’s Thai-inspired Dubai resort.
The facility blends Thai and Arabian healing traditions across twenty-four treatment rooms and a traditional Turkish hammam.
Beyond the massage suites, the hydrotherapy circuit features a bamboo sauna, crystal steam room, and a therapeutic liquid sound pool.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Any cancellations made less than 24 hours will incur a 50% charge. For no-shows, the full treatment price will be charged.

Name: La Mar by Gastón Acurio
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Established by chef Gastón Acurio, this Peruvian cebichería operates outposts in Lima, Miami, San Francisco, and Doha.
The kitchen explores Peru’s multicultural heritage, combining Japanese Nikkei and Chinese Chifa techniques with fresh seafood in a lively setting.
A signature presentation is the *chalana*, a wooden boat serving a tasting of causas and cebiches, ideally paired with a Pisco Sour.

Name: Amazónico
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by husband-and-wife team Sandro Silva and Marta Seco, this rainforest-themed dining concept operates locations in Madrid, London, Dubai, and Miami.
Interiors by Lázaro Rosa-Violán utilize abundant foliage and natural materials to create a backdrop for a menu blending Amazonian, Nikkei, and Brazilian flavors.
A defining signature is the *Ensalada Amazónica* with mango and avocado, served in a high-energy atmosphere driven by nightly live musical performances.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours in advance of the reservation time. A fee per person will be charged to the credit card on file for no-shows or cancellations made within this 24-hour window. Credit card details are required to secure all bookings.

Name: Trèsind Studio
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within the St. Regis Gardens on Palm Jumeirah, this three-Michelin-starred dining room is led by chef Himanshu Saini.
The kitchen presents a highly choreographed tasting menu that deconstructs traditional Indian flavours with technical precision and regional depth.
A memorable interval in the multi-course progression is the Blossom Chaat, a signature assembly of crisp textures and floral notes that arrives with sculptural poise.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: To receive a confirmation of your reservation, an advance payment of AED 1350/ person (valid for food only) must be paid through the online payment link. If the reservation is canceled 48 hours before dinner – a full refund is applicable. After 48 hours, no refund will be applicable even if it is made on the same day. The table will be held for 15 mins from the time of reservation.

Name: NYX
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Concealed within GAIA restaurants from Dubai to London, this private speakeasy is the nocturnal concept of Chef Izu Ani and Evgeny Kuzin.
Named for the Greek goddess of the night, the lounge offers a moody, velvet-clad counterpoint to the bright Mediterranean dining room.
Access is granted via a hidden door, leading to an intimate, DJ-led sanctuary that operates well into the early hours.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellation and pre-payment conditions depend on the chosen rate; flexible rates allow free cancellation until 18:00 on the day of arrival, while non-refundable rates are charged at booking. A credit-card pre-authorisation for incidentals is taken upon arrival.

Name: Talise Spa Madinat Jumeirah
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by Jumeirah Hotels & Resorts, Talise Spa is a Forbes Four-Star wellness retreat set among the canals of Dubai's Madinat Jumeirah.
The 26-room facility focuses on Middle Eastern healing practices and integrative medicine.
Guests can arrive by traditional wooden abra boat before experiencing the signature Shiffa 24-karat gold hammam or the Alphasphere Deluxe sensory room designed by Austrian artist Sha.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If you need to cancel an appointment, please notify us at least 24 hours in advance. Late cancellations and no-shows will incur the full treatment charge.

Name: LPM
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Born in Nice and expanded globally by co-founder Arjun Waney, this restaurant celebrates the light, ingredient-led cuisine of the French Riviera.
The dining room balances Belle Époque elegance with a vibrant atmosphere, featuring art-lined walls and crisp white tablecloths.
A signature ritual anchors the meal: fresh tomatoes, lemons, and olive oil await on every table for guests to slice and season themselves.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Parties of 1-5 guests must be cancelled 24 hours prior to the reservation. Guests who do not turn up or make a last-minute cancellation may be fined a penalty (e.g. AED 200 per person). For booking of more than 6 guests, please contact us directly.

Name: Talise Jumeirah Beach Hotel Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located at Jumeirah Zabeel Saray on Palm Jumeirah, this facility has been named the World's Best Resort Spa by the World Spa Awards.
The 8,000-square-metre interior is modeled on a traditional palace, prioritizing rigorous hammam rituals over standard relaxation therapies.
Notable features include saltwater thalassotherapy pools, 42 treatment suites, and a snow room designed to cool the body after the steam.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations or rescheduling require at least 6 hours notice for spa appointments and 24 hours notice for packages, group bookings, or rituals. Late notice or no-shows are subject to a 50% cancellation fee.

Name: Avida Longevity
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Dubai’s Jumeirah district, this wellness destination led by CEO Omar Geier merges preventive medicine with high-end hospitality.
The clinic prioritizes data over relaxation, employing systems biology and advanced diagnostics to engineer hyper-personalized health strategies.
Its flagship BioLongevity program exemplifies this approach, rigorously analyzing biomarkers like cellular stress and metabolic flexibility to optimize healthspan alongside regenerative therapies such as cryotherapy.

Name: Gigi Rigolatto
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set on J1 Beach, this Italian beach house is a project by RIKAS Hospitality Group and Paris Society, with interiors by architect Hugo Toro.
The space channels a grand rustic villa, merging lush foliage and terracotta tones with a pool and garden to evoke a laid-back Mediterranean residence.
A dedicated Bellini Bar anchors the experience, complementing a sharing-style menu that features signature plates like the Linguini Alle Vongole.

Name: Armani/SPA
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated within the Burj Khalifa, this wellness retreat was personally designed by Giorgio Armani to reflect his signature aesthetic.
The 12,000-square-foot space creates a moody, sophisticated atmosphere with dark stone surfaces, muted lighting, and sequential thermal bathing zones.
Therapies are often anchored by three bespoke oil blends—Mu, Libertà, and Fluidità—formulated to induce stillness, freedom, or fluidity.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: In the event of cancellation, guests are required to notify the SPA by 8:00 pm on the day prior to their appointment. In the event of later notification or failure to show, we reserve the right to charge in full for the treatment. Special conditions will apply in the case of bookings during the day and/or with exclusive use of our SPA; these conditions will be stipulated upon confirmation of the booking.

Name: 11 Woodfire
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in a repurposed villa on Jumeirah Beach Road, this Michelin-starred spot is the work of chef-owner Akmal Anuar. The kitchen eschews gas entirely, relying on a massive open grill to char simple, high-quality ingredients with precision.
Distinctive woods like oak, hickory, and hay are used to season signature dishes, including the popular grilled bone marrow and seabass.

Name: Bulgari Yacht Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Anchored on Jumeira Bay Island, this marina-side destination within the Bulgari Resort is the work of Italian architectural practice Antonio Citterio Patricia Viel.
The venue evokes a Mediterranean village with a 46-berth harbor and wooden boardwalks, featuring a pool deck and an Italian seafood restaurant.
The kitchen presents a concept by chef Niko Romito, serving signature plates like linguine alle vongole on a terrace overlooking the Arabian Gulf.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Nobu Privé
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Concealed within Nobu Dubai on the 22nd floor of Atlantis, The Palm, this intimate lounge operates as a hidden enclave for late-night drinking.
Floor-to-ceiling windows framing the skyline complement organic design elements like curved wicker panels and understated lighting.
With just 43 seats, the venue pairs shareable Japanese-Peruvian bites with signature cocktails like the Neon Colada, finished with lychee vanilla foam.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours in advance to avoid a penalty. Late cancellations or no-shows are subject to a fee (typically AED 150–200 per person).

Name: Ling Ling
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Created as a standalone offshoot of the Michelin-starred Hakkasan brand, this izakaya-style concept operates in select global destinations.
The atmosphere follows a "dining to drinking" progression, featuring Cantonese small plates and an extensive cocktail list within a design-led setting.
A signature element is the curated electronic soundtrack, originally developed for the main restaurant’s lounge, which now anchors the venue’s late-night identity.

Name: Iris
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated within the Meydan Grandstand, this sprawling open-air lounge is a standout venue from the Beirut-based Addmind hospitality group.
The atmosphere shifts from a relaxed sunset spot to a high-energy club, accompanied by a menu of Japanese raw dishes and South American bites.
Futuristic, pod-like booths provide privacy while framing panoramic views of the distant city skyline, best paired with a signature botanical cocktail.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: No refunds or credits will be made for any changes, cancellation, or non-arrival for any reason within the period of time specified by the Company at the time of booking. Even after full payment has been received, the venue reserves the right to cancel a reservation without notice if they become aware of or are notified of any fraudulent or illegal activity associated with the payment.

Name: Museum of the Future
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by architect Shaun Killa, this torus-shaped institution in Dubai investigates the evolution of science and technology through immersive simulations.
The column-free interior functions as a "living museum," replacing static collections with interactive environments like a digital Amazon rainforest and a simulated space station.
Its stainless steel exterior comprises 1,024 robotically manufactured panels, arranged to form Arabic calligraphy quoting Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Tickets are non-transferable, non-refundable, and non-exchangeable. No refunds are offered if the arrival time slot is missed. Ticket holders who purchased "Protection Fee" ticket protection may cancel or reschedule by contacting the Museum at least 24 hours prior to the scheduled date/time for a full refund (excluding the Protection Fee) or guaranteed rescheduling. Claims made within 24 hours of the scheduled time are not eligible for refunds.

Name: Mott 32
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Named after New York’s first Chinese general store, this contemporary Cantonese destination is the flagship concept of hospitality group Maximal Concepts.
The atmospheric, industrial-chic interiors provide a moody backdrop for regional classics refined through ethical sourcing and modern precision.
The unmissable centrepiece is the signature 42-day apple wood roasted Peking duck, a pre-order specialty carved tableside with theatrical flair.

Name: One&Only Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within Dubai’s One&Only Royal Mirage, this wellness sanctuary was created in conjunction with ESPA and features a Pedi:Mani:Cure Studio by Bastien Gonzalez.
Towering domes and intricate carved arches define the Arabesque architecture, creating a hushed atmosphere distinct from the city's modern skyline.
The authentic Oriental Hammam offers a traditional scrubbing ritual using black soap, a vigorous body exfoliation, and a nourishing mud wrap.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If a reserved and paid appointment is cancelled with less than 24 hours notice, no refund is given. Reservations with Gift Certificates must be cancelled 6 hours in advance, otherwise the Certificate will be considered used.

Name: Sirene by Gaia
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Dubai’s J1 Beach, this Aegean-inspired beach club is the latest coastal concept from restaurateur Evgeny Kuzin and Chef Izu Ani.
The multi-zoned venue channels the spirit of the Greek islands, combining a Mediterranean restaurant with a swimming pool and lounge area.
The site features a 350-seat dining room and 300 sunbeds, while hidden bars and private cabanas offer a more secluded retreat.

Name: Kinara by Vikas Khanna
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within Dubai’s JA Lake View Hotel, this restaurant is the culinary outpost of Michelin-starred chef Vikas Khanna.
The kitchen reimagines traditional Indian home cooking, serving approachable yet inventive regional plates that highlight the raw beauty of authentic spices.
A vibrant spice market display at the entrance sets the tone for a meal featuring standouts like the Dahi ke Kebab.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Hutong
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Owned by David Yeo’s Aqua Restaurant Group, this Northern Chinese dining concept operates in major hubs including Hong Kong, London, and New York.
The atmospheric interiors pay homage to Beijing’s ancient alleyways with hand-carved wood paneling, dim lighting, and traditional architectural motifs.
Tables frequently order the Red Lantern, a signature basket of crispy soft-shell crab hidden under a mound of Sichuan dried chilies.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Hutong London: Cancellation is requested at least 24 hours in advance of your reservation or a cancellation charge of £35 per person for lunch or brunch bookings and £50 per person for dinner bookings will apply. Hutong New York: A credit card is required to secure your booking and a $25 per person charge will be made in the event of a no show or cancellation within 24 hours of your reservation time. Hutong Hong Kong: A HK$500 per person charge will apply in the event of a no show or cancellation within 24 hours.

Name: Al Maha
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Based on my research, I now have sufficient information to write the description. Key facts:
- Opened in 1999
- Part of Marriott's Luxury Collection
- Located in the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve
- 42 suites/villas, each with private infinity pool
- Spa, fitness center, jacuzzi, steam and sauna rooms
- Al Diwaan restaurant serving Arabic and Mediterranean cuisine
- Activities include camel treks, horse riding, wildlife walks, archery
- Arabian oryx roam the property

Al Maha, a Luxury Collection Desert Resort and Spa, opened in 1999 within the Dubai Desert Conservation Reserve, a 225-square-kilometer protected habitat for Arabian oryx and gazelles.
The resort comprises 42 suites, each with a private temperature-controlled infinity pool; facilities include a spa with sauna and steam rooms, a fitness center, and guided desert activities such as camel treks, horse riding, and archery.
Al Diwaan, the signature restaurant, serves Arabic and Mediterranean cuisine with views over the dunes; wildlife walks led by resident naturalists offer direct encounters with free-roaming oryx.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations are only confirmed on receipt of a deposit equal to one night's stay. Full pre-payment is required 30 days prior to arrival. Cancellation within 30 days of arrival - guests will be charged for one night's stay. Cancellation within seven days of arrival - guests will be charged for the total number of nights reserved.

Name: Carna by Dario Cecchini
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Eighth-generation Tuscan butcher Dario Cecchini brings his deep reverence for ethical butchery to this contemporary Italian steakhouse.
The kitchen follows a nose-to-tail philosophy, honoring the animal through sustainable, family-style sharing plates that feature both humble and prime cuts.
Standout dishes include the Chianti Tuna—pork slow-cooked in olive oil—and the charcoal-grilled Bistecca alla Fiorentina, often carved tableside.

Name: Dior Spa (Cheval Blanc)
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the Peter Marino-designed Cheval Blanc Paris, the Dior Spa serves as the fashion house's dedicated wellness outpost in the French capital.
The facility provides a range of skincare and body treatments across six private suites, utilizing the brand's signature product lines.
The subterranean space centers around a 30-meter indoor swimming pool lined with iridescent mosaics.

Name: Emirates Golf Club Majlis Course
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by Karl Litten in 1988 as the Middle East’s first grass course, this Dubai venue hosts the annual Dubai Desert Classic.
The challenging par-72 track winds through natural rolling dunes and native vegetation, offering a stark contrast to the surrounding urban development.
Its signature par-four eighth hole demands a Cape-style tee shot played directly against a dramatic backdrop of the modern city skyline.

Name: CÉ LA VI
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Selected by the Michelin Guide, this rooftop venue atop the Address Sky View hotel is led by Executive Chef Howard Ko.
The multi-concept space features a restaurant, sky bar, and club lounge, offering contemporary Asian cuisine on a wraparound terrace.
Signature plates such as wagyu beef tartare with salmon roe are served against a direct backdrop of the Burj Khalifa.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Credit card details are used to secure your reservation. A cancellation/no-show fee of SGD $50.00 per guest applies if the reservation is not canceled at least 24 hours in advance. Cancellations must be made via the confirmation email. For reservations with deposits, strictly no refund for any cancellations or date amendments once the deposit has been made; deposits paid will be given as credit if canceled at least 72 hours prior to the reservation.

Name: 3Fils
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Overlooking the water at Jumeirah Fishing Harbour, this homegrown, no-reservations favorite is widely recognized as one of Dubai’s most accomplished casual dining destinations.
The kitchen serves premium Asian-influenced small plates without pretension, a formula that earned the venue a Michelin Bib Gourmand and the top spot on the inaugural MENA’s 50 Best Restaurants list.
A standout order is the signature Toro Croissant, featuring slices of bluefin tuna and caviar atop a crisp, buttery pastry.

Name: Brasserie Boulud
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Sofitel Dubai The Obelisk, this modern venue by Chef Daniel Boulud presents French gastronomy to the Middle East.
The kitchen refines rustic classics, balancing the casual energy of a Lyonnais bouchon with the polish of a grand hotel.
An open kitchen serves signatures like duck confit and escargots, while the marble flooring features patterns referencing the temples of Luxor.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Moonrise
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in St. Louis’s Delmar Loop, this boutique hotel is the project of owner Joe Edwards, a key figure in the area's revitalization.
The interiors display a distinct cosmic theme, housing the Eclipse Restaurant and cases filled with space memorabilia from Edwards’ personal collection.
A massive, rotating moon sculpture anchors the rooftop garden bar, serving as a beacon above the city skyline.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Full prepayment is required. Refunds and reschedules are available up to 5 days prior to the booking date. Reschedules within 5 days of the reservation are subject to a rescheduling fee of AED 500 per seat. Reschedules can only be made prior to the reservation time; no-shows cannot be rescheduled.

Name: Chez Wam
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by Chef Hadrien Villedieu and RIKAS Hospitality Group, this modern venue resides within the St. Regis Gardens on Palm Jumeirah.
The concept—French slang for "at my place"—evokes a dinner party atmosphere with a central open kitchen and curated music.
Secure a seat at the Chef’s Table to watch the team prepare signature plates like the foie gras bao buns.

Name: Mercury Rooftop
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched atop the Four Seasons Resort Dubai at Jumeirah Beach, this open-air lounge commands views over the Arabian Gulf and the downtown skyline.
The space channels a celestial theme with interiors by the Sundukovy Sisters, pairing Mediterranean plates with a high-energy, late-night atmosphere.
A signature "cosmic" cocktail list complements the venue’s defining feature: an unobstructed, 180-degree vista that frames the Burj Khalifa against the night sky.

Name: Il Ristorante - Niko Romito
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within Bulgari Hotels, this dining concept is curated by Abruzzese chef Niko Romito, bringing his three-Michelin-star precision to a global stage.
The menu presents a codified canon of contemporary Italian cuisine, distilling classic recipes to their absolute essence through rigorous technique rather than nostalgia.
Signature plates like the Spaghetti al Pomodoro reveal complex extraction methods behind apparent simplicity, set against sleek interiors by Antonio Citterio Patricia Viel.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations made within 48 hours of your booking will be subject to a 100% cancellation fee.

Name: The Arts Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within DIFC’s ICD Brookfield Place, this first international outpost of the historic London club features eclectic interiors by Milan-based Dimorestudio.
The four-story venue hosts a collection of restaurants and lounges, including a late-night club and a library, connected by a central sculptural staircase.
A 23,000-square-foot rooftop terrace anchors the experience, offering members a cigar lounge, outdoor dining, and direct views of the Burj Khalifa.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Refunds in respect of any events, private parties and for business events booked by any Members will be governed by the relevant contract entered into between the relevant Member and the Club. In the event that such contract does not contain any provision(s) in respect of refunds, the refunds will only be made if cancellation is received by the office of the Secretary at least 48 hours before the relevant event. Cancellations within 24 hours of the reservation date may be subject to a cancellation fee as determined by the Company from time to time. Online bookings can be modified or cancelled up to 24 hours before the reserved time.

Name: Billionaire
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Formula One mogul Flavio Briatore, this dinner-show venue anchors the Taj Dubai with a blend of Italian heritage and nocturnal hedonism.
The space functions as a theatrical dining hall where service meets avant-garde performance art, transitioning seamlessly from restaurant to late-night club.
Guests dine on a dual menu of modern Japanese and Italian dishes—think wagyu cuts alongside truffle pizza—while watching a spectacle of acrobats and singers.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: The holding time of the reserved table is 20 minutes, thereafter the reservation is automatically cancelled.

Name: Jun's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Boulevard, Jun’s is the flagship Dubai restaurant from third-generation Chinese-Canadian chef Kelvin Cheung.
The kitchen defines "third-culture" cooking, blending North American comfort food with Asian techniques and Indian flavors to reflect the chef’s global upbringing.
Signature plates like the Rainbow Heirloom Carrots arrive in a sleek dining room with direct views of the Burj Khalifa.

Name: Paus Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by sisters Sophiya and Sarah Faizal in Dubai’s Umm Suqeim, this wellness hub transforms a residential villa into a sanctuary for community and slow living.
The minimalist, earth-toned design fosters a philosophy of mindful pausing, with fluid transitions between movement studios, a nourishment-focused café, and recovery zones.
The venue balances active engagement with deep rest, offering social Padel courts alongside infrared saunas and a "Creator’s Club" for creative upskilling.

Name: AEON Clinic
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated within Dubai’s Atlantis The Royal, AEON Clinic is a regenerative medicine and longevity centre designed by ODG Architects.
The facility merges clinical precision with hospitality, providing multidisciplinary therapies that extend from functional medicine to advanced aesthetics.
Signature protocols include stem-cell therapy, ozone treatments, and hyperbaric oxygen chambers housed in a discrete 6,800-square-foot space.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: AEON requests at least 24 hours' notice for cancellations or rescheduling.

Name: Manao
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Dubai’s Wasl Vita, Manao is a Michelin-starred Thai restaurant led by chefs Abhiraj Khatwani and Mohamad Orfali.
The kitchen presents a modern, inventive take on regional Thai cuisine within a sleek, minimalist setting that avoids traditional tropes.
An eleven-course tasting menu anchors the offering, featuring dishes like grilled lobster and sticky rice roti that reflect the chefs' distinct culinary perspectives.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: La Cantine du Faubourg
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Brought to Dubai by creators Pierre Pirajean and Helena Paraboschi, this lively venue in Jumeirah Emirates Towers channels the spirit of their original Parisian address.
The space functions as a multi-sensory "artistic rendezvous," blending modern French cuisine with curated music, video installations, and a bold graphic aesthetic.
Order the signature yellowfin tuna ceviche or honey-glazed wagyu short ribs while seated on the leafy, open-air garden terrace.

Name: Leña
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Leña is a sophisticated steakhouse by acclaimed chef Dani García, with a Marbella flagship recognized for its award-winning design.
The experience centers on the primal allure of fire, set within a dramatic, dark-hued interior designed by Astet Studio that feels both ancient and modern.
A standout detail is the "Yakipincho" menu, offering Japanese-inspired skewers alongside premium aged cuts cooked over charcoal in the open kitchen.

Name: Armani/Ristorante
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the seventh floor of the Armani Hotel Milano, this Michelin-starred venue is led by executive chef Francesco Mascheroni.
The dining room is a study in restraint, presenting contemporary Italian plates amidst floor-to-ceiling glazing and a palette of muted metallic tones.
A table by the window offers a commanding view of the city’s skyline, framing the distant spires of the Duomo.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations within 12 hours of the reservation or no-shows are subject to a fee of $10 per person for lunch and $25 per person for dinner.

Name: Summersalt
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Summersalt is a beach club and dining venue situated at Jumeirah Al Naseem in Dubai, operated by the Jumeirah Group.
The destination pairs a refined open-air setting with a menu of Latin American fusion cuisine, shifting from daytime lounging to energetic evening dining.
A direct line of sight to the Burj Al Arab anchors the experience, accompanied by signature plates such as the lobster roll with spicy mayo.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: All reservations are subject to a 48-hour cancellation policy. Lunch bookings require a minimum spend of AED 250 per person. Table reservations are limited to a duration of 2 hours.

Name: Kyma Beach
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on Palm West Beach, this Greek-inspired retreat is a collaboration between RIKAS Hospitality Group and The St. Regis Dubai, The Palm.
The design evokes the Cyclades with earthy tones and macramé parasols, creating a refined sanctuary around the infinity pool.
Corporate Chef Gilles Bosquet’s menu features authentic plates like taramosalata and galaktompoureko, served against the Dubai Marina skyline.

Name: Ossiano
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within Dubai's Atlantis The Palm, this Michelin-starred destination is led by chef Grégoire Berger.
The subterranean dining room looks directly into the Ambassador Lagoon, framing 65,000 marine animals through floor-to-ceiling glass.
Berger’s narrative tasting menu features technical feats like sweet shrimp with jellyfish and green apple in a dill-infused seawater consommé.

Name: Al Muntaha
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched on the 27th floor of the Burj Al Arab, this Michelin-starred destination is helmed by chef Saverio Sbaragli.
The kitchen presents a sophisticated union of French and Italian cuisine, framed by panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf through angled glass walls.
Signature courses include a warm truffle salad and blue lobster, highlighting the team's technical precision and sourcing of premium ingredients.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Credit card details are required to guarantee reservations. A cancellation fee of AED 500 per person applies if the reservation is cancelled within 24 hours of the booking time or in the event of a no-show.

Name: Nobu Dubai
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched on the 22nd floor of Atlantis, The Palm, this outpost from Chef Nobu Matsuhisa brings his established Japanese-Peruvian style to a commanding vantage point.
The venue features a sprawling terrace and skyline vistas that complement the interior's sleek décor and low-lit atmosphere.
The menu relies on proven classics, most notably the miso-marinated black cod and yellowtail sashimi with jalapeño, served alongside premium wagyu beef.

Name: Cinq Mondes
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within Raffles The Palm Dubai, this wellness destination by French brand Cinq Mondes is a double winner at the 2025 Fact Spa & Wellness Awards.
The space includes 23 treatment rooms, two private suites, and a traditional hammam, utilizing advanced hydraulic and ozone-controlled air technology.
Its centerpiece is the Middle East’s largest indoor swimming pool, while the menu highlights signature rituals like the Japanese Ko Bi Do facial.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: You can cancel or postpone your appointment up to 48 hours before the scheduled date by contacting the Spa where you booked. After this time, we will not be able to accept cancellations or postponements. However, if you are ill, you will be able to cancel your appointment at any time as long as you present medical proof.

Name: Dubai Harbour Yacht Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated between Palm Jumeirah and Dubai Marina, this maritime hub was designed by AMA studio to anchor the region's largest marina.
The structure is defined by a curving steel-finned roof and expansive glass walls that frame the surrounding waterfront and skyline.
Its interiors host L’Amo Bistro del Mare, where Italian seafood is served against a backdrop of superyachts and Ain Dubai.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Pierchic
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched at the end of a private pier at Jumeirah Al Qasr, this Italian restaurant is helmed by Chef Beatrice Segoni.
The dining room extends over the Arabian Gulf, serving seafood-focused Italian dishes defined by fresh ingredients and contemporary technique.
Order the signature handmade pasta, best enjoyed against the direct backdrop of the Burj Al Arab.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Credit card hold required. Late cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows are subject to a fee of $25 per person. Premium tables and special events require a non-refundable deposit.

Name: Nammos Dubai
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located at the Four Seasons Resort Jumeirah, this beachside venue is the Dubai outpost of the Mykonos original, operated by ADMO Lifestyle Holding.
Designed by Elastic Architects, the space evokes Cycladic minimalism, pairing a sun-drenched Mediterranean atmosphere with a spirited dining room.
Signature plates like the aubergine mille-feuille and spicy crab tartare arrive before the tempo rises and guests inevitably take to the tables.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We operate with a 24-hour cancellation policy. For late cancellations or no-shows, a penalty of €50.00 per person applies to the card provided at the time of booking.

Name: Gaia
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Consistently honored by the World Travel Awards, this adults-only enclave sits atop a coastal ridge in Manuel Antonio, Costa Rica.
The design integrates tropical modernism with a private nature reserve, featuring terraced suites and polished stone interiors that frame the surrounding rainforest.
A standout detail is the on-site scarlet macaw reintroduction program, best observed from the three-tiered infinity pool overlooking the Pacific.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: All reservations are subject to a 24 hours cancellations policy. Late cancellation or failure to show will occur in a charge of AED250 per person.

Name: Flamingo Room by tashas
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Created by restaurateur Natasha Sideris and designed by Neydine Bak, this dining destination evokes African glamour through a lens of Miami Art Deco.
The space is defined by its blush-pink palette and whimsical detailing, offering a sophisticated backdrop for contemporary international cuisine.
A meal here is best anchored by the signature Calamari Mozambique or the house cocktail, finished with a delicate edible flamingo.

Name: Kokoro Dubai
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Ranked No. 15 on MENA's 50 Best Restaurants list, Kokoro is a Japanese hand roll bar brought to Dubai's Alserkal Avenue by chefs Daniel Lee and Patrick Pham.
The intimate counter dining setup focuses on made-to-order sushi, classical nigiri, and composed crudo dishes.
Diners watch as chefs assemble the signature hand rolls, passing the crisp creations directly across the bar for immediate consumption.

Name: French Riviera Beach
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on the private sands of Jumeirah Al Qasr in Dubai, French Riviera Beach serves as the al fresco counterpart to Chef Kim Joinié-Maurin’s restaurant.
The space evokes the south of France with a white-and-blue colour palette and a culinary focus on Mediterranean flavours prepared with French technique.
Tables offer clear sightlines of the neighbouring Burj Al Arab, providing a distinct architectural backdrop to the daily lunch and dinner service.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Berenjak Dubai
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Dar Wasl, this is the first overseas outpost of Kian Samyani’s Michelin Bib Gourmand-winning Persian restaurant from London.
The atmospheric dining room features opulent chandeliers and patterned tiles, serving a menu of charcoal-grilled meats and classic mazeh.
Order the signature Taftoon bread, baked fresh with a 24-year-old sourdough starter, to pair with the smoky kashk bademjoon.

Name: Indego by Vineet
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Grosvenor House hotel, this contemporary Indian restaurant is the Dubai outpost of acclaimed Michelin-starred chef Vineet Bhatia.
The sophisticated dining room features an open kitchen and a terrace with marina views, serving a modern evolution of regional classics.
A unique design element sees the walls lined with handcrafted leather mojiris—ceremonial shoes—threaded with gold and silver.

Name: Armani/Privé
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the Armani headquarters on Via Manzoni, this nightclub is personally designed by Giorgio Armani.
The interior defines a geometric aesthetic with a monochromatic palette of warm gold, bronze, and dark leather.
A signature feature is the backlit textured walls and lantern-like lighting that cast a soft, flattering glow over the central dance floor.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Avli by tashas
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Dubai’s DIFC, this refined Greek dining concept is the work of restaurateur Natasha Sideris and her Tashas Group.
The space channels the spirit of Athens with interiors reminiscent of rustic Mediterranean courtyards, blending ancient soul with contemporary design.
Signature plates like the lemonato baby chicken or sea bass baked in vine leaves are best enjoyed in the cavernous, sandstone-hued dining room.

Name: Al Iwan
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within the Burj Al Arab’s soaring atrium, this venue is the hotel’s showcase for traditional Arabian cuisine.
Appropriately named "The Royal Hall," the space features heavy gold columns and rich red textiles that frame a comprehensive buffet.
Tables are set against the backdrop of the world’s tallest atrium, offering views of the Persian Gulf alongside live cooking stations preparing fresh mezze.

Name: Hōseki
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within the Bulgari Resort Dubai, Hōseki is an intimate dining destination helmed by sixth-generation sushi master Masahiro Sugiyama.
The minimalist space functions as a culinary "jewel box," offering a bespoke Omakase menu dictated entirely by the day's freshest imports from Japan.
Guests arrive through a traditional Tokonoma entryway to find a singular Hinoki wood counter framing views of the glittering city skyline.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Hōseki maintains a strict 10 minute grace period for all reservations. Reservations are required.

Name: FZN
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within Atlantis, The Palm, this intimate dining room is the Dubai outpost of celebrated Swedish chef Björn Frantzén.
The tasting menu presents a seamless fusion of Nordic gastronomy, Japanese precision, and classic French technique.
A standout course is the signature råraka—a crispy potato cylinder with roe—served in a setting defined by pale wood and minimalist design.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations made within 72 hours of the reservation will be charged the prepayment fee of 50%.

Name: Bull & Bear
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the Waldorf Astoria Orlando, this steakhouse is helmed by Chef de Cuisine Juan Suarez as a modern outpost of the Manhattan original.
The club-like dining room overlooks the resort’s golf course and emphasizes tableside preparation, blending traditional service with re-imagined classics.
Signature orders include the Fried Chicken and the Pasta Explosion, served alongside the Chateaubriand carved tableside.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If you’ve made a reservation and wish to cancel, you may cancel at no penalty up to 24 hours prior excluding holidays or special events. If you cancel after your 24-hour window, you will be subject to a cancellation fee of $25 per person. We have a 15 minute grace period.

Name: CLAP
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a rooftop in DIFC, this contemporary Japanese restaurant is the Dubai outpost from the Beirut-born Addmind group.
The venue features a dining room, lounge, and bar, serving a menu that merges traditional techniques with modern flavors.
A chandelier composed of 2,100 toys hangs at the entrance, a playful design detail that contrasts with the skyline views.

Name: Mimi Kakushi
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Four Seasons Resort Dubai, this Japanese dining room is designed by Pirajean Lees and led by chefs Vladimir Kim and Gilles Bosquet.
The interior channels 1920s Osaka with intricate wood joinery and beaded curtains that reference the "Moga" modern girl movement.
Menu highlights include wagyu foie gras gyozas and marinated black cod, served from an open kitchen accompanied by a curated jazz soundtrack.

Name: Cape Morris
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Cape Morris is a secluded private island sanctuary in Dubai’s World Islands, managed by the team behind the Burj Al Arab.
The destination serves as a dedicated day retreat, defined by its pristine isolation and high-touch service on the sands of the Arabian Gulf.
Visitors arrive by a 64-foot yacht for a day of stone therapy rituals and dining curated by Michelin-starred chef Saverio Sbaragli.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: This offer is non-refundable and non-cancellable.

Name: Langosteria
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Enrico Buonocore in Milan, this seafood specialist has evolved from a compact bistro into a respected brand with outposts in Paris and St. Moritz.
The dining room eschews white-tablecloth formality for a moody, club-like atmosphere where the kitchen focuses strictly on sourcing the highest quality raw fish and shellfish.
Order the signature King Crab alla Catalana, served in a labyrinth of intimate, dimly lit rooms lined with floor-to-ceiling wine bottles.

Name: Soul Kitchen
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Brought to Dubai’s Business Bay by Beirut-based collective Factory People, this venue marries a restaurant and bar with an alternative arts space.
The menu weaves together Levantine and Latin American flavours—dubbed "Lela cuisine"—reflecting the Arab diaspora in South America within a design-led setting.
A standout dish is the white fish tabbouleh, which reimagines a regional classic with a fresh, textural twist typical of the kitchen's cross-cultural approach.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: The deposit paid when making the reservation will be deducted from the bill. We ask that any cancellation to your reservation be made no less than 24 hours prior. For no shows or late cancellations, you will be subject to a fee of 25,- euro per person. Soulkitchen reserves the right to cancel the reservation without any form of refund if the group is not complete within 30 minutes after the reserved time.

Name: Kulm Pizzeria
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within the Kulm Hotel St. Moritz, this GaultMillau-rated venue offers a relaxed counterpoint to the property’s formal dining halls.
The bustling space operates as an upscale trattoria, serving a straightforward menu of authentic Italian classics and rustic staples.
A wood-fired oven anchors the kitchen, turning out signature crispy pizzas that are best enjoyed on the sun terrace overlooking the lake.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: The amount of the fee will be communicated at the time of reservation and will be charged if the guest fails to show up for the booked reservation without notifying the hotel at least 24 hours prior to the reservation time. The no-show fee will be charged to the credit card provided by the guest at the time of booking.

Name: Kulm Country Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a historic pavilion renovated by Lord Norman Foster, this St. Moritz destination is helmed by Michelin-starred chef Mauro Colagreco.
The relaxed dining room and sun terrace offer a "Mountain Terroir" menu that blends local alpine ingredients with the chef’s Argentine roots.
A standout feature is the open-fire Asado, where meats are grilled over flames and served alongside views of the Olympic ice rink.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: The hotel will hold the reserved table for up to 15 minutes after the confirmed reservation time. A no-show fee applies if the guest fails to show up without notifying the hotel at least 24 hours prior to the reservation time. The fee amount is communicated at the time of reservation and charged to the credit card provided at booking. For early seating (e.g., 19:00), tables must be returned by 20:45.

Name: Secret Room
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Hidden behind F.R.N.D.S. in Downtown Dubai, this Moscow-born speakeasy is an exclusive nightlife destination operated by the Bulldozer Group.
The intimate, hip-hop-focused space is defined by six-meter walls adorned with intricate, hand-painted Japanese murals and raw concrete finishes.
A concealed entrance serves as the venue's signature feature, allowing VIP guests to drive their supercars directly into the center of the club.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: ALL DEPOSITS made via the Secret Parties website are strictly non-refundable. For cancellations please email us at bookings@secret-parties.com with full details of your cancellation so that we can handle it accordingly.

Name: Provocateur
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in Berlin’s Charlottenburg district, this Design Hotels member was conceived by interior designer Saar Zafrir to evoke the glamour of 1920s Paris.
The property distinguishes itself with a burlesque-inspired aesthetic, featuring rooms draped in crushed velvet, dark hues, and intricate stucco details.
A standout feature in every room is the "Provocateur Mode" switch, which instantly dims the lights and sets a mood consistent with the hotel's nocturnal spirit.

Name: Smoked Room
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Hidden inside the Leña steakhouse in Madrid, this "fire omakase" enclave is the two-Michelin-starred creation of chef Dani García.
The fourteen-seat counter focuses entirely on the transformative power of embers, with chefs preparing every course over charcoal grills in full view of guests.
The tasting menu features dishes like Motril shrimp with brown butter and smoked pepper, highlighting the kitchen's mastery of temperature and smoke.

Name: Twiggy by La Cantine
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched on the Park Hyatt Dubai Lagoon, this Riviera-inspired beach club is the work of the team behind La Cantine du Faubourg.
Evoking the Côte d'Azur, the sun-drenched space uses soft neutrals and natural materials to create a relaxed, sophisticated atmosphere.
A 100-meter infinity lagoon lined with white sand anchors the venue, serving Mediterranean plates like sea bass carpaccio and truffle burrata pizza.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Chasellas
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Positioned at the gateway to the Corviglia ski slopes, this rustic-chic mountain outpost is an extension of Suvretta House, helmed by chef Robert Jagisch.
The atmosphere shifts from a casual daytime stop for hikers and skiers into an intimate, candlelit destination for refined gourmet dining after dark.
Guests gather on the sun-drenched terrace for midday classics before retreating inside for evening specialties like Wienerschnitzel and herb-crusted rack of lamb.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: You will be asked to cancel reservations you cannot attend at least 12 hours in advance. Reservations that are not attended but also not cancelled may cause blocking of your mobile phone number in the online reservation system or the respective restaurant can demand cancellation or no-show fees according to its general terms and conditions.

Name: Da Vittorio
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within the Carlton Hotel, this Michelin-starred outpost is directed by the Cerea family, who bring their Lombardy-based culinary heritage to the Engadin valley.
The dining room serves a refined iteration of Italian comfort food, prioritizing market-fresh ingredients and precise execution over avant-garde experimentation.
Service culminates with the tableside preparation of Paccheri alla Vittorio, a signature pasta dish tossed in a velvety tomato and cheese sauce.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Trump International Golf Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within DAMAC Hills, this championship venue is the work of Gil Hanse, the architect behind the 2016 Olympic Games course in Rio.
The links-style layout features rolling Bermuda fairways that navigate a native desert landscape, contrasting manicured turf with arid surroundings.
A massive, cavernous barranca forms the strategic backbone of the routing, creating significant elevation changes and a distinct visual anchor.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Teible
Master_Aurora_Insights: Located within the Jameel Arts Centre on the Jaddaf Waterfront, this seasonal dining concept and artisan bakery is led by Executive Chef Carlos Frunze. The Michelin Green Star-awarded kitchen adheres to a strict farm-to-table philosophy, sourcing nearly all ingredients from the UAE to create menus that change with the seasons. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame views of the creek, setting a calm backdrop for experimental dishes like the signature Beef Garum Tartare.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Maine
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Montreal restaurateur Joey Ghazal, this New England–inspired brasserie has evolved into a global destination with stylish outposts in Dubai, London, and Ibiza.
The interiors deftly balance the rustic warmth of an East Coast oyster shack with the clubby, velvet-trimmed polish of a European grand café.
A brimming raw bar anchors the experience, serving freshly shucked oysters and signature lobster rolls alongside a program of live jazz and cabaret.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A minimum spend of £100 per guest will be required to be paid in advance for all reservations in the Brasserie from 6pm during Fridays and Saturdays.

Name: The Nice Guy
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in West Hollywood, this reservations-only restaurant and lounge is a flagship project from John Terzian’s The h.wood Group.
The dimly lit, wood-paneled interior evokes a vintage mafia social club, blurring the line between a dinner spot and a nightlife destination.
A strict no-photos policy preserves the room's privacy, while the kitchen serves late-night lobster pizza and cocktails in flasks.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: SEVEN Wellness Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Originating in Dubai, this social wellness club merges high-performance fitness with a refined lifestyle offering, creating a sanctuary for physical and mental resilience.
The approach treats mental conditioning as equal to physical strength, pairing advanced athletic equipment with restorative treatments in a calm, open-plan layout.
A signature element of the flagship space is the indoor starlit pool, offering a dramatic yet tranquil setting for post-training recovery.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations must be made through the SEVEN+ app within the required timeframes: Classes: minimum 12 hours before start time; Wellness services: minimum 24 hours before. Late cancellations or repeated no-shows may result in booking restrictions. Credits are non-refundable and non-transferable.

Name: Café Belmont
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on Via Maistra, this intimate day bar by Silvano Vitalini operates as a discreet gathering spot in the center of St. Moritz.
The space combines a polished, cozy aesthetic with a focused offering of quality coffee, light bites, and an impressive selection of vintages.
Patrons particularly value the extensive champagne and wine list, which transforms the petite venue into a spirited hub for refined socialization.

Name: King's Social House
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within St. Moritz’s Badrutt’s Palace Hotel, this dining and nightlife venue is a collaboration with Michelin-starred chef Jason Atherton.
The space reimagines Switzerland’s oldest nightclub as a modern urban bistro that evolves into a spirited late-night destination.
Interiors feature large-scale murals by Swiss street artists Bane + Pest, creating a striking contrast to the classic alpine setting.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: In case of a no-show (i.e., the guest does not arrive for the booked reservation without prior notification to the hotel 24 hours before the reservation time), a fee of CHF 50 per person will be charged to the guest’s credit card provided at the time of reservation. The hotel will hold the reserved table for up to 15 minutes after the confirmed reservation time.

Name: The Surf Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Four Seasons Hotel at The Surf Club is a 77-room hotel in Surfside, Florida, set within the original 1930 members' club designed by Russell Pancoast, with new buildings by Pritzker Prize-winning architect Richard Meier and interiors by Joseph Dirand; it opened under Four Seasons in 2017.
The property includes a six-room spa with hammam, three pools, 40 day cabanas, a fitness studio, and 900 feet of beachfront with non-motorized watersports.
The Surf Club Restaurant is Thomas Keller's first Florida outpost, serving continental cuisine; Lido Restaurant offers Italian-inspired dining in the original ballroom; the Champagne Bar serves craft cocktails and a curated Champagne selection.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Standard reservations must be cancelled at least 72 hours prior to arrival to avoid a penalty. Cancellation and prepayment policies vary according to accommodation type; advance purchase and festive season bookings may be non-refundable. A credit card is required to guarantee the reservation.

Name: Alphütte Clavadatsch
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by the Hotel Schweizerhof St. Moritz, this converted cow shed sits high on the Suvretta slopes with commanding views of the Engadine lakes.
The destination combines a traditional timber-clad interior with a spacious terrace that serves as a prime vantage point for skiers.
The kitchen utilizes a wood-fired oven for crisp focaccia and pizza, though the signature Kaiserschmarrn remains the essential order.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Dal Mulin
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Centrally located in St. Moritz, this intimate bistro is operated by hosts Kathrin and Danijel Krasnic with chef Pietro Spotti.
The rustic, wood-paneled space offers a refined setting for Alpine market cuisine that emphasizes Italian traditions and high-quality produce.
A standout feature is the two book-sized wine lists, offering over 700 labels to pair with the signature veal-shank ravioli.
