Name: Avatara
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Dubai Hills Estate, this Michelin-starred vegetarian enclave is the work of Passion F&B and executive chef Rahul Rana.
The kitchen redefines Indian cuisine through a sattvic philosophy, eschewing onion and garlic to present pure, ingredient-driven dishes with a modern edge.
Interiors feature a dramatic, altar-like communal table where the sixteen-course degustation includes the signature Naivedhya, a holy offering that anchors the culinary narrative.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: To confirm your reservation, you will be requested to make an advance payment. A 100% advance deposit is required for bookings of 5 or more calculated at AED 750 per person. For all bookings, you must notify us of a cancellation or any changes to the number of guests at least 24 hours before your booking. Bookings canceled up to 24 hours in advance and secured with a deposit will be granted a 50% refund on the deposit. Bookings secured by an advance deposit will be held for 30 mins after the booking time if nobody shows it will be released with no refund.

Name: Sylvestre Wahid
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed inside the Hôtel Les Grandes Alpes in Courchevel 1850, this restaurant serves as the alpine stage for two-Michelin-starred chef Sylvestre Wahid.
The dining room contains only four tables and an open kitchen, offering a tasting menu that connects the Mediterranean Alpilles with the snowy Alps.
Guests experience signature dishes like the Roscoff crab in a setting designed to resemble a private residence rather than a traditional dining hall.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Beefbar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in Monaco by restaurateur Riccardo Giraudi, Beefbar is an international dining concept rooted in the global meat trade.
The restaurant sources cuts of American Black Angus, Australian Wagyu, and certified Kobe beef, serving them in spaces frequently designed by architectural studio Humbert & Poyet.
Its menu is divided into Leaf, Reef, and Beef sections, featuring signature items like steak frites with a house-made creamy truffle sauce.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Please allow for 24-hour notice if you wish to change or cancel a booking, otherwise the following charges will apply: 100% of the booking fee for non-shows, or cancellations made within 12 hours prior.

Name: Sisley Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Pointe Milou, this World Spa Award winner is a partnership between Hotel Christopher and French beauty house Sisley Paris.
The open-air design embraces the surroundings, with treatment rooms facing the Caribbean Sea so the sound of waves soundtracks every session.
Each of the five cabins includes a private terrace and outdoor shower, creating a secluded setting for the brand's signature Phyto-Aromatic rituals.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations or rescheduling requests must be made at least 24 hours in advance to avoid a penalty. Cancellations made less than 24 hours before the appointment will incur a charge of 100% of the treatment price.

Name: One&Only Spa at One&Only Royal Mirage
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by DSA Architects International with the intricate arches of traditional Arabian architecture, this spa sits within Dubai’s One&Only Royal Mirage.
The facility centers on a dedicated Oriental Hammam, featuring heated marble slabs, steam rooms, and plunge pools modeled after Moroccan bathhouses.
A distinct feature is the Pedi:Mani:Cure Studio by Bastien Gonzalez, a signature treatment room focusing on the medical well-being of the nail.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancelation of treatments less than 6 hours in advance and no show will be charged 100%.

Name: Secret Room
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Hidden behind F.R.N.D.S Grand Café in Downtown Dubai, this speakeasy-style club is an import of the renowned Moscow nightlife brand.
The subterranean interior features six-meter ceilings and walls adorned with hand-painted murals referencing Japanese Yakuza culture.
In a display of engineering and status, the venue allows privileged guests to drive their supercars directly into the center of the room.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For cancellations please email us at bookings@secret-parties.com with full details of your cancellation so that we can handle it accordingly. Please be aware that ALL DEPOSITS made via the Secret Parties website are strictly non-refundable.

Name: AWAKEN Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the KPF-designed Atlantis The Royal, this wellness destination features interiors by GA Group and recognition from the Forbes Travel Guide.
The facility anchors its holistic approach in a hydrotherapy circuit featuring a charcoal sauna and halotherapy salt room.
A standout feature is the Hammam Sensorium, where traditional purification rituals incorporate modern sound and light therapy.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations or rescheduling within 4 hours of the appointment time will incur a 100% charge.

Name: Ula
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on the white sands of Palm West Beach, this Mediterranean-inspired venue is the work of Solutions Leisure Group and Broadway Interiors.
The space channels a grounded, organic aesthetic with natural stone, rattan furniture, and an open kitchen that blends a beachside lounge with a relaxed dining atmosphere.
A sprawling tree anchors the central curved bar, serving as a focal point for a menu featuring clay-pot slow-roasted lamb and fresh seafood.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Our Ristorante requires a credit card to reserve. Cancellations will result in a per person charge of $50. Cancellation policy will also apply to cancellations due to COVID 19 and all health or travel related circumstances.

Name: CLAP
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in DIFC Gate Village, this contemporary Japanese destination is operated by the Addmind group and led by culinary director Renald Epie.
The space combines a main dining room with a rooftop terrace and Ongaku, a separate music lounge hidden behind a discreet entrance.
Interiors are defined by eclectic touches, most notably a central chandelier crafted from over 2,000 vintage toys and anime figures.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For individual reservations a charge of €50 per person will apply in case of no-show or cancellation within 24 hours of the reservation. All reservations require card details.

Name: Ling Ling
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Created by the Hakkasan team, this izakaya-style concept adapts the brand's Cantonese cuisine into a lounge format with locations in Mexico City and Marrakesh.
The venue prioritizes a social atmosphere, pairing small, shareable plates and craft cocktails with a soundtrack of curated electronic music.
A defining feature is the progression from dinner to dancing, supported by architectural elements like open-air terraces and sweeping views of the surrounding landscape.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: In case of no-show, a charge of $250 MXN per person will apply. Multiple reservations or joining tables are not permitted. A grace period of 15 minutes is allowed.

Name: Saké Restaurant & Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the heritage-listed Argyle Stores in Sydney’s The Rocks, this award-winning venue is the flagship of Hunter St. Hospitality.
The kitchen delivers a high-octane interpretation of contemporary Japanese cuisine, blending sustainable local seafood with bold, fusion flavours.
A theatrical finale is guaranteed with the signature Dragon Egg, a chocolate sphere that melts under hot caramel to reveal a core of mousse and crumble.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: During peak service times, we kindly ask for a credit card to be placed on file when booking, helping us minimise last-minute cancellations and no-shows. If a booking is cancelled late or guests do not attend, a fee of $50 per person may apply. For small groups, we request at least 4 hours’ notice to avoid this charge. For groups of 8 or more, we require a minimum of 24 hours’ notice. Please note that separate cancellation terms apply to private room bookings, which will be shared at the time of reservation.

Name: Nammos London
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by Joyce Wang Studio, Nammos London is a two-storey Mayfair restaurant and the first urban outpost of the Mykonian hospitality group.
The venue translates its Aegean roots into a Mediterranean menu, offering an all-day dining format that transitions into evening gatherings.
The ground-floor dining room features a muted palette of terracotta and stone, complementing signature dishes like Greek lobster and shrimp linguine.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We operate with a 24-hour cancellation policy. For late cancellations or no-shows, a penalty of €50,00 per person applies to the card provided at the time of booking.

Name: Catch Steak
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Brought to the Rockies by Catch Hospitality Group, this energetic outpost reinterprets the classic steakhouse near the base of Aspen Mountain.
The sleek, multi-level venue balances a polished atmosphere with a lively rooftop terrace offering sweeping alpine views.
Diners can order a flight of rare Japanese Wagyu before finishing with the signature Snickers Baked Alaska.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Free cancellation before 24 hours of your reservation. After that, cancelling this reservation may trigger a fee of $50.00 per guest.

Name: Prospect
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the ground floor of the Infinity Towers, this San Francisco restaurant is led by the team behind Boulevard, including James Beard Award-winning Chef Nancy Oakes.
The lofty, glass-walled dining room by Brand + Allen Architects balances urban polish with a warm, hospitality-driven atmosphere.
Regulars return for the signature Eden Valley Berkshire pork chop, a standout dish on the seasonally evolving menu.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72 hour cancellation policy.

Name: Petit Trois
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Chef Ludo Lefebvre brings his Los Angeles–based Petit Trois concept to the boutique MOLLIE Aspen hotel.
This all-day bistro presents traditional French cuisine in a space featuring a year-round heated outdoor terrace.
Diners can expect faithful renditions of onion soup and steak frites alongside a curated selection of French wines.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Dinner reservations require 12 hours' notice of cancellation to avoid a fee of $25 per person. Lunch reservations require 12 hours' notice to avoid a fee of $10 per person. Larger parties are subject to a 72-hour cancellation window. No-shows are subject to the same fees. A credit card is required to secure the reservation.

Name: 7 Tales
Master_Aurora_Insights:
This Japanese-inspired speakeasy on the 44th floor of Grosvenor House is a nightlife venue from chef Jason Atherton.
The interior evokes 1960s Tokyo with graffiti-covered walls by artist Gary Yong and a soundtrack of hip-hop and funk.
A signature Negroni Game invites guests to roll a custom die to win a complimentary cocktail from the dedicated menu.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Billionaire
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by former Formula One boss Flavio Briatore, this high-energy venue occupies the 61st floor of the Mandarin Oriental Downtown.
The "dinner show" concept pairs a dual menu of modern Italian and Japanese cuisine with live performances by acrobats, dancers, and singers.
Celebrity Chef Batuhan Piatti oversees the kitchen, where guests dine on signature dishes like salt-crusted sea bass or wagyu beef while suspended above the city skyline.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Bookings can be cancelled up to 24 hours before the reservation time. The price for no-shows and late cancellations is non-refundable.

Name: Drift Beach Dubai
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within the One&Only Royal Mirage and managed by Sunset Hospitality Group, this beachfront destination features refined architecture by Michael Dawson.
The airy, open-plan space channels the Riviera with soft blues and whites, prioritizing Provençal cuisine over loud parties.
Guests lounge by the infinity pool facing the Palm Jumeirah skyline before dining on signature dishes like the whole poached lobster.

Name: Casa Tua
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Miky and Leticia Grendene with interiors by architect Michele Bönan, this Northern Italian outpost operates as both a restaurant and private club.
The chalet-style space features walls clad in natural bark-edged siding and structural aspen trunks that support the roof.
A twenty-one-foot, 200-year-old chef's table anchors the dining room, serving as a communal focal point for the kitchen’s classic menu.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We offer a 15-minute grace period for all reservations. If you arrive beyond this grace period, we will accommodate you if possible, but this is at the discretion of the restaurant. Reservations are subject to cancellations and no-shows. A credit card is required to secure reservations, and a fee may be charged for no-shows or late cancellations. Reservations are released 21 days in advance.

Name: Perrotin
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the heart of the Dubai International Financial Centre, this contemporary art space is the Middle Eastern outpost of blue-chip gallerist Emmanuel Perrotin.
The venue distinguishes itself by presenting a roster of established international artists through curated primary-market exhibitions.
A recent highlight includes the What Remains installation by Daniel Arsham, which transformed the Gate Village Building 5 interior into a landscape of fictional archaeology.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: The entrance to the gallery is always free of charge and without reservation.

Name: Slice Of Italy
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Slice Italian Bistro anchors the dining scene in Snowmass Village, Colorado, serving as a vibrant gathering place for mountain visitors.
The atmosphere blends the comfort of a classic trattoria with the high energy of a premier ski destination.
Its strategic location at the base of the Village Express lift offers immediate access for après-ski rituals featuring hand-tossed pizzas and curated wines.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We'll do our best to cancel your order, but if the order is already being cooked by the restaurant, we may not be able to approve a cancellation. If you cancel your order, you may be charged depending on what stage the order was in when you cancelled.

Name: EPIK
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Meydan Grandstand, this expansive nightclub is a key addition to the portfolio of Sunset Hospitality Group.
The venue is defined by its focus on Khaleeji and Arabic entertainment, set within a cavernous space capable of hosting over 1,000 guests.
A kinetic ceiling serves as the visual anchor, manipulating light and motion above the central dance floor.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: All ticket sales are final. No refunds or exchanges will be given except in the case of event cancellation, rescheduling, or relocation by the seller, or as required by law. Name changes and resales must be processed through the official resale platform.

Name: Krasota
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in the Address Downtown Hotel, this immersive gastro-theatre is led by the White Rabbit team, including chef Vladimir Mukhin and art director Anton Nenashev.
The intimate twenty-seat circular room acts as a 360-degree canvas, synchronizing haute cuisine with digital storytelling to explore the concept of synesthesia.
A standout course presents black cod with plum, plated to mimic the stormy seas of Aivazovsky’s *The Ninth Wave* projected on the walls.

Name: Cinq Mondes Opera Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by the French wellness brand Cinq Mondes, this 500-square-meter flagship spa occupies a listed historical monument near the Opéra Garnier in Paris.
The facility focuses on holistic treatments and sensory rituals derived from traditional beauty practices across five continents.
Guests can use the traditional hammam before experiencing signature therapies like the Japanese-inspired Ko Bi Do facial massage.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: You can cancel or postpone your appointment up to 48 hours before the scheduled date by contacting the Spa where you booked. After this time, cancellations or postponements are not accepted, except with medical proof.

Name: Zouk
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the former Nightingale Plaza space in West Hollywood, this nightlife destination is a collaboration between Singapore’s Zouk Group and operator sbe.
The interior evokes the roaring twenties with geometric flooring, curved banquettes, and a jade marble bar top.
A state-of-the-art lighting system anchors the room, where guests dance beneath the venue’s signature Mothership chandelier.ONE
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Advance deposits are non-refundable unless cancellation is received by venue at least 96 hours prior 10:00 A.M. Pacific Time on booking date. Cancellations received less than 96 hours prior to 10:00 A.M. PT on book date will result in forfeiture of advance deposit. Processing and credit card fees are non-refundable under all circumstances.

Name: Spring Place
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on Wilshire Boulevard, this private club and workspace (now Arc Beverly) is directed by hospitality veterans David Gutstadt and Amanda Potter.
The destination blends the functionality of a creative office with hotel-grade amenities, featuring private suites, communal lounges, and wellness programming.
A standout feature is the expansive rooftop terrace, which provides panoramic views of the city and serves as a backdrop for open-air social events.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Members must provide a 30-day written notice to discontinue, pause, or change any membership type (prior to the next renewal date for annual plans). All memberships are non-refundable. Monthly memberships have a 3-month minimum term. A non-refundable initiation fee of $500.00 plus sales tax applies. For Conference Room bookings, cancellations must be made at least 24 hours in advance to avoid a 50% fee; no-shows are charged 100%.

Name: Dolce
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in South Kensington, this boutique nightclub occupies the site formerly known as Montezuma and serves a dedicated Chelsea and Kensington crowd.
The venue operates as a high-energy lounge that pairs house and hip-hop playlists with an Italian-influenced bar program.
Interiors are defined by a bold palette of red, pink, and gold, creating a vibrant backdrop for late-night cocktails and e-shisha.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Tickets cannot be exchanged or refunded after purchase. The venue reserves the right to refuse entry and refund ticket value.

Name: Jonathan Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a 1925 Renaissance Revival building in Downtown Los Angeles, this private club was designed by Schultze & Weaver, the architects behind the Waldorf-Astoria.
The interiors maintain a dignified air of old-school privacy, characterized by dark wood paneling and a rooftop terrace high above the city.
A visual highlight is the hand-painted ceiling work by Vatican-trained muralist John B. Smeraldi, adding an artistic legacy to the social setting.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: 24-Hour cancellation notice required. Late cancellations will incur a charge of the first night.

Name: Funky Buddha
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Established by founders Ryan and KC Sentz in Oakland Park, Florida, this brewery earned a World Beer Cup gold medal for its culinary-driven approach.
The facility features a spacious taproom where guests can observe the production floor while sampling a rotating selection of experimental draughts.
A defining highlight is the Maple Bacon Coffee Porter, a rich dark ale evoking a diner breakfast with notes of syrup and smoke.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Tours are by reservation only and must be requested at least five days prior to the desired event date with a non-refundable deposit.

Name: Tare
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by chef Michael Carranza, this Michelin-recommended omakase counter is discreetly situated within a nondescript professional building in North Austin.
The twelve-seat venue defies its office-park setting with a focused, Tokyo-style tasting menu that subtly incorporates Texan ingredients.
An unmarked entrance adds to the allure, leading guests from a corporate hallway into a serene, wood-paneled culinary sanctuary.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Las Ventanas al Paraíso
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within the Las Ventanas al Paraíso resort, this award-winning spa draws on the restorative traditions of Baja’s ancient healers.
The facility centers its "Four Elements" menu on earth, air, fire, and water, performing treatments in a solarium or flower-filled garden.
A standout Flor de Luna ritual employs a native pitaya and moonflower sugar scrub to exfoliate and hydrate the skin before a calming massage.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We kindly ask for notice of cancellation at least 24 hours prior to your appointment time. Cancellations made within 24 hours will be subject to a 100% charge.

Name: Equinox (Kensington)
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the City of London, this five-storey fitness club features interiors designed by architects Woods Bagot.
The setting is defined by vertically cut grey stone, European oak, and champagne metal accents across its training floors.
Distinctive elements include a dedicated hot yoga studio and a spa offering performance-focused treatments such as hydrafacials and sports massage.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: You may cancel or reschedule your Treatment up to 24 hours before the Treatment is due to start. You will be charged for the full cost of the Treatment if you cancel or reschedule with less than 24 hours' prior notice or if you fail to show up to your Treatment.

Name: Soholistic Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Tucked within the Ham Yard Hotel in London’s Soho, this wellness enclave is styled by renowned interior designer Kit Kemp.
The quiet, sound-proofed rooms provide a sanctuary for restorative massages and facials using botanical products from Temple Spa.
Beyond the treatment menu, the facility houses a rare hypoxic gym that simulates high-altitude conditions for advanced athletic training.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Should you wish to cancel or change your appointment, please contact Soholistic at least 24 hours in advance. Non-arrivals or cancellations made within 24 hours will be charged at the full amount.

Name: Well & Being Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated within The Hythe, a Luxury Collection Resort in Lionshead Village, this wellness retreat is operated by the Well & Being brand.
The sanctuary adopts an apothecary-style approach to rejuvenation, grounding its menu in the restorative properties of the surrounding alpine nature.
A signature Himalayan Salt Lounge features glowing salt-brick walls and comfortable loungers intended for post-adventure relaxation.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If you must reschedule or cancel any spa appointment, please notify the spa four hours in advance to avoid being charged for the service.

Name: Bulgari Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set across two subterranean levels in Knightsbridge, this Antonio Citterio-designed facility is one of the most expansive hotel spas in central London.
The interiors utilise Vicenza stone and teak to create a grounded atmosphere for Mauli Rituals and Augustinus Bader skincare treatments.
A 25-metre swimming pool lined with green and gold glass mosaic tiles serves as the visual anchor alongside a vitality pool covered in gold leaf.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations made with less than 12 hours notice will be charged full price.

Name: Dior Spa (New York)
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by American architect Peter Marino, Dior Spa operates as a dedicated wellness space within the Cheval Blanc hotel in Paris.
The facility integrates advanced skincare technology with holistic therapies, providing 48 distinct treatments across six themed suites.
A central feature is the indoor swimming pool, lined with handcrafted mosaics by Michael Mayer.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Should you need to cancel or change your appointment, please let us know at least 24 hours before the scheduled time to avoid being charged the full cost of your treatment. In the case of late arrival, we'll do our best to offer the same service, but if not possible, your treatment will be shortened accordingly.

Name: E by Equinox St. James's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a converted historic bank building in London's St James's, this private club from Equinox offers a highly specialized tier of fitness and well-being.
The experience centers on data-driven performance, where Tier X coaches utilize 3D body scans and metabolic testing to design individual regimens.
Members access a dedicated regeneration area with Hypervolt therapy and locker rooms equipped with heated floors and a laundry valet service.
Master_Cancellation_Policy:
You may cancel a booked class up to five (5) minutes before the class starts. If you do not cancel within this allotted time period or check in by the start of class, you will be considered as having “missed” your booked class. If you miss three (3) bookings within a thirty (30) day period, you will be prohibited from booking classes online for a period of seven (7) days.

You may cancel or reschedule your Session up to twenty-four (24) hours before the Session is due to start. You will be charged for the full cost of the Session if you cancel or reschedule with less than twenty-four (24) hours’ prior notice or if you fail to show up to your Session.

Name: Spa Montage
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by Swiss architect Mario Botta, this wellness centre sits on the shores of Santa Maria Bay within the Montage Los Cabos resort.
The minimalist structure focuses on holistic therapies using indigenous ingredients like damiana and agave to ground guests in the Baja context.
A central feature is the adults-only Serenity Pool, framed by geometric walls that channel the region’s desert light.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Spa services are reserved especially for you, so we ask that you give us 24-hours advance notice should you need to reschedule or cancel your service. No-shows, changes or cancellations made less than 24-hours before the start time will incur a fee of the full price.

Name: Bar High Five
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Hidden in a Ginza basement, this venue is helmed by Hidetsugu Ueno, a bartender recognized by the World’s 50 Best Bars.
There is no menu; instead, staff interview guests to craft custom cocktails that demonstrate precise Japanese bartending techniques.
A signature feature is the crystal-clear ice, which is hand-carved into diamonds or spheres to suit each specific glass.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We have decided to take NO reservations from this May 2015.

Name: Artha
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Priyanka Khanna, recognized as a Woman of Impact by Los Angeles Magazine, this members-only wellness sanctuary operates outposts in West Los Angeles and Studio City.
The facility functions as a comprehensive holistic retreat, balancing high-tech recovery treatments with traditional movement and meditation practices in a streamlined setting.
Signature amenities include a rigorous contrast therapy circuit and cryotherapy chambers, available alongside immersive sound baths for total mind-body restoration.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations made within 3 hours of the appointment time and no-shows incur a $25 fee.

Name: Conrad Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within the Frank Gehry-designed Conrad Los Angeles, this downtown sanctuary features interiors by Tara Bernerd & Partners.
The spa balances high-tech recovery with holistic relaxation, offering private recovery cabins and an infrared sauna.
For a signature result, the Stem Cell Exosome Facial combines LED therapy, microcurrents, and ultrasound to lift and brighten.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Should you need to cancel or reschedule your appointment, please provide 24 hours' advance notice to avoid incurring the full service fee.

Name: Spa Montage
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Spa Montage serves as the wellness anchor for Montage Hotels & Resorts, earning frequent Forbes Five-Star recognition across its North American portfolio.
The ethos draws from the surrounding landscape, utilizing indigenous ingredients and the Elements of Wellness framework to ground guests in their specific environment.
A standout offering is the Surrender experience, a fully customized ritual where therapists tailor every stroke and scent to the individual's immediate needs.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: 24-hours advance notice is required to reschedule or cancel. No-shows, changes, or cancellations made less than 24 hours before the start time will incur a fee of the full price.

Name: The Bulgari Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Based in the Bulgari Hotel Milan, this sophisticated venue is designed by architects Antonio Citterio and Patricia Viel to overlook a secluded private garden.
A striking black resin oval bar and floor-to-ceiling windows define the space, creating an airy backdrop for the city's fashion crowd.
The signature Bulgari Cocktail, a blend of gin, Aperol, and fresh juices, is best enjoyed on the terrace during the daily aperitivo ritual.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If you do not arrive within 15 minutes of your reservation time and do not contact us, your reservation will be automatically canceled. We do not take reservations after 15:00, so please come directly.

Name: Chuan Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within The Langham Huntington, this Forbes Four-Star spa anchors its practice in the principles of Traditional Chinese Medicine.
The menu focuses on balancing the five elemental forces through therapies designed to harmonize internal energy and physical tension.
Guests can experience the Chuan Muddy Elements treatment, which uses specific mineral muds, before relaxing in the meditative Dream Room.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: All cancellations and amendments should be done at least 24 hours prior to your booking. For group reservations of 4 guests or more, a 48-hour cancellation notice is required. Any late cancellations or no-shows will be charged the full amount. All packages are non-refundable.

Name: The Spa at Stein Eriksen Lodge
Master_Aurora_Insights:
This Forbes Five-Star sanctuary brings traditional Norwegian wellness practices to the slopes of Deer Valley within the celebrated Stein Eriksen Lodge.
The 23,000-square-foot facility centers on recovery with comprehensive hydrotherapy circuits that include hot and cold plunge pools, steam rooms, and saunas.
Signature treatments like the Stein’s Freestyle Massage specifically target muscle tension for skiers, while altitude-adjustment rituals aid acclimatization to the mountain elevation.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If you need to cancel or reschedule, kindly give us at least 24 hours’ notice to avoid any charges for the treatment, including gratuity.

Name: Golden Gai
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Hidden behind Shinjuku’s neon towers, this grid of six narrow alleys hosts over 200 tiny bars favored by Tokyo’s writers and intellectuals.
The ramshackle wooden structures preserve the chaotic spirit of a post-war black market, defying the city’s polished modernity.
Most venues seat fewer than ten people, accessed via steep staircases that lead to distinct, owner-curated worlds.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Peninsula Spa and Wellness Centre
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by Peter Marino, this subterranean wellness destination sits within the new Belgravia hotel near Hyde Park Corner.
The wood-panelled space offers a quiet, park-inspired retreat blending ancient holistic wisdom with modern science-led therapies.
A double-height chamber houses the 25-metre swimming pool, featuring mosaic landscapes and dynamic light panels that simulate the changing natural daylight.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A 50% cancellation charge will be incurred for any treatment or spa programme not cancelled at least 24 hours prior to appointment. Cancellation within 12 hours will incur a 100% charge.

Name: Third Space (Mayfair)
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by the eponymous London fitness group, Third Space is a comprehensive health club in Mayfair recognized for its award-winning personal training.
The facility focuses on advanced athletic performance, equipping its workout spaces with an Eleiko strength area, a Reformer Pilates studio, and a dedicated Wattbike zone.
Recovery spaces include a Himalayan sea-salt walled sauna and a steam room supplied with UV-treated fresh air.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancelled within 24 hours incurs 50% of the treatment price. Cancelled on the same day or no show incurs a 100% fee of the treatment price.

Name: One&Only Spa - Cape Town
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within One&Only’s global resorts, these wellness sanctuaries are often operated in partnership with renowned brands like Guerlain and Chenot.
The spas combine advanced scientific therapies with indigenous healing traditions, set within environments that range from lush rainforests to secluded coastlines.
At the Cape Town location, the facility sits on its own dedicated island surrounded by waterways, accessible only by a private bridge.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellation within 24-hours will incur a 100% charge.

Name: Peter Luger Steak House
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a massive brick warehouse in Ebisu, this is the first international outpost of Brooklyn’s historic Peter Luger Steak House.
The multi-story venue channels a classic American hall aesthetic with dark oak and high ceilings, serving USDA Prime beef dry-aged on-site.
Diners gather for the signature porterhouse steak, presented sizzling on a tilted ceramic plate with melted butter and the brand’s tangy sauce.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: “No show” reservations made online will be subject to a $40 per person fee if and only if the booking is not cancelled within 24 hours of the reservation date and time. This is NOT a deposit and is taken by a third party.

Name: Janu Wellness
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Azabudai Hills, this wellness destination is the dynamic debut from the Aman group, designed by Jean-Michel Gathy.
The 4,000-square-metre facility diverges from the operator's usual seclusion, prioritizing connection through group movement studios and communal hydrotherapy.
Guests access a rare thermal circuit featuring a Russian banya and Turkish hammam alongside a 25-metre lap pool.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations made within 24 hours of the reservation time will incur a 100% cancellation fee. No-shows are also charged 100% of the treatment price.

Name: Attendant Coffee Roasters
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Ryan de Oliveira and Bosh McKeown, this Fitzrovia coffee bar occupies a restored Victorian public convenience built around 1890.
The subterranean interior features original green floor tiles and a cast-iron entrance cage that frame the compact serving area.
Guests sit at individual booths fashioned from restored Doulton & Co porcelain urinals while drinking house-roasted seasonal espresso blends.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Please note that we strictly do not take any bookings in advance. We operate a first come first serve basis.

Name: Polpetto
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Modeled on a traditional Venetian bacaro, this Soho establishment was created by restaurateur Russell Norman to showcase the region’s culinary simplicity.
The intimate room features a stripped-back aesthetic and low lighting, setting the stage for a menu of cicheti and small sharing plates.
Signature spicy pork and fennel meatballs are the defining dish, served in a rich tomato sauce best paired with a Spritz at the zinc bar.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Mediterraneo
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Mediterraneo is a family-owned Italian restaurant located at 1260 Second Avenue and 66th Street in Manhattan's Upper East Side, offering Florentine and Tuscan cuisine.
Features include full bar with beer, cocktails, wine, gluten-free options, vegan options, dog-friendly patio, outdoor dining, takeout, and delivery services available.
Specializes in homemade pastas, wood-fired thin-crust pizzas, duck ragu, mushroom ravioli, gnocchi, crab meat pasta, rack of lamb, and Roman-style pizza with delicate crusts.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: There is a 10-minute grace period. If you’re running late, your reservation will be canceled and reassigned upon arrival to the non-booked list!

Name: Dishoom
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by cousins Shamil and Kavi Thakrar, this Kingly Street canteen pays homage to the fading Irani cafés of Bombay.
The detailed interiors channel a 1960s narrative connecting Bombay's beat scene with the cultural revolution of London.
Order the location-exclusive Methi Lamb Gosht, a fenugreek-spiced stew served with paratha, alongside the signature 24-hour House Black Daal.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For group bookings, a deposit is required which is refundable if cancelled at least 24 hours in advance. Tables are held for 15 minutes for late arrivals. Dishoom is primarily a walk-in restaurant, but reservations are available for groups of any size during the day and for groups of 6 or more after 6pm (with some location exceptions).

Name: 45 Jermyn St
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a corner of the Fortnum & Mason building in St. James’s, this brasserie designed by Martin Brudnizki serves a modern take on classic dining.
The room features burnt orange leather banquettes and a marble bar, while the kitchen delivers seasonal British dishes.
A signature caviar trolley is wheeled tableside and served with scrambled eggs cooked to your exact specifications.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Bluebird
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a Grade II-listed Art Deco garage on London’s King’s Road, this sprawling dining complex was transformed by Sir Terence Conran into a Chelsea anchor.
The light-filled interior preserves its industrial origins with soaring steel trusses, serving as a central social hub for the neighborhood’s residents.
A cobbled courtyard provides a setting for open-air dining, framed by the building’s white facade and original 1923 metalwork.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Lunch: $10 per person cancellation fee for cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows.

Name: Lowe
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in Dubai’s KOA Canvas community, this Michelin Green Star recipient is led by chefs Jesse Blake and Kate Christou.
The kitchen prioritizes sustainability and elemental techniques, utilizing an open wood fire to roast seasonal produce.
A central charcoal grill anchors the space and imparts a distinct smokiness to dishes like the signature sesame flatbread with burnt aubergine dip.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Christopher's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a Grade II listed building that once housed London's first licensed casino, this Covent Garden institution features interiors by architects De Matos Ryan.
A sweeping spiral staircase anchors the space, linking the street-level martini lounge to a high-ceilinged dining hall overlooking the theatre district.
The kitchen serves transatlantic staples like USDA prime steaks and a celebrated French toast, while the bar offers an extensive list of specialty martinis.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A late cancellation or no-show (24 hours or less) will result in a £35 per person fee. Deposits are required for specific dates and are non-refundable.

Name: The Eagle
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 1957 by 85 original members, The Eagle is a private alpine club situated atop the Wasserngrat mountain in Gstaad, Switzerland.
Modeled after the Corviglia Club in St. Moritz, the traditional Swiss chalet serves as a daytime hub for members gathering over long lunches.
A signature element is the club's mulled wine, served on a terrace offering panoramic views of the Bernese Alps.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Akub
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Chef Fadi Kattan and entrepreneur Rasha Khouri have established this modern Palestinian restaurant within a converted townhouse in Notting Hill.
The kitchen reinterprets traditional recipes through a lens of British seasonality, centering hospitality around the tawla concept of abundant sharing plates.
Signature plates such as arak-cured monkfish and short rib fatteh join a drinks list featuring Taybeh beer and cocktails mixed with Palestinian apricot leather.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations must be made prior to 4pm the day before the booking. Late cancellations or no-shows are subject to a cancellation fee (reported as £10 per person for lunch and £25 per person for dinner). Credit card details are required to secure reservations.

Name: The Piano Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by Soho Live Studios, this discreet jazz lounge occupies a narrow townhouse on Carlisle Street.
The space functions as a semi-private club, offering an intimate drawing room dedicated to nightly live performances.
Look for the unassuming black door to access this bohemian hideaway, where guests sip classic cocktails like the Twinkle.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations merely reserve a seat at no charge up until 7:30pm. Those reservations are pulled at 7:30pm. No prepayment or card-hold requirements.

Name: Blandford Comptoir
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Master Sommelier Xavier Rousset, this Marylebone bistro and wine bar brings expert curation to a neighbourhood setting.
The interior features counter seating and a menu of Mediterranean small plates designed to complement the extensive cellar.
A standout feature is the 250-bin wine list, offering rare vintages and champagne by the glass alongside dishes like the Sicilian prawns.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Lunch: £10 per person cancellation fee for cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Dinner: £25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations or no-shows.

Name: No. Fifty Cheyne
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Overlooking the Thames on Chelsea’s historic Cheyne Walk, this riverside brasserie is owned by Sally Greene and helmed by executive chef Iain Smith.
The dining room features sky-blue banquettes and an open grill, serving a menu that bridges modern British dining with Provençal influences.
While the upstairs cocktail bar is a draw, the signature scallop and langoustine with champagne sauce is a notable highlight.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Hummingbird Bakery
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Tarek Malouf, who earned an MBE for services to baking, this bakery originated in Notting Hill and introduced American sweets to London.
The daily selection features generous slices of layer cakes and pies that prioritize indulgent flavor over delicate European presentation.
The defining order is the Red Velvet cupcake, distinguished by its deep scarlet sponge and the brand’s signature swirl of cream cheese frosting.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Orders under £100 can be cancelled up to 12pm the day prior to collection or delivery. Orders over £100 can be cancelled up to 48 hours in advance.

Name: Café Alaïa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on the third floor of the Maison Alaïa flagship in London, this intimate café and bookstore is curated by creative director Pieter Mulier.
The modernist space evokes Azzedine Alaïa’s kitchen-table hospitality with a central aluminium table designed to encourage conversation among guests.
Enjoy a seasonal pastry from Claire Ptak’s Violet Cakes while browsing the rotating library of rare art books curated by Claire de Rouen.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Electric Cinema
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on London’s Portobello Road, this Edwardian venue is one of the UK’s oldest working cinemas and is now operated by Soho House.
The interior is defined by wide leather armchairs, footstools, and individual side tables for food and cocktails.
A signature feature is the front row, which offers double beds lined with cashmere blankets.

Name: Megan's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 2002 as a King's Road antique shop, this independently owned collection of neighbourhood restaurants has expanded across London.
The Mediterranean-inspired spaces are defined by a "magical" aesthetic of abundant fairy lights, macrame, and a famously dog-friendly policy.
Signature dishes like the Turkish Brunch feast are served amidst year-round blossom, a design feature that anchors the brand's romantic reputation.
Master_Cancellation_Policy:
For all bookings, tables are held for up to 15 minutes before being released.

For Group Bookings (tables of 6+):
All deposits and pre-payments are non-refundable but are transferable if moved within the same quarter with at least one month's notice.

For tables of 12+:
A £10 per person card authorization is required. A reduction in numbers within 3 days of the booking incurs a £10 charge per person. Cancellations on the day will be charged the full menu price.

Name: Buvette
Master_Aurora_Insights:
James Beard Award winner Jody Williams founded this gastrotheque in the West Village, with subsequent locations established in Paris and Tokyo.
The all-day venue blends the function of a café and wine bar, serving French-inspired small plates in a compact, antique-filled room.
A defining culinary feature is the signature steamed eggs, cooked to a unique texture using the steam wand of an espresso machine.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Buvette is primarily a walk-in restaurant, but limited reservations are offered online 14 days in advance. A cancellation fee of $25 per person is charged for cancellations made less than 24 hours prior to the reservation time (or by noon on the day of the reservation) and for no-shows.

Name: The Queen Adelaide
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in Shepherd's Bush, this revamped gastropub merges a classic drinking hall with a stylish dining room, earning acclaim from *The Infatuation* for its retro-modern aesthetic.
The interior is defined by a large open fireplace and an imposing, wall-sized portrait of the namesake queen that anchors the space.
The kitchen serves elevated British classics, with the shin of beef croquette and signature pies standing out as essential orders.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: £10 per head pre-authorisation, charged if cancelled with less than 48 hours notice or for no-shows.

Name: Wright Brothers
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Ben Wright and Robin Hancock, this London seafood specialist operates as both a wholesale supplier to the city’s best kitchens and a group of atmospheric restaurants.
The offering is defined by a rigorous sea-to-plate ethos, with shellfish sourced directly from the team’s own Duchy of Cornwall oyster farm.
At the Borough Market outpost, diners gather at high tables for signature dressed oysters and fish pies amidst the market’s bustle.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Sticks'n'Sushi
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in Copenhagen in 1994 by brothers Jens and Kim Rahbek and Thor Andersen, this concept is rooted in their half-Japanese, half-Danish background.
The menu pairs fresh sushi with grilled yakitori sticks, while the interiors reflect a sharp, minimalist Nordic sensibility.
A defining feature is the open charcoal grill, which produces smoky skewers that serve as a warm counterpoint to the delicate raw fish.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We operate on 15 minutes holding policy. Unclaimed reservations after 15 minutes may be released to accommodate other waiting guests. For groups of 7+ guests, a £20.00 per guest deposit is required to secure a booking. Sticks’n’Sushi holds a 24hr cancellation policy for table bookings of 7+. Deposits will be withheld if the guest number reduces within 24hrs of the booking. On special days such as New Years Eve and Valentine's Day, a £20 deposit per person is required, and the cancellation policy is 24 hours.

Name: Mino Brasserie
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Gifu Prefecture, Mino is a historic merchant town known for its UNESCO-recognized paper traditions and preserved Edo-period district.
The town is defined by its rows of traditional houses featuring fire-preventing udatsu walls and its enduring legacy of washi paper production.
A distinct highlight is the local fabrication of Isamu Noguchi’s Akari light sculptures, which are still hand-crafted here using bamboo and translucent mulberry paper.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Lunch: $10 per person cancellation fee for cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows.

Name: L'Escargot
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a Georgian townhouse on Soho’s Greek Street, London’s oldest French restaurant is currently stewarded by restaurateur Brian Clivaz.
The spirited institution defines itself with classic Gallic gastronomy served amidst eccentric, velvet-clad interiors featuring works by Warhol and Picasso.
Beneath the iconic neon snail sign, the kitchen delivers its namesake *escargots* swimming in garlic and parsley butter, a ritual unchanged for decades.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We ask that any cancellation or modification to your reservation be made no less than 24 hours prior. Failure to arrive for your reservation or late cancellations, you will be subject to a charge of £25 per person that will be applied to the credit card details you provided during the booking process.

Name: Khob Khun
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in San Francisco’s Inner Richmond district, Khob Khun is a family-run restaurant recognized by The Infatuation for its curries and traditional Thai staples.
The kitchen distinguishes itself with a morning menu that serves authentic regional dishes alongside Thai-influenced American breakfast fare.
Signature items include pandan waffles topped with coconut flakes and multiple variations of Thai congee.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: 45 Park Lane
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within the Dorchester Collection’s 45 Park Lane, this Mayfair bar features a cocktail program developed with chef Wolfgang Puck.
The interior channels a mid-century aesthetic with rich wood paneling, amber lighting, and a mezzanine vantage point overlooking the lobby.
A signature Negroni trolley rolls tableside, presenting five variations of the classic aperitif paired with bespoke fragrances.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Muranaka
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Tokyo’s Azabu-Juban district, Muranaka is a discreet tonkatsu specialist that draws a loyal following for its focused, unpretentious approach to deep-fried pork.
The kitchen exclusively uses high-pedigree meat from Yamagata’s Hirata Farm, coating it in a feather-light batter that preserves the cut’s natural juices and sweetness.
Beyond the signature loin cutlet, the meal is anchored by a deeply savory pork soup that many regulars consider the true highlight of the experience.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Golborne Deli
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Run by Georgi Proykov and Aleks Loncar, this Notting Hill establishment operates as a deli, wine merchant, and casual café.
The counter offers Mediterranean salads and pastries while shelves line the walls with artisan pantry staples and continental produce.
Regulars congregate at the large communal wooden tables for the signature scrambled eggs or to browse the curated wine selection.

Name: Mildreds
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Established by Jane Muir in 1988, this Soho institution now occupies an 18th-century townhouse on Lexington Street.
The kitchen delivers a globally influenced plant-based menu that prioritises robust flavour over worthy abstinence.
A perennial favourite is the forest mushroom and ale stew, served beneath a crisp pastry lid with smashed peas.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Group bookings: no-shows will be subject to a fee of £10 per person. Private dining: The deposit is refundable if booking is cancelled 48+ hours in advance.

Name: Rosa's Thai
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by chef Saiphin Moore, this restaurant evolved from a Brick Lane market stall to its first permanent site in Spitalfields.
The kitchen specialises in family recipes from Moore’s native Khao Kho, blending traditional Thai cooking with seasonal British produce.
The name was retained from the site’s previous occupant, a traditional English café, as the founders could not afford to replace the sign.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For groups of 9+ guests, credit card details are required to reserve the table. We don’t charge any deposits when making a reservation. The card will only be charged at £10 per person in case of a complete no-show or if the actual party size is less than half of the original booking. For other reservations, changes can be made online via the link in the email confirmation or by contacting the restaurant.

Name: The Lamb & Flag
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Tucked down a narrow passage off Rose Street, this historic institution stands as Covent Garden’s oldest tavern and a rare survivor of local gentrification.
The interior feels resolutely unchanged, offering a labyrinth of creaking timber floors and brass fittings that evoke a bygone era of unpolished hospitality.
Once nicknamed "The Bucket of Blood" for its bare-knuckle boxing matches, the pub famously counted Charles Dickens as a regular patron.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Chelsea Physic Garden
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 1673 by the Worshipful Society of Apothecaries, this walled enclave on the Thames is London’s oldest botanic garden.
High brick walls create a unique microclimate, allowing a vast collection of medicinal and edible plants to thrive in conditions rarely found in the UK.
Beyond its historic glasshouses, the garden shelters the largest outdoor fruiting olive tree in Britain.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Tickets are non-transferable and non-refundable. Tickets are only valid for the dates and times shown. You can arrive up to 30 minutes after your allocated arrival time. Children under the age of 16 must be accompanied by an adult.

Name: Pizza Pilgrims
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by brothers Thom and James Elliot, this Neapolitan pizzeria evolved from a street-food venture born from a six-week culinary pilgrimage across Italy.
The menu highlights slow-proved dough and Italian ingredients to create a soft and blistered crust that remains faithful to Naples traditions.
Interiors often feature the three-wheeled Piaggio Ape van which the owners drove 4,500 kilometers from the toe of Italy to London.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Argyll Arms
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Soho, this Grade II* listed public house features a celebrated 1895 interior designed by architect Robert Sawyer.
The long saloon is divided by mahogany and etched-glass partitions that form a sequence of rare, corridor-linked snugs.
Period details include the original decorative ceiling and bevelled mirrors, providing an atmospheric setting for a traditional cask ale.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: To cancel an online booking, just click on the link in your booking confirmation email and follow the steps. Please try to give us as much notice as possible.

Name: Granger & Co.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Established by the late Australian restaurateur Bill Granger, this all-day dining group operates bright, airy spaces across London neighbourhoods like Notting Hill and King’s Cross.
The atmosphere channels a relaxed Sydney sensibility with a focus on fresh, fuss-free plates served from breakfast through dinner.
A loyal following persists for the signature ricotta hotcakes with honeycomb butter, a dish that defines the kitchen’s enduring appeal.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Polpo
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by the late restaurateur Russell Norman, this Soho venue evokes the bustling energy of a traditional Venetian bàcaro.
The interior features a stripped-back design with exposed brick and tin ceilings, serving as an unpretentious backdrop for small plates and spritzes.
A consistent highlight is the signature spinach, soft egg, and Parmesan pizzetta, a crisp dish that perfectly represents the kitchen’s rustic simplicity.

Name: 123V
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within the Browns Brook Street flagship in Mayfair, this plant-based dining destination is helmed by French chef Alexis Gauthier.
The restaurant functions as a quiet retreat from the retail floor, serving a fully vegan menu that focuses on sushi and seasonal plates in a bright, modern setting.
A standout feature is the secluded evergreen courtyard, where guests can enjoy the signature sushi selection in a rare, open-air sanctuary.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellation of a booking within 48 hours of your reservation time will render the voucher null and void.

Name: Pétrus by Gordon Ramsay
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in Belgravia, this Michelin-starred restaurant by Gordon Ramsay serves modern French cuisine within a contemporary, circular dining room.
The kitchen executes precise dishes that marry classical technique with British produce, featuring ingredients such as native lobster and turbot.
A floor-to-ceiling cylindrical wine cellar anchors the space, housing an extensive collection that includes the rare vintages for which the venue is named.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: All bookings require card details to confirm your reservation. In the event that the booking is not honoured or is cancelled with less than 72 hours' notice a fee of £75pp for weekday lunch and £120pp for weekend lunch and all dinners will be charged to the card.

Name: The Ivy Victoria
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated near Victoria Station, this expansive brasserie is part of The Ivy Collection and showcases the group's signature maximalist interiors by Martin Brudnizki Design Studio.
The two-floor venue serves modern British classics and international favourites within a setting defined by colorful artwork, velvet banquettes, and polished brass.
A central feature is the pink onyx bar on the first floor, which anchors the room and complements the year-round outdoor terrace.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Duck and Rice
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a corner site in Soho, this polished gastropub is the work of Alan Yau, the restaurateur behind Wagamama and Hakkasan.
Istanbul-based studio Autoban designed the interior, layering the space with abstract geometric screens and blue-and-white floral tiles that reference Chinese porcelain.
Four glowing copper tanks of Pilsner Urquell anchor the entrance, setting the stage for a menu of Cantonese roast duck and jasmine-smoked ribs.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For groups of 8 or more a selection of set menus are on offer and a deposit of £20pp will be required.

Name: The Sea Shell
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Beach Haven on Long Beach Island, The Sea Shell Resort & Beach Club is a coastal fixture established and operated by the Reynolds family.
The destination is distinguished by its comprehensive resort layout, combining oceanfront accommodation with a lively pool deck and multiple dining concepts.
A concrete detail is the on-site tiki bar, a popular gathering point that sits directly on the sand and serves as the property’s social hub.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: No cancellation fee if cancelled 24 hours in advance.

Name: The Monro
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a Grade II-listed Georgian merchant’s mansion on Duke Street, this historic Liverpool landmark has been sensitively restored by the 1936 Pub Company.
The interiors return to a traditional aesthetic, defined by roaring open fires, original wooden floorboards, and a distinct absence of modern clutter.
Named after the first scheduled passenger ship to New York, the site features a year-round courtyard garden and a menu of reliable British staples.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Bombay Brasserie
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Established in South Kensington in 1982, this enduring venue is part of the Taj Hotels portfolio and operates under the guidance of Executive Chef Sriram Aylur.
The kitchen presents a survey of the subcontinent’s diverse culinary heritage, prioritizing regional authenticity over heavy-handed adaptation.
An expansive glass-roofed conservatory filled with tropical greenery offers a striking setting for signatures like the crispy spinach *palak patta chaat*.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We ask that any cancellation to your reservation be made no less than 24 hours prior. For no shows or late cancellations, you will be subject to fee of £25 per person that will be applied to the credit card on file.

Name: Tamarind
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Based in London's Mayfair, this landmark venue was the first Indian restaurant in the UK to earn a Michelin star.
The David D'Almada-designed interior features a sophisticated, light-filled dining room where the open kitchen serves as the focal point.
Guests can watch the chefs prepare specialties like the Pudhina lamb chops in the traditional clay tandoor ovens.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: All cancellations must be made at least 48 hours in advance for party size 7 guests and above, and marked for the manager on duty. In case the reservation is cancelled less than 48 hours from the reserved time, the credit card on file will be charged $35 per person in addition to the private room charges.

Name: The Punch Bowl
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Farm Street, this Grade II-listed Georgian pub was famously owned by Guy Ritchie and remains a discreet favorite among the city’s elite.
The interiors feature original dado panelling and leaded windows, creating a moody backdrop for a menu that refines traditional British pub classics.
A historic dog-leg staircase leads to The Club, a private dining room on the top floor that offers an exclusive Victorian-style retreat.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For all bookings, you must notify us of a cancellation or any changes to the number of guests at least 24 hours prior to your booking. We reserve the right to charge a cancellation fee of £15.00 per person for any bookings changed or cancelled within this 24 hour notice period. Any bookings which fail to turn up without any prior notice, will also incur a £15.00 per person fee.

Name: Som Saa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a Spitalfields fabric warehouse, this regional Thai spot is the permanent evolution of a celebrated pop-up by chefs Andy Oliver and Mark Dobbie.
The kitchen delivers uncompromisingly spicy flavors from the northeast, eschewing standard staples for punchy, complex dishes.
A signature deep-fried seabass with Isaan herbs anchors the menu at this venue named after a rare citrus fruit used in traditional cookery.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Credit card details are required to secure a booking. A fee of £10 per person applies if the reservation is cancelled with less than 24 hours' notice or in the event of a no-show.

Name: Temper
Master_Aurora_Insights: Founded by chef Neil Rankin, this London smokehouse is defined by its commitment to whole-animal butchery and live-fire cooking. The concept centers on a theatrical open kitchen where chefs prepare tacos and steaks over wood-burning grills. Counter seating offers a direct view of the butchery and cooking process, emphasizing a distinct nose-to-tail ethos.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Ninth
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Charlotte Street in Fitzrovia, this Michelin-starred neighbourhood restaurant is the debut solo project from chef Jun Tanaka.
The kitchen focuses on French-Mediterranean sharing dishes that combine high-end culinary technique with a warm and accessible bistro setting.
Meals here typically conclude with the famous pain perdu, a decadent caramelised brioche dessert that has earned a dedicated following.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations require 48 hours' notice. A fee applies for late cancellations or no-shows.

Name: The Blue Posts
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Restored by Layo and Zoë Paskin of The Palomar, this Georgian pub stands on the edge of Chinatown.
The building operates as a three-tiered destination with a ground-floor taproom, a first-floor cocktail lounge, and a Michelin-starred restaurant in the cellar.
While the main bar serves British ales, the standout feature is Evelyn’s Table, a twelve-seat dining counter located in the former beer cellar.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Guests are welcomed on a first-come-first-seated basis. We do not take table reservations.

Name: The Scolt Head
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Owned by siblings Rich Haines and Rosie Wesemann, this De Beauvoir establishment operates as a traditional local rather than a dining-focused destination.
The bright, wood-floored interior hosts a kitchen dedicated to British classics using produce sourced directly from small, independent suppliers.
Its distinct name references a small island off the Norfolk coast, a specific detail that underscores the personal nature of the project.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We are using a system of deposits for bookings of 6ppl or more. Nothing is taken from your card if you come & eat as agreed. £10 per head under 24 hours. £15 a head for a no show.

Name: The Enterprise
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in London’s Brompton Cross, this enduring gastropub serves as a lively social hub for the South Kensington neighbourhood.
The interior combines the warmth of a traditional tavern with a polished dining room, defined by dark wood panelling and leather banquettes.
Its distinct wedge-shaped structure hosts a crowd drawn to reliable staples like Jersey rock oysters and steak frites.

Name: The Ivy Chelsea Garden
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on King's Road, this all-day brasserie from Richard Caring’s Caprice Holdings transports the West End institution’s heritage to a relaxed Chelsea setting.
Martin Brudnizki designed the space with botanical prints and parquet flooring, centering on a substantial rear garden that mimics a private country estate.
A table in the orangery or near the stone fountains provides the ideal setting for the house signature shepherd’s pie.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Spuntino
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Denver’s Highland neighborhood, this intimate restaurant is the personal project of husband-and-wife team Elliot Strathmann and James Beard Award semifinalist Cindhura Reddy.
The kitchen bridges Italian tradition and Reddy’s South Indian heritage, applying from-scratch techniques to everything from hand-rolled pasta to house-baked bread.
A meal here concludes with a ritual pour from the extensive library of house-made digestivi, including unique amari crafted by Strathmann himself.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Late cancellation fee of $10 per person for lunch and $25 per person for dinner if cancelled within 12 hours of the reservation time. No-shows are subject to the same fees. Larger parties may be subject to a 72-hour cancellation window.

Name: The Jugged Hare
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Hailed as "carnivore heaven" by Hardens, this City gastropub from the ETM Group sits in the shadow of the Barbican.
The interior blends polished rusticity with a serious culinary focus, featuring red leather banquettes, taxidermy-lined walls, and a bustling open kitchen.
Its namesake signature dish is wild Norfolk hare, braised in its own blood and traditionally served in a tall jug alongside buttery mash.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For bookings up to 11 guests, please allow 48 hours should you wish to cancel your booking. No-shows or cancellations with less than 48 hours’ notice are subject to a cancellation fee which is the amount your card is held for at the time of booking. Your table will be held for 20 minutes; after this time, your table may be charged a cancellation fee and given away. For bookings of 12-20 guests, 7 days' notice is required, and for 20+ guests, 14 days' notice is required.

Name: The Ivy Market Grill
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on the edge of Covent Garden’s piazza, this all-day brasserie from Caprice Holdings features interiors by Martin Brudnizki.
The space channels a late 19th-century industrial aesthetic with tessellated floor tiles, antique brass chandeliers, and burnt-orange leather banquettes.
A menu of British classics anchors the experience, headlined by the group’s signature shepherd’s pie comprising slow-braised lamb and beef with cheddar mash.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: 48-hour cancellation policy, £20pp fee if canceled late. A non-refundable deposit for £10 is required per person for special events.

Name: The Fox
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Now I have comprehensive information about The Fox Hotel in Ponce, Puerto Rico. Let me write the three-sentence description.

The Fox is a 30-room boutique hotel in Ponce, Puerto Rico, housed in a 1931 Art Deco theater designed by architect Francisco Porrata-Doria and originally commissioned by the Serralles family as the Teatro Fox Delicias; it reopened as The Fox in December 2019.
The hotel features a plaza patio, bar, free Wi-Fi, and pop-art-influenced interiors with Warhol and Lichtenstein prints throughout; there is no spa.
Coffee House Bistro serves all-day breakfast and casual fare; the patio hosts rotating pop-up events with guest chefs and live music.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations must be cancelled 72 hours prior to arrival to avoid a penalty of the first night room rate plus taxes. In case of No-Show, the first night room rate plus taxes will be charged. No deposit is required for single reservations booked directly, but a credit card is required on file.

Waiters in traditional livery present dry-aged British beef and three-time award-winning steak and kidney pies to guests at white-clothed tables.
