Name: The Ivy Cafe Marylebone
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by Caprice Holdings, this neighborhood outpost translates the theatrical glamour of its West End parent into a more intimate, accessible format.
Martin Brudnizki’s interiors feature Art Deco details, antique brass, and polished marble floors that elevate the all-day dining atmosphere.
The menu’s enduring staple is the Shepherd’s Pie, a rich blend of minced lamb and beef topped with Wookey Hole cheddar mash.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Standard bookings can be amended or cancelled via confirmation email or text message. Group bookings are subject to a 48-hour cancellation policy with a £20 per person fee for late cancellations. Special event bookings require a non-refundable deposit of £10 per person.

Name: The Ivy Granary Square Brasserie
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Wimbledon Village, this all-day brasserie is part of The Ivy Collection and features interiors by Martin Brudnizki Design Studio.
The space combines Art Deco-inspired elements like an antique pewter bar and burnt orange leather banquettes with a secluded garden terrace.
The menu highlights British classics, including the group’s signature shepherd’s pie made with slow-braised lamb and beef under a crust of Keen’s Cheddar mash.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: 48-hour cancellation policy, £20pp fee if canceled late.

Name: The Little Yellow Door
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located off Portobello Road, this Notting Hill venue from The Little Door & Co is conceptualized as a fictional flat share.
The interiors mimic a lived-in home with an open-plan living room and kitchen, fostering a house party atmosphere that encourages mingling.
Playful details anchor the theme, from menus presented in photo albums to a downstairs den that hosts late-night retro gaming sessions.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Ivy Tower Bridge
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated within the One Tower Bridge development, this all-day brasserie from The Ivy Collection features interiors by Martin Brudnizki Design Studio.
The kitchen presents a broad menu of modern British classics and international staples in a polished, art-filled dining room.
A Parisian-style alfresco terrace offers diners direct views across the River Thames to Tower Bridge.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: 48-hour cancellation policy, £20 per person fee if canceled late.

Name: The Ivy in the Park
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 1917 and operated by Caprice Holdings, this West Street institution is the historic predecessor to the wider collection.
Martin Brudnizki’s redesign highlights Harlequin stained glass windows and a central dining bar within the oak-panelled space.
Waiters serve the signature shepherd’s pie to a crowd that regularly includes talent from the surrounding theatre district.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A cancellation fee of £20 per person applies to cancellations made within 48 hours of the reservation time or for no-shows. Credit card details are required to secure the booking.

Name: The River Café
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Ruth Rogers and Rose Gray in a warehouse adapted by architect Richard Rogers, this Hammersmith destination redefined Italian cooking in London.
The kitchen serves rigorously seasonal dishes in a bright industrial dining room that opens onto a garden by the Thames.
Famous as the training ground for Jamie Oliver, the menu is anchored by wood-roasted John Dory and the signature Chocolate Nemesis.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: You can modify or cancel reservations up to 5 days prior. Cancellations within 5 days of the reservation will incur the full $245 charge per person.

Name: Marksman
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Hackney Road, this restored Victorian public house is led by chefs Tom Harris and Jon Rotheram, both formerly of St. John.
The dual-concept space features a traditional wood-paneled taproom on the ground floor and a contemporary dining room upstairs designed by Martino Gamper.
Its menu is anchored by the signature beef and barley bun, a savory starter served with a dollop of horseradish cream.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Ivy West End
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 1917 and operated by Richard Caring's Caprice Holdings, The Ivy is a restaurant located in London's Covent Garden.
The pre-theatre destination features an art deco interior updated by architect Martin Brudnizki, retaining its original harlequin stained-glass windows.
The menu centers on traditional British comfort food, anchored by the restaurant's signature shepherd's pie.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If you already have a booking with us, you can amend or cancel your booking via your confirmation email or text message. For group dining, there is a 48-hour cancellation policy with a £20 per person fee if canceled late.

Name: The Elk
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the West Village, this specialty coffee shop and general store was founded by Vancouver native Claire Chan.
The space functions as a neighbourhood lifestyle hub, blending Pacific Northwest warmth with a curated selection of home goods and healthy fare.
A standout feature is the signature Market Bowl, served amidst interiors defined by whitewashed wood and industrial accents.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Harwood Arms
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Tucked away in the backstreets of Fulham, this Michelin-starred gastropub is co-owned by game expert Mike Robinson and Brett Graham of The Ledbury.
The kitchen champions a robust, game-focused approach to British cuisine, elevating traditional pub fare with technical precision and wild ingredients.
The menu is anchored by the signature venison Scotch egg, a crisp and golden snack served with a side of tangy Oxford sauce.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Credit or debit card details are required to secure all reservations. No charges will be made to the card, unless in the event of no-shows and cancellations within 24 hours of the seating time where there will be a £50 per person charge (This applies to all bookings, including those made shortly before the reservation time).

Name: The Hand & Flowers
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Marlow, this whitewashed gastropub is the flagship project of chef Tom Kerridge and his wife Beth Cullen-Kerridge.
As the only pub in the UK to hold two Michelin stars, it balances unpretentious hospitality with bold, refined British cooking.
The menu features the signature glazed omelette of smoked haddock and parmesan, illustrating the kitchen's skill with elevated comfort food.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Card details are required to secure the reservation. A cancellation fee of £195 per person is charged if you fail to turn up without notice or cancel within 48 hours of the reservation.

Name: The Ivy Soho Brasserie
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Broadwick Street, this all-day venue from The Ivy Collection offers a relaxed iteration of the group’s established dining formula.
Martin Brudnizki Design Studio outfitted the interior with a coral-hued onyx bar, polished parquet floors, and a collection of British art.
The kitchen serves the brand’s signature shepherd’s pie, a consistent favourite within a room illuminated by warm bronze lighting.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: 48-hour cancellation policy, £20pp fee if canceled late.

Name: The Kitchin
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a converted whisky bond on Leith’s waterfront, this Michelin-starred venue is the flagship of Chef Tom Kitchin.
The kitchen follows a strict From Nature to Plate philosophy, applying classical French technique to Scotland’s seasonal larder.
A glass window reveals the brigade preparing signature plates like boned and rolled pig’s head with langoustine.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Guests are required to provide credit card details at the time of booking to secure the reservation. A fee of £45 per person for lunch and £90 per person for dinner is charged for cancellations within 24 hours or no-shows. For bookings of 8 guests in the Main Dining Room, a 72-hour cancellation policy applies with the same fees.

Name: The Berkeley Café
Master_Aurora_Insights: Located within Knightsbridge’s The Berkeley hotel, this all-day dining venue offers a relaxed setting for menus featuring desserts by celebrated pastry chef Cédric Grolet. The interior is defined by soft curves and natural tones, providing an understated backdrop for delicate sandwiches and seasonal plates. The signature Goûtea is a French-inspired fusion of afternoon tea that showcases the kitchen’s architectural approach to patisserie.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Should you be running late for your reservation, please do call us 0207 235 6000.

Name: The Ivy Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located above the original West End restaurant, this private sanctuary is owned by Caprice Holdings and features interiors by Martin Brudnizki Design Studio.
The Art Deco-inspired space spans three floors of wood-paneled dining rooms and a piano bar, serving as a discreet retreat for the creative industries.
Members enter through a concealed door within a working flower shop on West Street, a signature detail that ensures privacy.

Name: The Ivy Asia Mayfair
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by The Ivy Collection, The Ivy Asia Mayfair is an Asian-inspired restaurant located in London's Mayfair district.
The kitchen serves a pan-Asian menu featuring sushi, sashimi, and large sharing plates such as crispy duck within a maximalist dining room.
The interior design is anchored by a signature illuminated floor crafted entirely from green semi-precious agate stone.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: The Ivy Asia (part of The Ivy Collection) has a 48-hour cancellation policy. A fee of £20 per person applies for cancellations made within this window or for no-shows. Bookings can be amended or canceled via the confirmation email or text message.

Name: BOA Steakhouse
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by the Innovative Dining Group and overseen by Chef Brendan Collins, this modern steakhouse sits just steps from the ocean in Santa Monica.
The kitchen focuses on prime cuts like the 40-day dry-aged New York strip alongside a selection of sustainable seafood.
A memorable highlight is the goat cheese baklava, a savory starter featuring black truffles, pistachios, and phyllo dough.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Lunch: $10 per person fee for late cancellations within 12 hours. Larger parties are subject to a 72 hour cancellation window.

Name: Beethoven Market
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a restored 1949 building in Mar Vista, this neighborhood spot is led by owner Jeremy Adler and chef Michael Leonard.
Designed by Tara Bean, the venue blends Italian simplicity with California ease through Roman plastered walls and a patio anchored by a mature olive tree.
A custom rotisserie fires the signature chicken, while the meal concludes with a scoop of tiramisu served tableside from a communal tray.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Sager + Wilde
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Michael Sager’s East London wine bar occupies a stripped-back former pub on Hackney Road.
The venue focuses on accessible fine wine and serves rare vintages by the glass alongside a simple seasonal menu.
A standout design element is the bar top crafted from reclaimed London paving stones where regulars enjoy the signature grilled cheese sandwich.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Dear John's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Revived by chefs Josiah Citrin and Hans Röckenwagner, this Culver City steakhouse preserves the spirit of its 1962 original, once frequented by Frank Sinatra.
The dark, wood-paneled dining room operates as a mid-century time capsule where tuxedoed servers deliver classic continental plates.
A theatrical tableside Caesar salad service stands out alongside the restaurant’s signature chicken parmesan.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations must be made a minimum of 48 hours prior to your reservation time or a fee of $25 per person will be charged. Late cancellations, no-shows, or last-minute changes — including rescheduled reservations that are then cancelled — may result in the full cancellation fee being charged.

Name: Wally's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Wally's Santa Monica is a hybrid wine merchant and dining destination on Wilshire Boulevard, established by Christian Navarro and the Marciano brothers.
The high-ceilinged interior merges a gourmet market with a restaurant, defined by communal seating and floor-to-ceiling shelves holding thousands of bottles.
Patrons visit for the signature wood-fired truffle pizza and the opportunity to sample rare wines usually sold only by the bottle.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Kaspar's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by Robert Angell, this seafood destination within The Savoy evoked a dazzling 1920s Art Deco aesthetic.
The interior featured a theatrical central circular bar, cut-glass mirroring, and chequerboard marble floors set against panoramic views of the River Thames.
Its namesake was the hotel’s legendary black cat sculpture, Kaspar, carved by Basil Ionides to join parties of thirteen.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Wally's Beverly Hills
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by Christian Navarro and the Marciano brothers, this hybrid venue pairs a wine merchant with a kitchen led by Chef David Féau.
Floor-to-ceiling shelves line the walls, framing communal tables where the retail inventory doubles as the dining backdrop.
The menu features a signature Wally's Burger and truffle-infused dishes, best enjoyed alongside a bottle selected from the thousands on display.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Lucky's Steakhouse
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the former Mr. Chow space at the Malibu Country Mart, this coastal steakhouse is the second outpost from Lucky Brand co-founder Gene Montesano.
The Warner Group Architects oversaw the redesign, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor environment that balances a refined dining room with a breezy patio.
A menu of premium chops and fresh seafood is served on signature monogrammed plates, a nod to the venue’s commitment to old-school hospitality.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Everyone must be present to be seated and after 15 minutes the next available party that’s all there will be seated. We will do our best to seat you next, but it’s important to show up at your scheduled time. We have limited tables for larger parties.

Name: Bacari
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Bacari Silverlake is a Venetian-inspired small plates destination from the Kronfli Brothers and Executive Chef Lior Hillel, occupying a converted Sunset Boulevard residence.
The restaurant centers on a lush, multi-tiered garden patio where diners share Mediterranean-influenced cicchetti in a lively, open-air setting.
A standout experience involves ordering the signature Bacari fries with bcn sauce and shawarma tacos under the canopy of an ancient Ficus tree.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Perch
Master_Aurora_Insights: Occupying the top floors of the historic Pershing Square Building in Downtown Los Angeles, this French-inspired rooftop bistro is led by Executive Chef Gerardo Benitez. The multi-level space balances boudoir-style interiors and antique furniture with lush outdoor landscaping. A wrap-around balcony and open-air deck offer 360-degree skyline views, often accompanied by live jazz performances.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: As a courtesy, we hold reservations 15 minutes past the scheduled time, after which you may be placed at the top of our cancellation list for the next available seating. Refunds are not available. Cancellations made within 24 hours will be converted to a gift card for the full prepaid amount.

Name: Bombay Bustle
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Samyukta Nair with Executive Chef Surender Mohan, this Mayfair dining room draws inspiration from the tiffin tin carriers of Mumbai.
The interiors by Fabled Studio evoke a stylized railway carriage, featuring leather banquettes and art deco touches that frame a menu of regional family recipes.
A standout detail is the presentation of curries and breads in tiered dabbas, referencing the city’s complex lunch delivery network.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Bookings will only be secured and confirmed through a valid credit or debit card. The payment link will be valid for 24 hours. A fee of £50 per person will apply for late cancellation within 48 hours before the booking or no show. We will release the table should guests fail to arrive within 15 minutes from the reservation time.

Name: Sartoria Launceston Place
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a series of townhouses in South Kensington, Sartoria Launceston Place marks the site's latest chapter under the guidance of chef patron Francesco Mazzei.
The kitchen presents a Milanese-inspired menu of refined Italian cooking, balancing traditional technique with a distinctively modern edge.
A standout is the signature Tagliatelle Martino with rich short rib ragu, served amidst a chic interior of green walls and crisp white tablecloths.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If cancelling less than 24 hours, there is a charge of £25pp for 2 or more people Tuesday to Saturday. A credit card is required to secure the booking.

Name: Catch Los Angeles
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the West Hollywood Design District, this rooftop seafood destination is the West Coast outpost of Mark Birnbaum and Eugene Remm’s Catch Hospitality Group.
The open-air dining room serves globally influenced seafood and sushi in a garden-like setting defined by a retractable roof and abundant foliage.
The venue features a distinct floral-lined entryway and panoramic views of the Hollywood Hills to complement the signature Truffle Sashimi.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Late cancellations within 12 hours of the reservation or no-shows are subject to a fee of $25 per person for dinner and $10 per person for lunch. Larger parties are subject to a 72-hour cancellation window.

Name: CUT
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Wolfgang Puck’s first European outpost anchors the ground floor of the Thierry Despont-designed 45 Park Lane in Mayfair.
The room balances a clubby atmosphere with Damien Hirst artworks, serving as a stage for Executive Chef Elliott Grover’s modern American cooking.
While the menu headlines with rare cuts of Japanese Wagyu and USDA Prime beef, the meal invariably begins with Puck’s signature warm cheese gougères.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: To ensure an exceptional experience for all, we request 24 hours' notice for cancellations. Late changes may result in a $25pp fee.

Name: The Grill at The Dorchester
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within Mayfair’s The Dorchester, this gilded dining room celebrates the British grill tradition under the direction of culinary veteran Martyn Nail and head chef Jacob Keen-Downs.
The kitchen delivers a polished expression of classic comfort food, stripping away stuffy formalities while retaining the room’s original 1931 grandeur.
A memorable highlight is the theatrical pudding trolley, which allows guests to select from an array of British desserts tableside.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations must be made at least 48 hours prior to the reservation to avoid a charge of £50 per person.

Name: Maggie Jones's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Tucked away in a Kensington cul-de-sac, this rustic institution was renamed after Princess Margaret, who used the alias "Maggie Jones" to book her table.
The interior resembles a candlelit farmhouse, cluttered with hanging baskets and mismatched wooden furniture for a distinctly cosy, unpretentious feel.
Hearty British classics define the menu, best experienced through the signature Maggie’s fish pie or roast rump of lamb served in generous portions.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Ivy Café Wimbledon
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by The Ivy Collection, The Ivy Café Wimbledon is an all-day British brasserie located in London's Wimbledon Village.
The restaurant provides a relaxed dining experience featuring a brasserie-style dining room and a dedicated garden terrace.
Designed by Martin Brudnizki Design Studio, the venue includes the Danby Room for private events of up to forty standing guests.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Great White
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Australian duo Sam Trude and Sam Cooper, this all-day café on Pacific Avenue channels a relaxed coastal aesthetic.
The kitchen bridges Sydney’s coffee culture with Californian seasonality, offering a menu defined by fresh produce and coastal comfort food.
A signature Blue Smoothie Bowl, tinted with E3Live algae and topped with tropical fruit, serves as the menu's most recognizable visual element.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: While you won't be charged if you need to cancel, we ask that you please do so at least 24 hours in advance.

Name: BAO
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Erchen Chang, Shing Tat Chung, and Wai Ting Chung, this Soho eatery is a Michelin-listed specialist in Taiwanese street food.
The minimalist, wood-panelled space evokes a Taipei xiao chi house, serving small plates and fluffy steamed buns.
A standout order is the signature Classic Bao, featuring braised pork, peanut powder, fermented greens, and coriander inside a pillowy white bun.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Chulita
Master_Aurora_Insights:
This Michelin Bib Gourmand recipient on Venice Beach’s Rose Avenue is an Alta California-style restaurant from owner Shireen Imani.
The breezy, Tulum-inspired space focuses on "botanas y mezcales," creating a relaxed environment for sharing small plates and agave spirits.
A signature element is the hand-pressed cassava flour taco, served alongside a robust selection of tequilas and mezcals.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: All guests must be confirmed 24 hours before booking. You will be charged a per person cancellation fee of $25 dollars for any guest booked that doesn't attend. We can hold your table for up to 10 minutes after your reservation time.

Name: Orla
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the Regent Santa Monica Beach, Orla is an Egyptian-Mediterranean restaurant from chef Michael Mina and design firm AvroKO.
The market-driven menu blends the aromatic spices of the Middle East with California’s coastal bounty in a space defined by rich tan leather and mid-century influences.
A central ovular bar anchors the dining room, where guests enjoy charcoal-roasted meats and fresh seafood against a backdrop of panoramic Pacific Ocean views.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Lina Stores
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 1944 at 18 Brewer Street, this Soho institution has evolved from an Italian delicatessen into a restaurant group led by head chef Masha Rener.
Signature pistachio-green interiors and mid-century design frame a menu of fresh, handmade pasta and regional Italian staples.
A standout detail is the rich 30-egg yolk tagliolini, a vibrant dish often served with black truffle and Parmigiano Reggiano.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For bookings up to 8 people, please let us know 24 hours before your reservation time; tables are held for 15 minutes. For parties of 9-15 guests, a £200 deposit is required which is non-refundable for cancellations made less than 24 hours before the booking. For groups of 16 guests and above, a 50% deposit is required; cancellations less than 14 days before the event receive a 50% refund of the prepayment, and for cancellations less than 7 days the deposit is not refundable.

Name: The Botanist
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by the ETM Group, The Botanist is an all-day restaurant and bar situated within the City of London's Broadgate Circle.
The venue pairs a menu of modern British cuisine with an extensive cocktail program tailored to the surrounding financial district.
Designed by Russell Sage Studio, the multi-level space features a large central bar and a subterranean late-night club known as the Soda Room.

Name: Malibu Farm Restaurant
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Swedish chef Helene Henderson, this counter-service spot sits at the end of the Malibu Pier with a simple farm-to-table ethos.
The whitewashed, open-air space embodies a relaxed Californian aesthetic, pairing panoramic ocean views with a menu of fresh, organic ingredients.
Diners queue for signature plates like the cauliflower crust pizza, best enjoyed on the deck while watching surfers catch waves below.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Arriving 15 minutes past your scheduled reservation time will result in cancellation. We recommend that you make a reservation ahead of time if you wish to be guaranteed seating.

Name: Dishoom
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by cousins Shamil and Kavi Thakrar, this bustling homage to the Irani cafés of Bombay sits in the heart of Shoreditch.
The space evokes a 1970s Bombay café with bentwood chairs, retro advertising, and a lived-in patina that feels established rather than designed.
Guests gather in the airy, indoor-outdoor Verandah to savour the signature House Black Daal, cooked for 24 hours for rich, dark harmony.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For any group, we do ask for a deposit, which is used against your final bill. If you need to cancel for any reason, let us know 24 hours in advance and we will gladly refund your deposit. We can only hold your table for 15 minutes.

Name: Gracias Madre
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a light-filled structure designed by Wendy Haworth, this West Hollywood venue comes from the founders of Café Gratitude.
The kitchen prepares organic, plant-based interpretations of Mexican staples, complemented by a bar program focused on small-batch agave spirits.
A sprawling courtyard shaded by mature olive trees anchors the property, serving as a central gathering point for al fresco dining.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Lunch reservations are subject to a cancellation fee of $10 per person if cancelled within 12 hours of the reservation time. Dinner reservations are subject to a cancellation fee of $25 per person if cancelled within 12 hours of the reservation time. These fees also apply to no-shows. Large parties may be subject to a 72-hour cancellation window.

Name: Dehesa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London's Carnaby district, this charcuterie and tapas bar is a key venue within the respected Salt Yard Group.
The kitchen bridges Spanish and Italian traditions to create a menu of refined small plates served in a bustling, wood-paneled space.
A perennial favorite is the signature deep-fried courgette flower stuffed with goat's cheese and drizzled with honey.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Tar & Roses
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by chef Andrew Kirschner, this Santa Monica restaurant is a Michelin Bib Gourmand recipient known for its globally inspired, locally driven Californian cuisine.
The kitchen centers around a wood-burning oven that imparts a rustic char to everything from vegetable small plates to large-format sharing platters.
A signature whole fried snapper arrives with cold soba noodles and dipping sauces, designed to be dismantled and shared by the table.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Emilia's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within The Crescent Hotel in Fort Worth’s Cultural District, Emilia’s is a Mediterranean dining destination centered around an open kitchen and seasonal patio.
The kitchen focuses on the coastal flavors of the Adriatic and Mediterranean, serving fresh crudos, house-made pastas, and wood-grilled seafood.
A standout feature is The Blue Room, a distinct dining enclave within the main space offering a more reserved atmosphere and a specialized menu.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations up to 6 people: modifications or cancellations allowed, without penalty, up to 7 days before the day of your reservation. Reservations up to 10 people: modifications or cancellations allowed, without penalty, up to 20 days before the day of your reservation. If the reservation is modified or cancelled after the established deadline, or in case of a no-show (arriving 15 minutes late without notice), a penalty of €362 per person applies.

Name: 1890 by Gordon Ramsay
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Overlooking The Savoy’s entrance, this intimate Michelin-starred venue by Gordon Ramsay honors the culinary tenure of Georges Auguste Escoffier.
The interiors evoke a gilded trinket box, setting the stage for a modern French tasting menu that refines classical techniques with contemporary flair.
Dinner unfolds as a Carte Blanche experience, featuring intricate courses like a lobster cornetto or seasonal plates inspired by the hotel's 19th-century heritage.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Dinner bookings require a deposit of £100 per guest to confirm your reservation. Lunch bookings require card details to confirm your reservation. In the event that the booking is not honoured or is cancelled with less than 72 hours' notice, the deposit of £100 per guest for dinner will be retained, or a fee of £90 per guest for lunch will be charged to the card. Please note that special terms & conditions may apply for key seasonal dates.

Name: Sartoria Savile Row
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Anchoring Mayfair’s Savile Row, this refined Italian institution is defined by the sharp tailoring-inspired interiors of designer David d’Almada.
Head Chef Francesco Chiarelli oversees a menu of sophisticated regional classics, serving everything from breakfast to late-night cicchetti amidst leather and velvet.
The Libare Bar is a standout, offering a dedicated Spritz menu and a heated terrace that provides a rare alfresco vantage point in the neighbourhood.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If cancelling less than 24 hours, there is a charge of £25pp for 2 or more people Tuesday to Saturday.

Name: Capo
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated near the beach in Santa Monica, Capo is a modern Italian restaurant established by chef and owner Bruce Marder.
The menu centers on handmade pastas and fresh seafood, supported by a cellar that holds a Wine Spectator Grand Award.
A defining feature of the space is an open fireplace where steaks and chops are grilled over a wood fire.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: No-Shows and Cancellations within 48 hours of the reservation will incur a $250 per person charge for the loss of that business.

Name: Gordon's Wine Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Still owned by the Gordon family, this Embankment cellar is widely celebrated as London’s oldest wine bar.
The subterranean interior feels suspended in time, defined by low vaulted ceilings, flickering candlelight, and walls lined with fading memorabilia.
Patrons sit at rustic tables to sample the signature selection of sherries and ports served directly from old oak barrels.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: It will require a minimum spend of £250 per bookable slot no matter the party size, which is secured upon booking. We ask that you please reschedule or cancel at least 48 hours before the beginning of your appointment to avoid the cancellation fee. Cancellations made within 48 hours of the reservation time will be considered late cancellations. In the event of a late cancellation or no-show, a £125 cancellation fee will be applied to the card on file.

Name: The Ivy Cafe Blackheath
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in London’s Theatreland, this 1917 landmark was originally founded by Abel Giandolini and now serves as the flagship for Richard Caring’s Caprice Holdings.
The Martin Brudnizki interiors feature a central dining bar, oak panelling, and the restaurant’s distinct harlequin stained-glass windows.
Regulars bypass the seasonal options for the signature Shepherd’s Pie, a specific blend of minced lamb and beef topped with cheddar mash.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: 48-hour cancellation policy, £20pp fee if canceled late.

Name: Shirube
Master_Aurora_Insights:
This influential izakaya group, founded by Takashi Uno, anchors the backstreets of Tokyo’s Shimokitazawa and Shibuya districts.
The interior is defined by a raucous, communal energy and a concealed entrance that requires a keen eye to locate.
A standout ritual is the aburi shimesaba, a cured mackerel fillet torched tableside with a massive open flame.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If we are unable to contact you within 15 minutes of your reservation time, we may be forced to cancel your reservation, so please be sure to contact us if you will be late.

Name: Caldesi
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on Marylebone Lane, this enduring Italian restaurant is the flagship of chef and author Giancarlo Caldesi and his wife Katie.
The kitchen serves authentic, seasonal regional dishes that rotate to reflect the diverse culinary traditions of the Italian peninsula.
The site also houses La Cucina Caldesi, a celebrated cookery school where students master techniques from fresh pasta to Tuscan classics.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Please note, we have a 15 minute grace period. If you are running more than 15 minutes late for your booking, please call the restaurant on 0207 487 0758 and kindly let us know. All table reservations will be for 2-hour slots.

Name: The Princess of Shoreditch
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a Victorian building, this split-level gastropub is led by MasterChef: The Professionals champion Nikita Pathakji.
A spiral staircase divides the space into two distinct zones, separating the bustling ground-floor bar from the refined upstairs dining room.
While the tasting menu highlights the kitchen's technical skill, the Sunday roast remains a standout ritual for the neighborhood crowd.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: In order to reserve a table you will be required to provide your card details. Please note, your details will be held securely in our PCI-compliant Payment Gateway. We will not apply any charge to your card at this point. If you are unable to honour your reservation, you must cancel your booking 48 hours in advance of the booked date, otherwise your card will be charged £25 per person. The cancellation policy varies for large group bookings and private hires.

Name: Old Spitalfields Market
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a Victorian hall built by Robert Horner, this East London destination was modernized by architecture firm Foster + Partners.
Independent stalls selling clothing and crafts stand alongside established restaurants and a central concourse dedicated to street food vendors.
The weekly Thursday antiques market draws collectors to hunt for vintage maps, period clothing, and rare books beneath the restored glass roof.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: J Sheekey
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Hidden within St Martin's Court since 1896, this Covent Garden seafood stalwart is a theatrical fixture operated by Caprice Holdings.
The wood-paneled dining rooms function as an unofficial canteen for West End actors, defined by intimate leather banquettes and low lighting.
Beyond the extensive oyster selection, the signature fish pie stands out as the enduring favorite served beneath walls covered in signed celebrity portraits.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Credit card details are required to secure the booking. A cancellation fee of £25 per person applies to no-shows or late cancellations.

Name: Musso & Frank Grill
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 1919 by Frank Toulet and Joseph Musso, this Hollywood Boulevard establishment is the neighborhood's oldest restaurant.
The interior features dark mahogany paneling and red leather booths that have hosted writers from F. Scott Fitzgerald to William Faulkner.
Red-jacketed waiters serve the house martini, stirred and poured with a sidecar, alongside the signature flannel cakes.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Hawksmoor
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by childhood friends Will Beckett and Huw Gott, this British steakhouse group has expanded from a Spitalfields basement to heritage sites across the UK and US.
The offering is defined by a steadfast commitment to charcoal-grilled, grass-fed native beef served in handsome, heritage-inspired interiors.
Regulars know to order the cult-favourite Shaky Pete’s Ginger Brew or the Sunday roast, a celebrated weekly ritual.

Name: La Mia Mamma
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Peppe Corsaro, Corrado Mozzillo, and Luca Maggiora, this London restaurant hands its kitchen over to a rotating cast of Italian matriarchs.
The concept centers on quarterly residencies, recruiting mothers from specific provinces to prepare the traditional, home-style recipes of their heritage.
Diners can watch these non-professional chefs in the window as they hand-roll dough for daily specials like fresh tagliatelle or slow-cooked ragù.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: CANCEL or EDIT by increasing or decreasing your booking, via the link in your confirmation email 48 prior your reservation (7 days prior for groups). We will reserve the right to charge £ 25 per person for late cancellation / no show / late party size amendment/ late arrival. No phone cancellations or amendments accepted. Card details are required to complete the booking. No charge will be applied (unless we apply a no show/late cancellation fee).

Name: Speedboat Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Chef Luke Farrell brings his Bangkok Chinatown-inspired canteen to Notting Hill’s historic Electric Cinema building.
The late-night space channels the energy of Thailand’s canal-side hangouts with a soundtrack of Thai pop and unapologetically spicy stir-fries.
A real speedboat engine anchors the room, while fierce games of shuffleboard compete with signature dishes like the tom yam mama seafood soup.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Card details are required to secure bookings. A fee of £20 per person applies for no-shows or late cancellations. The specific cancellation window is not published online but is provided in the booking confirmation.

Name: Riccardo's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on London’s Fulham Road, this enduring Tuscan trattoria is the personal project of owner Riccardo Mariti, serving a loyal Chelsea crowd since 1995.
The kitchen specializes in rustic sharing plates that defy the typical heavy Italian format, distinguishing itself with a pioneering selection of vegan and gluten-free options.
Regulars gather on the heated terrace for the signature *melanzana parmigiana* or a plant-based menu that faithfully recreates regional classics.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Lunch: $10 per person cancellation fee for cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72 hour cancellation window.

Name: Gordon Ramsay Bar & Grill
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a prime address on London’s Grosvenor Square, this contemporary steakhouse by Gordon Ramsay delivers a polished but relaxed dining experience.
The menu focuses on rare-breed beef and seasonal grill dishes, offering a more casual atmosphere than the chef’s flagship fine-dining venues.
For a closer look, the Butcher’s Block table offers front-row seats to watch chefs prepare cuts aged in the on-site Himalayan salt locker.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Bookings of 6+ guests require card details to confirm your reservation. In the event that the booking is not honoured or is cancelled with less than 24 hours' notice a cancellation fee of £25 per person will be charged to the card. Please note that special terms & conditions may apply for key seasonal dates.

Name: Chelsea Farmers Market
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Anchored by the well-regarded Chelsea Gardener, this quiet enclave off King's Road is a collection of chalet-style boutiques and restaurants.
The open-air square functions as a relaxed lifestyle destination, offering al fresco dining and independent retail in a garden-like setting.
A signature element is the cluster of wooden structures that gives the space a distinct country-village feel in the heart of the city.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Honest Burgers
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Tom Barton and Philip Eeles in Brixton Village, this British specialist grew from a marquee to prioritize traceable provenance.
The team chops rather than minces beef in a central butchery, allowing patties to be served pink alongside signature rosemary-salted chips.
While the menu centers on the cheddar-topped Honest, every location serves a unique local burger created with neighboring food producers.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Aubaine
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Hani Nakkach, this independent group of modern French brasseries and patisseries operates across London’s most prestigious neighborhoods.
The all-day dining concept blends the rustic charm of a Provençal bistro with the refined, cosmopolitan energy of the capital.
Its Selfridges location is famous for a ceiling of trailing wisteria, a lush backdrop for house-made breads and delicate pastries.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Duke of Clarence
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Hidden in a Sydney CBD laneway, this 19th-century-inspired tavern is the work of Mikey Enright and Julian Train, the duo behind The Barber Shop.
The venue recreates the atmosphere of a Victorian London local, serving cask ales and British fare in a space that feels centuries old.
Film set designer Sara Mathers sourced the entire fit-out, including floorboards and stained glass, from England before shipping it to Australia for assembly.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72 hour cancellation window.

Name: The Cross Keys
Master_Aurora_Insights:
A Chelsea institution since 1708, this historic gastropub on Lawrence Street has long served as a sanctuary for artists and locals alike.
The revitalized interior balances period charm with contemporary dining, featuring exposed brick, roaring fires, and a menu of refined British classics.
Its enduring appeal is cemented by a legendary patronage that spans from J.M.W. Turner and James Whistler to Bob Marley and the Rolling Stones.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: No-shows or cancellations less than 2 days in advance will be subject to a charge of £50 per person.

Name: Peggy Porschen
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Le Cordon Bleu alumna Peggy Porschen and husband Bryn Morrow, this Belgravia parlour is a confectionery destination known for its distinctively feminine aesthetic.
The bakery specializes in layer cakes and cupcakes that emphasize traditional baking techniques within a setting defined by pastel hues.
A signature pink façade framed by seasonal flower arches serves as the backdrop for enjoying a slice of the Glorious Victoria sponge.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Valid credit card details are required to secure bookings. For standard tables, no deposit is taken, but changes or cancellations must be made no later than 24 hours before the booking; late cancellations and no-shows incur a fee of £20 per person. A £20 per person fee also applies if guests change their mind upon arrival regarding a pre-booked experience. For group bookings, a £20 per person upfront deposit is required, which is non-refundable if cancelled within 7 days of the booking.

Name: The Hillgate
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on a quiet residential street behind Notting Hill Gate, this neighbourhood gastropub is operated by the independent Indapubs group.
The interior is defined by dark wood panelling and antique furnishings, setting a traditional backdrop for a menu of seasonal British staples.
Upstairs, the Racks Dining Room offers a bright, private space for gatherings, distinct from the main bar's open fireplace and wooden tables.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Hollywood Arms
Master_Aurora_Insights: Established in 1865 on Hollywood Road, this Grade II-listed Chelsea institution serves as both a spirited local and a polished dining destination. The kitchen delivers seasonal British plates to a well-heeled clientele that has reportedly included the Duke of Sussex and other high-profile locals. Its defining feature is the first-floor Boulevard Bar, an airy space designed to evoke an English country garden with sylvan wallpaper and a large central skylight.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Ottolenghi
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Led by chef Yotam Ottolenghi, this collection of London delis features clean white interiors designed by architect Alex Meitlis.
The daily offering centers on a vibrant counter display of vegetable-centric salads and grains seasoned with bold spices.
Signature window displays feature oversized meringues and fruit-laden cakes arranged at varying heights to create a colorful edible landscape.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We have a 24 hours cancellation policy for bookings of 9 guests and below and a week notice for parties of 10 guests and above. We require credit card details to secure your reservation. Cancellations outside of the policy timing may incur a cancellation fee. We hold reservations for 15 minutes. If we’re not able to reach you, we will hold the reservation for a further 5 minutes before releasing the table and sending a no show/cancellation message. Please note that 'no shows' will incur a late cancellation fee.

Name: Beaufort House
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on the King's Road, this private members’ club and brasserie serves as a sophisticated social anchor for Chelsea residents.
The four-story venue transitions from a lively ground-floor dining room and cocktail bar to an exclusive champagne bar and members' lounge on the upper levels.
The culinary offering is headlined by Kora, a Mediterranean concept featuring a signature trio of raw dishes alongside established brasserie classics.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A non-refundable deposit of 25% is required upon receipt of the signed confirmation. Provisional Bookings: A provisional booking may be held for a 24 hour period during which time this space can be cancelled without a penalty. Cancellation by the customer: All cancellations must be made in writing. Charges: Cancellation greater than 31 days before function date: Deposit retained (25% of contracted spend). Cancellation 30 days or less prior to the function date: 50% of contracted spend. Cancellation less than 7 days: 100% of contracted spend.

Name: Mazi
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Tucked away in Notting Hill, this modern Greek restaurant is the creation of founders Christina Mouratoglou and Adrien Carré.
The kitchen eschews taverna clichés to present Hellenic classics as refined, shareable plates that emphasize culinary innovation.
Signature jars of fish roe mousse and feta tempura with lemon marmalade are best enjoyed in the vine-covered garden.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We kindly request a 24hr cancellation for all bookings. Please note late arrivals over 15 minutes will be automatically cancelled. Tables available for 2hr slots unless previously requested, or if group is larger than 6.

Name: My Old Dutch
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Established in 1958, London’s original pancake house serves as a steadfast destination for Dutch-style comfort food in the capital.
The kitchen turns out massive, plate-filling batters that function as a base for everything from smoked bacon and chicken to fresh fruit and cream.
A meal here is best anchored by a starter of *bitterballen*, traditional deep-fried meatballs served with a side of mustard.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We generally only take bookings for 10 guests or more with £5 deposit per guest. Anything less than 10 guests would be a walk-in first come first serve basis.

Name: Julie's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
A fixture of London’s Holland Park since 1969, this neighbourhood destination has been reimagined by owner Tara MacBain and chef patron Owen Kenworthy.
The all-day modern French brasserie retains its original bohemian character, shifting from a relaxed café by day to a wine-focused dining room at night.
Interiors by Rosanna Bossom feature the venue’s signature honeycomb of alcoves, providing the setting for a lobster soufflé.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Coopers Arms
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on a quiet corner of Flood Street in Chelsea, this Victorian public house is a steadfast local favourite managed by Young’s.
The interiors preserve a Dickensian aesthetic with etched glass and dark wood, serving as a backdrop for a menu of traditional British classics.
A curious historical detail is that the original 1831 structure was demolished and rebuilt exactly forty feet south in 1874 to accommodate street widening.

Name: Jak's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Valentino Seferi, this collection of London venues serves as a reliable all-day hub for Chelsea and Mayfair residents.
The atmosphere balances an informal, home-cooked sensibility with a bustling social scene, offering generous Mediterranean-leaning plates intended for communal dining.
Regulars flock to the signature salad counter, an expansive display of daily-changing grains and vegetables that defines the space.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If your party is not complete at the reservation time, your reservation will be held for 10 minutes and then your party will be moved to a priority standing. All reservations will be held for up to 10 minutes.

Name: Joe & The Juice
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in Copenhagen by Danish athlete Kaspar Basse, this juice and coffee concept is defined by its high-energy, club-like atmosphere.
The industrial, open-plan spaces function as social hubs where youthful staff deliver spirited service against a backdrop of loud music.
Beyond the made-to-order shakes, the viral Tunacado sandwich featuring whipped tuna mousse and avocado on crispy flatbread is the standout signature.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Once an Order is placed by you, the Order cannot be cancelled. You cannot withdraw or cancel an Order for Products once you have submitted it. All food and beverage items are non-refundable.

Name: Bouchon Racine
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Bouchon Racine is a Michelin-recognized French restaurant located above The Three Compasses pub in London's Clerkenwell, helmed by chef Henry Harris and co-owner Dave Strauss.
Inspired by the traditional bouchons of Lyon, the dining room serves a classic menu focused on bourgeois French cooking.
The daily offerings are scribbled on a blackboard, featuring staples like calves' brains in brown butter and a Mont Blanc gâteau.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If a guarantee card was requested at the time of booking, you will receive an email and an SMS in which you must reconfirm or cancel the reservation using the links provided for this purpose. Your reservation will only be guaranteed when it has been reconfirmed.

Name: The Fox & Pheasant
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Tucked away in a quiet corner of Chelsea, this 19th-century pub was rescued and restored by singer James Blunt and his wife Sofia Wellesley.
The interiors channel a country-pub aesthetic with three fireplaces, a traditional bar, and a dining room housed within a glass-roofed conservatory.
A signature order is the bucket of guinea fowl and chicken pieces, served with a sticky honey and Szechuan pepper glaze.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Any 'no show' or cancellation with less than 2 days notice may be charged a £25pp fee.

Name: The Duke of Wellington
Master_Aurora_Insights:
This Belgravia corner pub on Eaton Terrace is led by Chef Patron Laurie Gear of the Michelin-starred Artichoke.
The kitchen focuses on elevated British dining served within a setting that retains its nineteenth-century roots.
A framed Wellesley family tree hangs within the oak-panelled interior as a specific nod to the history of its namesake.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: You may cancel your Booking up to 14 days from the Arrival Date. Group Bookings (6 or more people) may be cancelled up to 21 days prior to the Arrival Date. Deposits will be refunded solely at the discretion of the manager. Any Deposit may become non-refundable if you cancel a Group Booking within 21 days or less, if you cancel a Booking within 14 days or less, or if you fail to attend (No Show).

Name: Botanica
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by former food editors Emily Fiffer and Heather Sperling, Botanica is an all-day restaurant and market in the Silver Lake neighborhood of Los Angeles.
The hybrid space focuses on health-conscious, vegetable-forward California cuisine paired with a selection of natural wines and gourmet pantry goods.
The daytime menu features signature dishes like Turkish eggs served with sheep’s milk yogurt and Aleppo-Urfa butter.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We understand that plans can change but please let us know if you intend to cancel or alter your booking no less than 24 hours prior to your reservation to avoid incurring a cancellation fee of $50 per person.

Name: The Chelsea Ram
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Burnaby Street, this Young's pub serves as a quiet neighbourhood anchor in the heart of Chelsea.
The interior balances rustic warmth with contemporary polish, featuring cosy booths and an eclectic collection of curios.
The kitchen is best known for its hearty, slow-cooked pies and traditional Sunday roasts, served alongside a rotating selection of cask ales.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Juicebaby
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Aida Foustok, this modern plant-based café has become a reliable fixture for health-focused Londoners in Notting Hill and Chelsea.
The daily offering features organic, cold-pressed juices and nutrient-dense salads designed for efficient, high-quality nourishment.
Regulars frequently opt for the signature Green Glow juice, best enjoyed alongside one of the house-made raw Caramel Bars.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Pig's Ear
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a tall townhouse overlooking Trinity College Park, this Dublin restaurant is the work of chef-owner Stephen McAllister.
The kitchen interprets Irish culinary history with a contemporary edge, offering playful updates on traditional recipes.
The menu features distinctively Irish creations, including a boxty pancake and the signature Dublin Lawyer lobster omelette.

Name: The Phene
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Built in 1853 by architect John Samuel Phene, this three-story Chelsea establishment sits on a quiet residential street near the King’s Road.
The venue operates as a multi-room clubhouse, moving from a traditional saloon bar and library-themed dining room to a bright conservatory.
A dedicated garden serves as the focal point, offering a year-round outdoor retreat often styled with seasonal themes.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: All bookings are considered provisional until your deposit has been received. The required deposit is half of your agreed minimum spend. If a booking is cancelled more than 15 days before the event, the deposit will be refunded in full. After this, we will help you find an alternative date. Should you cancel within 7 days of your booking, we will retain the deposit to cover loss of earnings.

Name: Chelsea Potter
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on King's Road, this historic pub was founded in 1842 as the Commercial Tavern before being renamed to honor the area's artistic heritage.
It became a hub of the 1960s social scene, drawing regulars like Jimi Hendrix and The Rolling Stones to its unpretentious bar.
The traditional wood-paneled interior offers a grounded respite from the shopping district, maintaining the legacy of the neighborhood's creative past.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For standard, non-event bookings, we do not require you to pay a deposit when you book. To cancel your booking, please refer to your booking email and click 'cancel booking'.

Name: Stanley's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Tucked off the King’s Road, this Chelsea restaurant from Hugh Stanley earns its reputation with a Michelin Guide listing and a smart local crowd.
The venue centers on a heated courtyard and orangery designed to evoke an English country garden for year-round dining.
Olive trees and trickling fountains frame the outdoor space, serving as a backdrop for a menu of seasonal British small plates.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Lunch: $10 per person cancellation fee for cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72-hour cancellation policy.

Name: Kurobuta
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Originally launched by ex-Nobu chef Scott Hallsworth, this London izakaya presents an unconventional take on Japanese dining in a casual setting.
The atmosphere is defined by a rock soundtrack and stripped-back decor, offering a lively backdrop for inventive, tapas-style sharing plates.
A signature dish is the BBQ pork belly buns with spicy peanut soy, known for their soft steamed dough and rich, sticky glaze.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Rabbit British Bistro
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by the Gladwin Brothers, Rabbit British Bistro is a farm-to-fork restaurant located on King's Road in Chelsea.
The interior utilizes reclaimed materials to evoke the Sussex countryside, reflecting a menu focused on sustainable, wild, and foraged ingredients sourced largely from the family's own farm.
A fixture of the menu is the signature Mushroom Marmite éclair served with confit egg yolk.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: You will be charged £55 per person in the event of a late cancellation (24 hours before your booking) or a 'no show'. We require your credit card information to be stored to confirm this booking.

Name: Hans Bar & Grill
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Anchoring Chelsea’s pedestrianized Pavilion Road, this AA Rosette-awarded venue operates as the all-day dining arm of the 11 Cadogan Gardens hotel.
The kitchen presents seasonal British produce in a contemporary setting, transitioning from healthy morning plates to a celebrated Sunday roast.
A standout feature is the monthly Chelsea Wine Table series, where region-specific vintages are paired with a curated tasting menu.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Dinner: £25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72 hour cancellation policy.

Name: Scalini
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Established in 1988 by Mario Paggetti and Valerio Calzolari, this Chelsea mainstay continues the culinary lineage of London’s historic La Trattoria Terrazza.
The dining room operates with a traditional rhythm, characterized by white-jacketed waiters, theatrical tableside service, and a bustling atmosphere.
Regulars order the signature lobster spaghetti, served in a space lined with framed photographs of the many celebrities who have dined here.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If there are more than 6 people in your party, we ask for a deposit of £40 per person at the time of booking. The deposit is refundable should you cancel within the limit of our Restaurant Reservation Cancellation Policy (24 hours prior).

Name: Pavilion Road
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Redeveloped by the Cadogan Estate with architecture by Stiff + Trevillion, this former Chelsea service road is now a pedestrian-friendly haven for artisan commerce.
The mews functions as a village high street, prioritizing independent purveyors over chain retail to serve the local community.
A standout feature is the concentration of food specialists like Bread Ahead and Natoora, where al fresco dining spills onto the brick-paved thoroughfare.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: King's Road
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Commissioned by King Charles II as a private route to Hampton Court, this Chelsea thoroughfare is a historic retail and cultural corridor.
Once home to Mary Quant’s Bazaar, the street defined the swinging sixties and punk era, now balancing that legacy with independent boutiques.
Its avant-garde spirit endures at Vivienne Westwood’s World’s End shop, where a backward-spinning clock marks time on the facade.
Master_Cancellation_Policy:

More than 45 days prior to departure: The total deposit paid to us (30% of tour value) will act as your cancellation fee to cover hotel charges and organization fees.

No-Show: 100% on total charge.

After the trip has commenced, we are unable to refund any amount for unused services due to your willingness, early departure, late arrival, or missed days on tours.

Name: Made in Italy
Master_Aurora_Insights:
A fixture on the King’s Road, this family-run Italian trattoria brings the spirited warmth of the Amalfi Coast to West London.
The rustic, multi-level space features exposed brickwork and a coveted rooftop terrace that provides a rare al fresco hideaway above the street.
Regulars head here for the signature pizza al metro, served on long wooden paddles that encourage a communal and convivial dining experience.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Naya Beach Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Naya Beach Club is a restaurant and coastal venue on the Bay of Faliraki in Rhodes, featuring earthy architecture by local architect Eleni Karimali.
The kitchen focuses on a modern interpretation of Greek and Mediterranean cuisine, serving fresh seafood, grilled meats, and savory meze plates.
Beyond the dining area, guests can transition to shoreline gazebos and sea beds while ordering from a premium shisha menu.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Pizza East
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a vast corner of Shoreditch’s Tea Building, this industrial eatery was designed by Michaelis Boyd and is now operated by Gordon Ramsay Restaurants.
The menu focuses on produce-led Italian comfort food, centering on wood-fired pizzas known for their chewy, ciabatta-like crusts.
Regulars favour the spicy ’nduja and honey pie, enjoyed at communal tables amidst exposed concrete and original warehouse features.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Bookings of 6+ guests require card details to confirm your reservation. In the event that the booking is not honoured or is cancelled with less than 24 hours' notice a cancellation fee of £25 per person will be charged to the card. Please note that special terms & conditions may apply for key seasonal dates.

Name: Hartley Botanica
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Somis, California, this three-acre botanical estate was originally cultivated by Richard and Kate Hartley to host their daughter’s wedding.
The family-run venue functions as a private sanctuary for open-air celebrations, defined by its intimate atmosphere and lush, manicured grounds.
Guests wander through the Paliuli and Lotus Tea Gardens, discovering hand-paved pathways, vine-covered archways, and cascading waterfalls amidst the scent of jasmine.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Deposits are non-refundable. To firmly reserve a date, signed contracts and deposits ($7,500 for Paliuli Gardens, $3,000 for Command Performance Catering, and full payment for Bella Dia Weddings) are required. The balance for the venue is due 90 days prior to the event, and the catering balance is due 2 weeks prior. If final payment is not made 7 days prior to the event, it may be considered cancelled. For photo sessions, the fee is non-refundable but can be applied to a different day and time; no-shows forfeit the fee.

Name: Ella Canta
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the InterContinental London Park Lane, this modern Mexican restaurant was the creation of celebrated chef Martha Ortiz.
The David Rockwell–designed space blended mid-century elegance with a theatrical, feminine aesthetic featuring blush pink tones and walnut accents.
A standout detail was the signature guacamole garnished with a real gold grasshopper, served alongside pomegranate and ricotta.

Name: Cakes & Bubbles
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in London’s Hotel Café Royal, this dessert-led venue marks the first international opening from Albert Adrià, the celebrated pastry chef formerly of El Bulli.
The menu treats sweets as a main event, offering a progression of technical, trompe-l'œil creations paired specifically with sparkling wines.
A signature highlight is the Cheesecake, a hazelnut and white chocolate composition shaped to resemble a wheel of Baron Bigod cheese.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Pétrus
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Run by the Aichner sisters—Brigitte, Christina, and Daniela—this design-led alpine retreat sits at the foot of Mount Kronplatz in South Tyrol.
The property blends contemporary wellness and Tyrolean tradition, featuring a spa focused on local herbs and interiors enriched with handcrafted details.
Its Petrus Restaurant holds three Gault Millau toques and recently won a German Design Award for its unique garden-inspired architecture.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: All bookings require card details to confirm your reservation. In the event that the booking is not honoured or is cancelled with less than 72 hours' notice a fee of £75pp for weekday lunch and £120pp for weekend lunch and all dinners will be charged to the card.

Name: Bellamy's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Tucked away in a quiet Mayfair backstreet, this discreet Franco-Belgian brasserie is the creation of Gavin Rankin and hosted Queen Elizabeth II.
The dining room evokes a clubby, civilised atmosphere where the menu eschews trends in favour of classic French consistency.
Regulars know to order the signature iced lobster soufflé, a dish once named among the world’s best shellfish plates by National Geographic Traveller.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Late cancellation fee for lunch is $10 per person when you cancel within the 12-hour window before your reservation. For dinner, it's $25 per person.

Name: Pollen Street Social
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Jason Atherton’s former Michelin-starred flagship in Mayfair established a template for modern British dining by combining culinary precision with a social ethos.
Designed by Neri&Hu, the interior featured a segmented layout that encouraged interaction, balancing the rigour of fine dining with a relaxed energy.
A defining ritual involved moving to the dedicated dessert bar, allowing diners to witness the preparation of the final course at a specialized counter.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Humble Grape
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by James Dawson, this London wine bar and merchant recently won "Best Bar in London" at the 2025 City AM Toast Awards.
The operation bypasses intermediaries to import over 400 sustainable and biodynamic vintages directly from small, family-run vineyards worldwide.
Diners select bottles from the retail shelves to enjoy on-site for a fixed corkage fee, accompanied by Executive Chef Dane Barnard’s European sharing plates.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Card details are required to secure bookings. A 48-hour cancellation policy applies; cancellations within this window or no-shows incur a fee of £25 per person charged to the card on file.

Name: Chucs
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Charles Finch and led by Graziano Arricale, this Italian restaurant collection spans London neighbourhoods from Mayfair to Hyde Park.
The interiors channel the 1950s Riviera with polished timber, brass fittings, and vintage photographs that evoke the atmosphere of a private yacht.
The Serpentine outpost occupies a Zaha Hadid-designed pavilion, providing a distinct architectural setting for signatures like truffle arancini and cacio e pepe.

Name: E&O
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched atop the Athens Marriott Hotel, E&O Athens is the Greek outpost of Will Ricker's London-born pan-Asian restaurant group.
The eighth-floor dining room and terrace provide an elevated vantage point to take in unobstructed views of the Athenian Riviera.
Diners pair dishes like the signature crispy duck and Wagyu fillet with drinks from the dedicated Martini Bar.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Lunch: $10 per person cancellation fee for cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72-hour cancellation policy.

Name: Portland Restaurant
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Opened in 2015 by Will Lander and Daniel Morgenthau, Portland is a Michelin-starred Modern European restaurant located in London's Fitzrovia neighborhood.
The kitchen, currently led by executive chef Chris Bassett, focuses on technique-driven cooking rooted in strict seasonality and careful ingredient sourcing.
To reflect the freshest available produce, the staff often reprints the dining menu immediately after lunch service.

Name: Bag of Beans
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 1998 by owner Charito Antiquera, Bag of Beans is a family-operated restaurant and cafe with multiple locations across Tagaytay in the Philippines.
The establishment pairs local and international cuisine with carefully designed interiors and outdoor garden seating.
Diners frequently visit the Charito branch to enjoy signature dishes like roasted spring chicken alongside panoramic views of the Taal Volcano.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Mosimann's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a converted nineteenth-century church in Belgravia, this private dining club is led by Royal Warrant holder Anton Mosimann OBE.
The kitchen serves a lighter style of cooking known as "Cuisine Naturelle" that avoids cream and butter to focus on natural flavors.
Private dining rooms are individually sponsored and designed by luxury houses like Lalique and Montblanc.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Maze Grill
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Modeled on the grill rooms of Manhattan, this polished steakhouse from Gordon Ramsay brings a New York aesthetic to the dining room.
The menu distinguishes itself by pairing traditional grilled cuts with a comprehensive selection of fresh sushi and sashimi.
Signature offerings include USDA Prime beef sourced from Creekstone Farms and a classic Beef Wellington served with peppercorn sauce.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Bookings of 6+ guests require card details to confirm your reservation. In the event that the booking is not honoured or is cancelled with less than 24 hours' notice, a cancellation fee of £25 per person will be charged to the card.

Name: Bar Termini
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Created by mixologist Tony Conigliaro and coffee expert Marco Arrigo, this diminutive Soho spot channels the spirit of a 1950s Italian railway station bar.
White-jacketed waiters navigate the intimate space, serving a streamlined menu that transitions seamlessly from morning espresso to evening aperitivo.
Settle into the pistachio leather banquettes to sip a signature bottle-aged Negroni, served chilled in a delicate custom glass.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If you are running late or won't be able to make your reservation please let us know via text or a phone call. Your table will be held for 10 minutes.

Name: Crocker's Folly
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by C.H. Worley, this Grade II* listed Victorian gin palace in St John's Wood is now a Lebanese restaurant run by Maroush.
The Northern Renaissance interior features elaborate marblework, cut glass, and mahogany, contrasting with the contemporary menu of mezze and grills.
Its name recalls the local legend that the venue was built to serve a railway terminus that was eventually constructed at Marylebone instead.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Saporitalia
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Run by a Neapolitan family, this understated pizzeria and trattoria sits along London’s Portobello Road.
The space pairs exposed brick with wooden furniture, providing a simple backdrop for traditional southern Italian cooking.
Mammoth wood-fired pizzas are handcrafted in an open kitchen, emerging as the undisputed highlight of the dining experience.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Buddha-Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in Paris in 1996 by Raymond Vișan, this global venue blends Pan-Asian dining with a cinematic, nightlife-driven atmosphere.
The space is defined by its grandiose interiors, Pacific Rim cuisine, and an electro-ethnic musical identity shaped by DJ Claude Challe.
A towering, gilded Buddha statue dominates the dining room, creating a dramatic backdrop for the signature Buddha-Bar Chicken Salad.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Credit card details are required to secure the booking. A fee of €50 per person is charged for no-shows or cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance.

Name: Benares
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London’s Mayfair, this Michelin-starred restaurant is led by Executive Chef Sameer Taneja, who pairs Indian heritage with British ingredients.
The kitchen delivers a modern interpretation of subcontinental cuisine, balancing traditional spices with precise, contemporary techniques.
Guests enter past a water feature adorned with floating flowers before settling in for signature dishes like the hand-dived Malabar scallop.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Enoteca Turi
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Giuseppe and Pamela Turi, this Pimlico Road establishment was a respected destination for regional Italian cuisine.
The venue was distinguished by its comprehensive all-Italian wine list, curated to showcase indigenous grape varieties from every province.
A signature offering was the pappardelle with Tuscan lamb ragu, often enjoyed alongside a recommendation from the knowledgeable sommelier team.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For bookings over 8 people, we request a deposit. To cancel or change an existing reservation, please call the restaurant on 020 7730 3663.

Name: Eataly
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Oscar Farinetti in Turin, this global Italian marketplace integrates retail, dining, and education under one roof.
The concept aligns with Slow Food principles, allowing visitors to shop for artisanal ingredients or dine at counters dedicated to specific regional traditions.
Its signature Spaghetto Eataly features Afeltra pasta and Così Com'è tomato sauce to illustrate the brand's focus on provenance and simplicity.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations cancelled within 24 hours may result in a $50 per person fee. Reservations are held for 15 minutes.

Name: Mano Mayfair
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Mill Street, this Brazilian-Japanese fusion concept is the work of Riviera entrepreneur Romain Fargette and *Top Chef Brazil* winner Luciana Berry.
The venue channels a St Tropez beach club energy, combining vibrant interiors with an atmosphere that evolves into late-night deep house DJ sets.
Signature sharing plates include hickory-smoked picanha with yakiniku sauce and truffle-topped cassava cheese bread, served alongside sake and cachaça-based cocktails.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Burger & Lobster
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Restaurateur Misha Zelman and three school friends founded this London-born concept to simplify the surf and turf experience to its absolute essentials.
The venue strips away menu clutter to focus exclusively on perfecting two premium ingredients in a lively, unpretentious setting.
Diners choose between a Nebraskan beef patty, whole wild lobster, or a lobster roll, with the seafood options paired with a signature lemon and garlic butter sauce.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND
