Name: Mina's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated inside Long Island City’s MoMA PS1, this all-day café is the first permanent restaurant from chef and author Mina Stone.
The kitchen focuses on Greek-inflected comfort food with a domestic sensibility, drawing on Stone’s experience cooking private lunches for the art world.
Artist Alex Da Corte designed the pastel interior, a vibrant backdrop for simple plates of braised meats and salads dressed in small-batch olive oil.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Ormer Mayfair
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within Flemings Mayfair Hotel, this Michelin-starred restaurant is under the direction of Executive Chef Sofian Msetfi.
The kitchen serves only tasting menus that interpret seasonal British produce through classical techniques and the chef's Irish and Moroccan roots.
A standout signature is the warm Ibérico ham jelly, finished with Parmesan, Bramley apple, and nasturtium.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We are now asking for card details to secure all Ormer Mayfair reservations. If you don't honour your booking without giving us 48 hours notice in advance, a fee of £75 for Dinner per person will be charged

Name: Beast
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a candlelit basement in Marylebone, this subterranean venue is operated by the group behind Goodman and Burger & Lobster.
Rows of long communal tables define the space, where the menu is dedicated entirely to Nebraskan steak and whole king crab.
Glass tanks filled with live Norwegian crustaceans line the walls, serving as a prelude to the shared platters of ribeye and grilled crab legs.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For groups we request a deposit of £50 per person, from 15 guests and more. We require 48 hours cancellation notice. In case of late cancellation the deposit is non-refundable with an option to keep it for the future booking.

Name: Gauthier Soho
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a converted townhouse in the heart of Soho, this elegant restaurant is led by chef Alexis Gauthier.
The kitchen applies classical French techniques to an entirely plant-based menu, challenging fine dining conventions with vegetable-forward creativity.
Expect a seasonal tasting menu featuring intricate plates such as the signature truffle tortellini or the celebrated "faux gras" terrine.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: No pre payment taken. Dietary requirements must be notified 48 hours in advance.

Name: Oblix
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on the 32nd floor of The Shard, this contemporary grill and lounge is the creation of Zuma founder Rainer Becker.
The venue is divided into a formal dining room and a livelier bar that both focus on open-fire cooking within a sophisticated, urban atmosphere.
Architect Claudio Silvestrin’s minimalist stone interiors frame the open kitchen, where chefs prepare signature dishes like whole suckling pig and rotisserie duck.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations cancelled with less than 24 hours' notice will result in a charge of £20 per person to the card provided.

Name: Gaucho
Master_Aurora_Insights:
This UK-based collection of Argentine steakhouses features distinctive, low-lit interiors updated by the award-winning studio DesignLSM.
The kitchen serves grass-fed Aberdeen Angus beef sourced from the Pampas, distinguished by its verified carbon-neutral status.
A signature service ritual involves the "Beef Board," where servers present raw cuts like the spiral-cut Churrasco to demonstrate flavor profiles before ordering.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Tables are held for 15 minutes. Cancellations or amendments must be made at least 48 hours in advance of the reservation time. Late cancellations or no-shows are subject to a fee (typically £25 per person).

Name: C London
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Mayfair, this bustling restaurant is operated by the Cipriani family, bringing their Venetian heritage to the British capital.
The wood-panelled dining room functions with the efficiency of a private club, where white-jacketed staff serve a menu of established Italian classics.
Regulars often finish with the vanilla meringue cake, a towering dessert that has become a verifiable signature of the kitchen.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Ognisko
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a grand Victorian townhouse on Exhibition Road, this South Kensington venue is the dining room of the historic Polish Hearth Club, led by restaurateur Jan Woroniecki.
The elegant, high-ceilinged space serves refined Eastern European classics, elevating traditional comfort food in a setting that balances old-world grandeur with relaxed energy.
A large terrace overlooking Prince's Gardens offers a rare al fresco spot, while the bar is renowned for its extensive selection of house-infused vodkas.

Name: NOPI
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in London’s Soho, this all-day brasserie operates as the full-service counterpart to Yotam Ottolenghi’s network of delis.
The menu integrates the group's trademark vegetable-centric approach with Southeast Asian influences, resulting in complex, spice-laden sharing plates.
Diners gather amidst white marble and brass to enjoy the enduring signature of courgette and manouri fritters with cardamom yogurt.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We have a 24 hours cancellation policy for bookings of 9 guests and below and a week notice for parties of 10 guests and above. We require credit card details to secure your reservation.

Name: Edera
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the coastal town of Moneglia on the Italian Riviera, this family-run boutique hotel is an intimate retreat managed by the Schiaffino family.
The property is defined by a deep connection to its landscape, blending a tranquil, adults-only atmosphere with terraced gardens that overlook the Mediterranean.
At the Michelin-starred restaurant Orto, chef Jorg Giubbani creates tasting menus centered on ingredients harvested daily from the hotel’s own vegetable plots.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Bar Trigona
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Ranked among Asia’s 50 Best Bars, this cocktail venue inside the Four Seasons Kuala Lumpur is a pioneer of sustainable mixology.
The menu is defined by a hyper-local ethos, utilizing every part of indigenous ingredients sourced directly from Malaysian farmers.
Signature cocktails highlight nectar from the native stingless bee, enjoyed within a gilded space designed by AB Concept.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Baduzzi
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Baduzzi is an Italian restaurant located in Auckland's Wynyard Quarter, established by proprietor Michael Dearth and chef Ben Bayley.
The indoor-outdoor venue pairs a retro-inspired interior with a menu focused on regional Italian fare.
The kitchen is particularly recognized for its signature handmade New York- and Sicilian-style meatballs, which anchor the daily menu.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For lunch reservations, a late cancellation fee of $10 per person applies if cancelled within 12 hours of the booking time. For dinner reservations, a cancellation fee of $25 per person applies for cancellations made within 12 hours or for no-shows. For large parties of 30 guests or more, a $1,000 deposit is required; cancellations made within 7 days of the booking forfeit the deposit, and cancellations within 48 hours may be charged the full menu cost.

Name: Kaktus Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in Istanbul’s bohemian Cihangir district, this established gathering place attracts a loyal crowd of local writers, actors, and creatives.
The venue operates as a versatile all-day anchor, shifting from a laid-back café serving Turkish breakfast to a spirited bar by evening.
Its most distinctive element is the colony of resident cats that lounge on the furniture, underscoring the space’s informal and community-focused spirit.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: El Pirata
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched on the rocky ledge of Cala Bonifaci in Roses, this enduring beach club acts as the spirited seaside annex of the Hotel Vistabella.
The atmosphere balances the Costa Brava’s rugged natural beauty with a high-octane social scene, where patrons frequently arrive by tender for long, wine-soaked lunches.
A signature ritual defines the summer weekends: the Sunday champagne party, which transforms the jetty into an effervescent celebration of music and magnums.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We operate a minimum 48-hour cancellation & amendment policy. Bookings of 6-10 guests are subject to a £15 per person card authorization. No money is taken from the card unless in the event of a no-show or a cancellation made within 48 hours of your booking date, which will result in a charge of £15 per person.

Name: Beige Alain Ducasse
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched on the top floor of the Chanel Ginza Building in Tokyo, this restaurant is a partnership between chef Alain Ducasse and the French fashion house.
The kitchen applies French culinary techniques to Japanese ingredients, utilizing a custom hearth to prepare meats and seasonal Kamakura vegetables.
Interiors by Peter Marino feature tweed-upholstered chairs, a fitting backdrop for the signature Carré Chanel, a gold-leafed chocolate praline square.
Master_Cancellation_Policy:
If you cancel on the day of your reservation, a cancellation fee will be charged for the course fee x number of the guests. The same applies to a decrease in the number of reservations. Reservations cannot be changed on the day; this constitutes a cancellation and a 100% cancellation fee will be charged. For cases of late arrival beyond the last seating time of last order (L.O), the reservation will be cancelled and a cancellation fee will be incurred.

For parties of 5 or more persons:
7 days before the reservation: 50% of the course fee
3 days before the reservation: 80% of the course fee
The day before or the day of the reservation: 100% of the course fee

Name: Dozo
Master_Aurora_Insights: DŌZO Japanese-American Kitchen, now at 1419 East Blvd, Dilworth, Charlotte, NC, is an izakaya-style restaurant from Katsu Kart creators Chef Perry Saito and Chef John Gamble. The Dilworth location seats 30-34 indoors plus a 30-seat patio, with a by-the-glass sake program and craft cocktails by local mixologist Sean Teague. Signature dishes include crab fried rice with blue crab and pork belly, okonomiyaki with cabbage, shrimp, and pork belly, and rotating A5 Wagyu gyudon with soy-cured egg yolk.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Groups of 8 or more require a $5.00 deposit. Cancellations within 4 hours incur a $10.00 fee per person. Any changes to reservations must be communicated 24 hours in advance to avoid additional charges. Any shortfall in guests will incur a $10.00 fee per missing guest.

Name: Titu
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Tucked away in Mayfair’s Shepherd Market, this intimate Japanese fusion restaurant is the solo project of New Zealand chef Jeff Tyler, formerly of Novikov.
The tiny fifteen-seat dining room offers a cosy, smart-casual setting for sharing small plates, a quiet contrast to the neighbourhood's larger venues.
Order the signature gyoza, instantly recognizable by the delicate filigree of lacy batter that links them together like a crisp, golden web.

Name: The Wigmore
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Regent Street attached to The Langham, this modern British tavern features interiors by Martin Brudnizki and a menu overseen by Michel Roux Jr.
Housed in a repurposed banking hall, the space balances high ceilings and original architectural details with the convivial atmosphere of a neighbourhood local.
Order the signature XXL stovetop three-cheese and mustard toastie, which arrives beneath a cast-iron press to ensure a crisp, molten finish.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Vasco & Piero's Pavilion
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Once a favourite of Princess Diana, this Umbrian restaurant was founded in 1971 by Vasco Matteucci and remains under the stewardship of his son Paul.
The kitchen prioritizes regional authenticity over trends, serving handmade pastas and simple, ingredient-led plates in a classic setting.
Regulars return for the signature calf’s liver with sage, a dish that exemplifies the venue’s commitment to traditional technique.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Truscott Arms
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the historic Truscott Arms site in Maida Vale, this restored venue is the latest project from the Public House group, the team behind The Pelican.
The dual-concept space features a traditional taproom for cask ales on the ground floor and a dining room upstairs for open-fire cooking.
A standout detail is the menu of British classics, including signature lamb ribs prepared directly over charcoal.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Tramp
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Jermyn Street in Mayfair, this legendary private members’ club has been revitalized by lifestyle entrepreneur Luca Maggiora to honor its 1969 origins.
The reimagined space balances a hedonistic heritage with a refined all-day atmosphere, serving as a discreet sanctuary for a carefully curated community.
Interiors by Campbell-Rey feature restored centuries-old wall panels and the original Zodiac ceiling, preserving the soul of its storied past.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Ten Bells
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by the London Beer Factory, this Grade II-listed Spitalfields institution has commanded the corner of Commercial Street since the mid-19th century.
The candlelit interior is defined by its preserved Victorian features, including elaborate floor-to-ceiling tiling and a bustling energy that evokes a bygone era.
A sprawling blue-and-white tile mural depicting 18th-century weavers anchors the main bar, offering a tangible link to the neighbourhood's industrial heritage.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Silver Birch
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Chiswick, this modern British restaurant was led by Michelin-listed chef Nathan Cornwell and named AA London Restaurant of the Year.
The independent neighbourhood venue served a seasonally driven menu within a natural, earthy space crafted by B3 Designers.
The interior featured cream walls accented by hanging kitchen spoons and a maple counter that doubled as a pass.

Name: Theo Randall
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in the InterContinental London Park Lane, this established dining room is led by Theo Randall, the former head chef who earned a Michelin star at The River Café.
The kitchen prioritizes rustic precision over trend, delivering a daily changing menu defined by seasonal sourcing and regional Italian provenance.
Regulars return for the handmade pasta, particularly the signature Cappelletti di Vitello filled with slow-cooked veal and finished with porcini mushrooms and butter.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Breakfast Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Jonathan Arana-Morton and Alison Rooney, this London-based group channels 1980s nostalgia with a vibrant, community-focused ethos.
The interiors feature egg-yolk yellow facades and retro memorabilia, setting the stage for an unpretentious all-day menu of comfort food classics.
For a hidden twist, guests at the Spitalfields outpost access the basement cocktail bar by stepping through a vintage Smeg fridge.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Social
Master_Aurora_Insights:
The Social London, at 5 Little Portland Street, Fitzrovia, is a two-floor independent bar and live music venue opened in 1999 by Heavenly Recordings, near Oxford Circus.
Cocktails, beer, wine, and Homeslice Pizza are served; the venue runs six days a week, Thursday to Friday until 1am.
The basement hosts gigs, DJ sets, club nights, film screenings, and literary events with partners including Faber Social, Trojan, The Quietus, and Rough Trade Books.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Tickets are non-refundable. Refunds for canceled shows are automatic, please allow up to 15 business days to see this reflected. No entry fees will be refunded following ejection or refused entry.

Name: Icebar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Constructed from natural Torne River ice by the creators of Sweden’s Icehotel, this sub-zero venue brings the Arctic to London.
The interior is maintained at minus five degrees Celsius, featuring walls and sculptures that are redesigned annually by international artists.
Guests wear thermal capes to drink from signature ice glasses, surrounded by evolving themes such as the recent Pangea design.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Refund request must be made prior to the reservation’s date. No refunds are given for requests made after the scheduled reservation.

Name: Simpson's in the Strand
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Revived by restaurateur Jeremy King, Simpson's in the Strand has returned to its historic home as a bastion of British dining.
The Grand Divan dining room retains its clubby, wood-panelled character while serving a menu of unpretentious national staples like mulligatawny soup.
Silver carving trolleys glide between tables to serve the signature roast beef and Yorkshire pudding with theatrical precision.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We ask that any cancellation or modification to your reservation be made no less than 24 hours prior. Should you fail to arrive for your reservation, you will be subject to a charge which will be applied to the credit card on file. Breakfast £15 per person. Lunch and Dinner £25 per person.

Name: Gelupo
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by chef Jacob Kenedy opposite his restaurant Bocca di Lupo, this Soho spot serves artisan gelato made with rigorous Italian techniques.
The kitchen prioritizes premium ingredients and sophisticated flavor profiles over sugary excess or novelty toppings.
While the fruit granitas are refreshing, the signature ricotta and sour cherry gelato is a defining classic known for its balance of creamy richness and tart fruit.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Haz
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by partners Haci, Ahmet, and Zafer, this City of London staple delivers modern Mediterranean cuisine rooted in authentic Turkish hospitality.
The dining rooms pair slick design with a menu of charcoal-grilled classics, serving as a backdrop for business lunches and evening gatherings.
Signature mezze and meats cooked over open flames define the experience, with the St Paul’s outpost offering a terrace overlooking the cathedral.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Electric Diner
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by the Soho House group, this Portobello Road venue sits adjacent to one of the oldest working cinemas in London.
The interior features exposed brickwork and red leather banquettes, offering a classic backdrop for a menu of French-American comfort food.
Unlike the private club upstairs, this space is open to the public and is known for its signature double cheeseburger.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Lunch: $10 per person cancellation fee for cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows.

Name: The Shard
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Italian architect Renzo Piano designed this 310-metre tower, which stands above London Bridge station as the United Kingdom's tallest building.
The tapering form houses offices, restaurants, and the Shangri-La hotel behind an angled glass façade inspired by historic church spires.
An open-air viewing gallery on level 72 features glass walls that terminate in open shards, allowing the elements to enter the building’s apex.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: All ticket sales are final and non-refundable. Dates and times can be amended provided the booked visit date and time has not passed, subject to availability and a processing fee of £15 per booking. If visibility is poor (unable to see at least three of five specific landmarks), a View Guarantee revisit voucher may be issued for a future return visit. Visitors arriving more than 15 minutes late are subject to a £15 re-booking charge and availability.

Name: The Sportsman
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched on the windswept marshes of Seasalter in Kent, this Michelin-starred pub is the vision of self-taught chef-patron Stephen Harris.
The kitchen practices a rigorous definition of terroir, sourcing ingredients primarily from the immediate estuary, garden, and surrounding farmland.
Signature slip sole grilled in seaweed butter exemplifies the hyper-local approach, accompanied by salt harvested from the sea just yards away.

Name: Tramshed
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a Grade II-listed former power station in Shoreditch, this historic venue is currently the UK flagship for Swiss manufacturer Vitra.
The adaptive reuse project by Waugh Thistleton Architects contrasts raw brickwork with refined interiors, offering a distinct space for design exhibitions.
Massive steel trusses from 1905 frame the skylit main hall, providing an industrial backdrop for the brand’s mid-century and contemporary collections.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Yeni
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Chef Civan Er brings the culinary philosophy of his Istanbul restaurant, Yeni Lokanta, to this modern Turkish outpost in London’s Soho.
The kitchen applies contemporary techniques to British produce, elevating Anatolian flavors through open-fire cooking rather than strict adherence to tradition.
A meal here is incomplete without the dried aubergine manti, small dumplings paired with a yoghurt sauce that balances their smoky intensity.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A cancellation fee of £30 per person applies to no-shows or late cancellations.

Name: Empire Empire
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Harneet Baweja of Gunpowder fame, this Notting Hill restaurant channels the nostalgic energy of the 1970s Indian disco era.
The kitchen revisits classic curry house staples with a menu focused on rich, slow-cooked dishes and substantial sharing plates.
A custom-made Marshall jukebox plays Bollywood disco tracks while diners enjoy the signature lobster biryani, served complete with the shell.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Inko Nito
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Conceived by Rainer Becker of Zuma and Roka fame, this casual Japanese restaurant centers on the energy of an open robata grill.
The kitchen serves unconventional dishes that blend traditional charcoal cooking with bold Korean spices and citrus notes.
A signature highlight is the nigaki, a distinct sushi style featuring roasted nori and warm rice topped with ingredients like yellowtail and wasabi shiso.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Regrettably, it has become necessary to implement a cancellation policy on all online & large party bookings, therefore card details are taken. There is no charge to the card unless you cancel your reservation with 24 hours' notice or less, or the party fails to attend their booking, where a charge of £20 per person will be incurred.

Name: Seahorse
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the W Union Square, this polished seafood brasserie comes from restaurateur John McDonald and architect David Rockwell.
The maritime-inflected interior sets a refined stage for Chef John Villa’s menu of Greenmarket-driven coastal fare and pristine crudo.
A surrealist 40-foot mural by studio En Viu anchors the room, creating a dramatic backdrop for signature sea urchin toasts.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Smoking Goat
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Restaurateur Ben Chapman’s Shoreditch canteen channels the energy of Bangkok’s late-night spots with a focus on wood-fired Thai barbecue using British produce.
The industrial space is anchored by a central open kitchen where chefs work over charcoal grills to produce smoky, spice-laden plates.
Regulars swear by the signature fish sauce wings, which arrive sticky with caramelized palm sugar and chili.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Veeraswamy
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Overlooking Regent Street, the UK’s oldest Indian restaurant was founded in 1926 by Edward Palmer and currently holds a Michelin star.
The interiors pay homage to its royal history with silver-clad ceilings, 1920s velvet, and a cabinet of maharaja-era artefacts.
A standout dish is the Patiala Shahi Raan, a slow-braised lamb shank wrapped in golden puff pastry, served in the dining room.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Your card will not be charged providing you cancel or reduce numbers at least 12 hours prior to your reservation using the “cancel” or “manage” reservation buttons in the reservation confirmation email. A cancellation fee of £30 per person will be charged if this does not occur.

Name: Noble Rot
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Dan Keeling and Mark Andrew, this London destination extends the ethos of their eponymous magazine into a serious culinary haunt.
The space channels a Parisian cave à manger, prioritizing an unpretentious atmosphere and a curated wine program over white-tablecloth formality.
A signature slip sole with smoked butter is the standout dish, perfectly accompanying the list of rare and undervalued vintages.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Plans changed? No problem - just let us know at least 24 hours in advance. We take card details to secure bookings, for cancellations made within 6 hours of your reservation a £50 charge will automatically be applied per person.

Name: The Shed
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Anchoring New York's Hudson Yards, this kinetic cultural center is the work of lead architects Diller Scofidio + Renfro and collaborator Rockwell Group.
The flexible venue serves as an infrastructure for performance and visual art, characterized by a movable shell made of translucent polymer cushions.
This telescoping outer layer glides on industrial rails to double the building's footprint and create a fully enclosed, climate-controlled hall.

Name: Rudy's Pizza Napoletana
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in Manchester’s Ancoats neighborhood by Jim Morgan and Kate Wilson, this pizzeria is consistently ranked among the world's best by 50 Top Pizza.
The kitchen adheres to strict Neapolitan tradition, double-fermenting dough for 24 hours before baking it in 60 seconds for a soft, pliable base.
Its signature crust, made with Caputo '00' flour, is light and floppy, requiring diners to fold their slices or use a knife and fork.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Square
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a Georgian townhouse on Bristol’s historic Berkeley Square, this private members’ club and boutique hotel is a sanctuary for the city’s creative class.
The venue blends a workspace with a social hub, featuring a rotating art collection, a seasonal kitchen, and a lower-deck cocktail bar.
A standout feature is the Secret Garden, a heated, covered terrace adorned with foliage that offers an alfresco escape regardless of the season.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Kindly note, if you cancel with less than 12 hours' notice, or failure to attend, will incur a cancellation fee of £15 per person to the card provided.

Name: Cahoots
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Tucked beneath London’s Kingly Court, this 1940s-themed venue from the Inception Group inhabits a former air-raid shelter styled as a vintage Tube station.
The space commits to its post-war narrative with tiled walls, staff in period dress, and a soundtrack of live swing and jazz.
Guests sit within a vintage subway carriage while enjoying cocktails served in period-specific vessels like thermos flasks and milk bottles.

Name: The Sloane Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 1922 by Princess Helena for ex-service women, this Chelsea landmark has evolved into a spirited private members' club.
Recently reimagined by Russell Sage Studio, the interiors combine the comfort of a country house with a refined Chelsea mews aesthetic.
Bespoke headboards in the bedrooms echo the club’s oval cameo motif, adding a subtle, historical nod to the design.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Shannons
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Tokyo’s Gate City Osaki complex, this Irish pub brings authentic Celtic culture to the Shinagawa district.
The venue is defined by its traditional atmosphere, offering an extensive selection of craft beers, Guinness, and Irish whiskeys.
Patrons can enjoy drinks on the terrace overlooking the Sunken Garden, a spacious courtyard that offers a quiet urban escape.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Yeni Lokanta
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Istanbul’s Beyoğlu district, this Michelin-recognized stalwart is the flagship of Chef Civan Er, who champions a sophisticated take on Anatolian cuisine.
The kitchen bridges traditional Turkish recipes with contemporary techniques, utilizing a wood-fired oven to add depth to regional ingredients.
A defining ritual is ordering the signature dried aubergine manti dumplings, served in a rich Antiochian yoghurt sauce that perfectly balances savory and tart notes.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: In case of cancellations made less than 24 hours prior to the reservation time, as well as no-show situations, the provision amount is non-refundable. If we do not receive your confirmation by 4:00 PM on the day of your reservation, your booking will be canceled.

Name: Dove
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Road Town, Tortola, this intimate dining venue occupies a beautifully renovated historic West Indian cottage.
The kitchen delivers a modern international menu that balances fresh Caribbean ingredients with precise, global techniques.
A standout feature is the Dragonfly Lounge, an atmospheric space for craft cocktails set amidst the building’s traditional architectural details.

Name: Barrafina
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by brothers Sam and Eddie Hart, this Spanish tapas destination brings the bustling counter-dining tradition of Barcelona to London.
The layout features a long marble bar and open kitchen where chefs prepare regional small plates in full view of the diners.
A standout dish is the signature loose-centered tortilla, often ordered alongside fresh seafood like grilled red prawns or milk-fed lamb kidneys.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours before the booking time. Card details are required to secure the reservation. Cancellations can be made via the 'Cancel Reservation' link in the confirmation email.

Name: Serpentine Galleries
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in Kensington Gardens, this dual-site institution encompasses the original 1934 tea pavilion and the Zaha Hadid-designed North Gallery.
With no permanent collection, the destination is defined by its pioneering contemporary art exhibitions and the annual architectural pavilion commission.
A signature element is The Magazine restaurant, where diners sit beneath Hadid’s undulating white canopy with views of the surrounding Royal Park.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Free tickets may be cancelled or exchanged dependent on availability and at the discretion of Serpentine. Unfortunately, we cannot offer refunds on paid tickets unless Serpentine is closed due to an emergency, or if an event (or exhibition time slot) is cancelled by Serpentine. Serpentine is unable to refund donations made as part of any ticket purchase. Tickets will not be cancelled or refunded as a result of adverse weather conditions if an event or exhibition still goes ahead.

Name: Casa do Frango
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Marco Mendes and Jake Kasumov, this Algarvian restaurant brings the relaxed atmosphere of southern Portugal to London.
The kitchen prioritizes regional authenticity, offering shareable plates and charcoal-grilled specialties without unnecessary fuss or modern reinvention.
Its signature free-range chicken is brushed with piri-piri and cooked over wood charcoal, delivering a smoky depth that defines the menu.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Hispania
Master_Aurora_Insights: Housed within the historic Lloyds Bank building in the City of London, this ambitious gastronomic project is helmed by Michelin-starred Asturian chef Marcos Morán. The sprawling venue delivers an authoritative survey of regional cuisine within a sophisticated space designed by Lorenzo Castillo. While the ground floor offers excellent tapas, the upstairs dining room serves Morán’s legendary *fabada asturiana*, a rich bean stew perfected over five generations.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: 24-hour cancellation policy. Late cancellations or no-shows are subject to a £20 per person fee.

Name: Pantechnicon
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Belgravia’s Motcomb Street, this Grade II-listed former arts and crafts warehouse has been reimagined by Sunset Hospitality Group as a multi-level dining destination.
Behind a grand neoclassical façade of Doric columns, the venue now hosts the Japanese restaurant Sachi, late-night lounge Luum, and Café Kitsuné.
Its name, derived from Greek for "all the arts," became the standard term for furniture vans, a legacy contrasting with its modern culinary focus.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Barrica
Master_Aurora_Insights: Located in the heart of Porto, this intimate restaurant is led by Chef Bruno de Jesus and operates under the YoursPorto hospitality group. The kitchen celebrates Portuguese terroir through a modern lens, pairing contemporary plates with a curated list of regional wines. A standout feature is the surprise tasting menu, where guests entrust their palate to the chef for a sequence of courses revealed only upon service.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: La Fromagerie
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Patricia Michelson, this independent retailer operates as a cheesemonger and seasonal café across its Marylebone, Highbury, and Bloomsbury locations.
The spaces are defined by temperature-controlled walk-in cheese rooms and a market-style layout pairing farmhouse cheeses with specialty breads and produce.
A signature experience involves tasting the Beaufort Chalet d’Alpage, the mountain cheese that inspired Michelson to launch the business from her garden shed.

Name: Barrio
Master_Aurora_Insights: INCOMPLETE — Missing: location, operator or creator, defining character or offering, and a concrete signature detail (such as a design feature, ritual, or standout fact).
Master_Cancellation_Policy: You may cancel your booking up to 14 days before the Arrival Date (21 days for Group Bookings of 6 or more people) by providing written notice. Deposits are refunded solely at the discretion of the manager. If a booking is cancelled within 14 days (or 21 days for groups) of the Arrival Date, or in the event of a no-show, any deposit paid is non-refundable and/or the credit or debit card provided may be charged.

Name: 100 Hoxton
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a former council housing office on Hoxton Street, this Filipino-fusion restaurant is led by ex-NOPI chef Francis Puyat.
Interiors by Yaojen Chuang feature polished concrete and low-hanging lights, creating a stark yet inviting backdrop for the sharing menu.
The standout offering is the Boodle Fight, a communal feast piled high on banana leaves and eaten exclusively with your hands.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Lunch: £10 per person cancellation fee for cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Dinner: £25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations or no-shows.

Name: Rib Room
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Anchored within the Omni Royal Orleans, this French Quarter steakhouse has remained the preferred midday gathering spot for politicians and power brokers for over six decades.
The atmosphere is defined by its wood-paneled interior, open rotisserie kitchen, and floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the passersby on Royal Street.
For a true local ritual, order the massive Washbucket Martini, a Friday tradition served alongside the slow-roasted prime rib.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A cancellation fee of £10 per person applies to reservations cancelled within the notice period or with no notice. Large tables of 7+ guests are required to give a minimum of 24 hours' notice.

Name: L'Entrecôte
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Paul Gineste de Saurs in 1959, this Parisian institution is defined by its single-minded focus on steak frites.
The service offers no menu, presenting only a walnut salad followed by cuts of sirloin and golden fries.
Servers in traditional black dresses deliver the meal in two stages, dousing it in the house’s secret, greenish herb-butter sauce.

Name: Bleecker Burger
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by former corporate lawyer Zan Kaufman, this London favorite has earned global acclaim for its uncompromising approach to the American burger.
The defining character is a commitment to dry-aged beef, cooked medium-rare and served on a toasted sesame bun with no unnecessary garnishes.
A standout detail is the patty itself, a dry-aged blend that delivers an intensely savory, steak-like flavor profile.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: No bookings taken; walk-in or click & collect only.

Name: Maddox Tavern
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a restored 19th-century building on Maddox Street, this all-day Mayfair brasserie is led by head chef Jon Grimes.
The interior merges the relaxed energy of a New York tavern with the heritage of a classic London institution.
Dining unfolds across four discrete spaces within the former tailor's shop, where original wood paneling frames a menu of oysters and Welsh rarebit.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Marylebone Farmers' Market
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Run by London Farmers Markets, this Sunday fixture transforms Aybrook Street into a dedicated showcase for British agriculture.
The strictly producer-only policy ensures transparency, with stalls offering a seasonal edit of heritage meats, artisan cheeses, and organic vegetables.
Regulars make a beeline for The Potato Shop to secure rare tuber varieties, a consistent highlight of this neighborhood institution.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Ivy Kensington Brasserie
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Brought to Brompton Road by Caprice Holdings, this all-day brasserie translates the heritage of its West Street forebear into a refined neighbourhood format.
Martin Brudnizki’s interiors define the space, layering Art Deco references with leather banquettes, antique mirrors, and brass detailing.
The menu centers on established classics, most notably the signature shepherd’s pie made with slow-braised lamb and beef.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Rasa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Burlingame, California, Rasa is an Indian restaurant founded by Ajay Walia that became the state's first Indian concept to earn a Michelin star.
The kitchen focuses on South Indian coastal cuisine, preparing regional recipes with sustainable ingredients.
The bi-level dining room features modern chandeliers and serves signature dishes like halibut pollichathu and the white-elephant butter paper dosa.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For any reservation, we require a credit card on file. Cancellations or changes can be made up to 24 hours before your reservation without any charge. Cancellations within 24 hours are subject to a $25 per person fee.

Name: Le Vacherin
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Chiswick, this AA Rosette-awarded bistro by Executive Chef Marc Wainwright brings the spirit of a Parisian brasserie to West London.
The interior features Belle Époque styling and mirrored walls, setting the stage for a menu rooted in traditional French techniques and seasonal ingredients.
A standout finish to the meal is the signature vacherin dessert, a delicate meringue creation crafted by pastry chef Claire Dubois.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For tables of 5 or more, credit card details are required, and the restaurant reserves the right to charge a cancellation fee of £20 per person for a no-show or if the cancellation is made so late that the table cannot be re-sold on the same terms. If the table is re-sold, no charge is made. For event dinners, a £20 deposit per person is required; if the table is not cancelled at least 48 hours in advance, the full amount of the deposit will be retained.

Name: The Chelsea Gardener
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Established by the Fenwick family in 1984, this Chelsea destination occupies a site on Sydney Street.
The grounds function as a calm retreat, stocking specimen plants alongside a refined edit of outdoor furniture.
A handsome glass orangery anchors the site, serving as a showroom that transforms into an atmospheric event venue.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE

Name: Signor Sassi
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in Knightsbridge in 1984, this enduring Italian restaurant is owned and operated by the San Carlo Group.
The dining room is defined by a spirited, bustling atmosphere where career waiters attend to a loyal crowd of international regulars.
While the menu covers the entire peninsula, the signature spaghetti lobster served in the shell remains the perennial favorite.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Nag's Head
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Tucked away in a Belgravia mews, this steadfastly traditional pub has been stewarded for decades by former Scots Guard Kevin Moran.
The interior serves as a defiant time capsule, strictly prohibiting mobile phones to preserve an atmosphere of conversation and crackling open fires.
Amidst the low-lit clutter of curiosities and pewter tankards, the space features a working collection of vintage penny-arcade machines.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Deposits are non-refundable. Cancellations made with less than 24 hours' notice are liable for full payment of food.

Name: Kazu
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Montreal’s Shaughnessy Village, this compact izakaya is led by Chef Kazuhiro Okochi, a veteran of the city’s acclaimed Toqué!.
The no-reservations spot is defined by its perpetual sidewalk queue and a frenetic atmosphere where handwritten specials cover the walls.
A standout is the signature shrimp burger, a textural masterpiece featuring a crisp tiger prawn patty and spicy mayo on a soft bun.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: No Reservations

Name: Noura
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Established in 1989 by the Bou Antoun family, this Parisian institution anchors the Place de Beyrouth as a culinary embassy for Lebanese culture.
The recently renovated space by architect Laura Gonzalez blends the warmth of a Beirut home with the polish of a French brasserie.
Diners indulge in a ritual of generous mezzes and charcoal-grilled meats, often concluding with the celebrated artisanal rose-petal ice cream.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Ace Hotel
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 1999 by Alex Calderwood, Ace Hotel is a collection of boutique properties featuring architectural contributions from firms like Kengo Kuma and Associates.
The brand adapts historic buildings into neighborhood hubs, emphasizing open lobby spaces that function as communal work areas.
Guest rooms frequently include acoustic guitars and turntables with curated vinyl collections, while vintage photobooths remain a staple of the ground floor.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Our modification and cancellation terms vary per rate plan booked. Please refer to the reservation policies while you are making your reservation. Reservations must be guaranteed with a credit or debit card at the time of booking. Payment is taken upon check-out unless stated otherwise.

Name: Boxpark
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Launched by Roger Wade and designed by Waugh Thistleton Architects, this Shoreditch venue is the world’s first pop-up mall.
The industrial complex repurposes shipping containers to house a rotating mix of independent fashion brands and street-food vendors.
The structure utilizes sixty stacked units to create a dual-level layout with a ground floor for shops and an upper deck for dining.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE

Name: Phoenix Palace
Master_Aurora_Insights:
From the team behind Potluck Club comes this spirited Cantonese American spot on the Bowery, injecting fresh energy into New York’s Chinatown.
The dining room features scalloped velvet booths and turquoise lanterns, setting the stage for a menu that playfully remixes traditional flavors with Italian accents.
Order the lobster sticky rice, a standout dish featuring fried lobster and pancetta that perfectly encapsulates the kitchen’s bold, cross-cultural approach.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72-hour cancellation policy.

Name: Cicchetti
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Owned by the Distefano family’s San Carlo Group, this polished London destination elevates the casual spirit of a traditional Venetian bacaro.
Interiors by architecture studio Fettle evoke the glamour of water taxis through high-gloss mahogany, brass accents, and pale marble.
The bustling, all-day atmosphere is best experienced while sharing signature plates like the truffle and pecorino ravioli.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Beauchamp
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on Knightsbridge’s Beauchamp Place, this multi-level venue from the Jak’s group houses a pub, restaurant, and late-night lounge.
The interiors display an eclectic mix of furniture and art, while the kitchen serves a range of British staples alongside Mediterranean pasta and pizza.
A subterranean bar anchors the experience, offering a dedicated space for evening cocktails and DJ sets that continue until midnight.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: 28-50 Wine Workshop & Kitchen
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Led by a team of expert sommeliers, this London collection of wine workshops pairs seasonal modern European cuisine with a comprehensive wine program.
Interiors blend industrial-chic elements like oak tables and wine crate displays to create a relaxed backdrop for the French bistro-style menu.
A standout feature is the 'Collectors’ List,' allowing guests to sample rare and fine wines by the glass.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For bookings from 5pm on Friday and 12pm on Saturday, we require credit card details to secure your booking. If you wish to cancel or amend your booking, please call us at least 24 hours before your reserved time. A cancellation fee of £10 per person will apply after this time. For groups of 8 and over we require credit card details to secure your reservation.

Name: Bubala
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Marc Summers, this vegetarian Middle Eastern concept has grown from a pop-up to established venues in Spitalfields, Soho, and King's Cross.
The kitchen utilizes charcoal grills to produce complex, vegetable-forward sharing plates that rely on texture and spice rather than meat substitutes.
The menu is anchored by the signature confit potato latkes, served crispy with a side of toum.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We will hold your table for a 15 mins grace period. Please email us at reservations@bubala.co.uk, or send a message through OpenTable if you are running late, as we do not have a phone number.

Name: 108 Brasserie
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set on Marylebone Lane, this all-day dining room is part of The Doyle Collection and features interiors by Alexander Waterworth.
The space is defined by a classic brasserie aesthetic with oxblood leather banquettes, warm wood, and marble surfaces.
A custom copper still named Isabella produces the house signature 108 Gin, which anchors the cocktail list.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For no shows or late cancellations, you will be subject to fee of £25 per person that will be applied to the credit card on file. Your reservation will be held for fifteen minutes beyond the time booked.

Name: The Bar at The Athenaeum
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within the five-star Athenaeum Hotel on Piccadilly, this venue was reimagined by Kinnersley Kent Design to evoke the ease of a private members’ club.
The space combines contemporary interiors with a warm atmosphere, serving as a quiet retreat from Mayfair’s bustle for speciality coffee or evening drinks.
Glass cabinets display the defining feature: a curated collection of over 100 rare and independent whiskies offered alongside cheese pairings in guided masterclasses.

Name: Caffè Stern
Master_Aurora_Insights: Located within the historic Passage des Panoramas, this Venetian-style café occupies a 19th-century engraver’s workshop reimagined by the Alajmo brothers and designer Philippe Starck. The interior balances heritage and wit, pairing the site’s original cabinetry and embossed Cordoba leather walls with winged mirrors and theatrical details. A stuffed wolf wearing a rhinestone collar stands guard near the entrance, while the kitchen serves Venetian classics like steamed pizza and dill tagliolini.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: In case of booking a meal at one of our restaurants, the Customer, by confirming with the references of his credit card, expressly accepts that (a) in case of cancellation at least 72 hours before the day on which the reservation refers, to be charged on the credit card indicated as guarantee an amount equal to 50% of the order; (b) in case of cancellation of less than 72 hours but more than 24 hours, he will be charged an amount equal to 80% of the order and (c) in case of no-show (so-called "no show") or cancellation with notice less than 24 hours will be charged the full amount of the order.

Name: Bouillon Pigalle
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Spearheaded by the Moussié brothers, this bustling Pigalle outpost is credited with reigniting the city’s craze for the traditional working-class bouillon.
The vast, two-story dining hall captures the democratic spirit of the genre with fast-paced service, affordable classics, and a convivial atmosphere.
Settle into a red banquette or the rare upstairs terrace to order the celebrated oeuf mayonnaise, a former world champion dish.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations are held for 15 minutes past the scheduled time; after this grace period, the table is released. No specific cancellation fee or credit card hold is required for standard reservations.

Name: The Dandelion
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in the quiet town of Villa Guardia near Lake Como, this independent boutique hotel resides within a converted historic courtyard estate.
The design pairs original architectural details like exposed brick with vintage furnishings, industrial accents, and rich fabrics.
The property is anchored by a large private park, offering a secluded garden setting that connects the suites to the on-site Arabella restaurant.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Coburg Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Overlooking Carlos Place, this intimate Mayfair lounge at The Connaught is the work of Parisian architect India Mahdavi.
The space functions as the hotel’s living room, combining velvet wingback chairs and linen-paneled walls to create a quiet, library-like atmosphere.
A menu of rare vintages accompanies the room's mix of silver leaf accents and Julian Opie’s pop-art portraits.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Coburg Bar operates a no reservation policy for all-day dining and drinks.

Name: Le Grand Restaurant
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Paris’s Golden Triangle, this two-Michelin-starred restaurant is the flagship address of chef Jean-François Piège.
The intimate dining room centers on an open kitchen beneath a sculptural glass ceiling that defines the marble-and-wood interior.
A signature highlight is the sweetbreads cooked on walnut shells, served on custom tableware to reflect the chef's focus on slow-cooked modern dishes.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Circolo Popolare
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Paris’s 2nd arrondissement, this buzzing trattoria from the Big Mamma group brings a slice of Naples to the French capital.
The space is defined by its electric atmosphere and long communal tables that encourage a shared dining experience.
Diners enjoy authentic wood-fired Margherita pizza beneath walls stacked floor-to-ceiling with over 15,000 bottles.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We kindly ask that any cancellation of your reservation be made no less than 48 hours prior. For no-shows or late cancellations, you will be subject to a fee of £20 per person that will be applied to your credit card.

Name: Donovan Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Mayfair’s Brown’s Hotel, this bar is directed by mixologist Salvatore Calabrese.
The interior is dedicated to British photographer Terence Donovan, featuring his black-and-white prints from the 1960s on every wall.
A semi-private alcove known as the "Naughty Corner" displays the artist’s risqué works and serves as a discreet setting for Calabrese’s signature Breakfast Martini.

Name: The Berkeley Bar & Terrace
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by Bryan O'Sullivan Studio, this Knightsbridge venue combines a refined interior bar with an intimate outdoor terrace.
The main room centers on a half-moon marble bar and wall paneling crafted from a single 300-year-old walnut tree.
A secluded "Snug" serves as a private retreat, distinguished by a pastel-toned mural of female faces painted by artist TM Davy.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: The Berkeley Bar and Terrace operates a no reservation policy. Please note there is a minimum spend of £50 per person for outdoor seating.

Name: Vesper Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
This cocktail destination within The Dorchester features interiors by designer Martin Brudnizki and a menu curated by head bartender Lucia Montanelli.
The space honors the hotel’s long-standing connection to James Bond author Ian Fleming through a mood of 1930s glamour and cinematic nostalgia.
A memorable serve is the License to Chill, which arrives with a golden cacao bullet embedded in a block of ice.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Trente-Trois
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Hidden within the discreet Maison Villeroy in Paris’s Golden Triangle, this intimate dining room is orchestrated by Michelin-starred chef Sébastien Sanjou.
The kitchen presents a refined interpretation of contemporary French cuisine, blending classical technique with lighter Mediterranean influences in a wainscoted Belle Époque setting.
Guests dine at just seven tables on historic oak parquet, where the concise menu changes weekly to reflect market availability.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Accents Table Bourse
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located near the Bourse in Paris, this Michelin-starred restaurant is led by Chef Romain Mahi and pastry chef-owner Ayumi Sugiyama.
The kitchen delivers a distinct Franco-Japanese menu where classic French techniques meet roasted aromas and precise Asian sensibilities.
Meals conclude with the signature sugar bubble, a delicate sphere containing unexpected savory-sweet pairings like green tomato and basil.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Don Juan II
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Moored at Port Debilly, this Art Deco yacht hosts a gastronomic cruise along the Seine under the direction of chef Frédéric Anton.
The intimate interior features mahogany wainscoting and thick carpets, creating a refined setting that feels more like a private club than a riverboat.
Service unfolds as the vessel glides past illuminated landmarks, securing its status as the only Michelin-starred dining experience on the river.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A partial prepayment is requested at the time of booking. There is no penalty for cancellations made more than 48 hours before the service. For cancellations made 48 hours or less before the service or in case of a no-show, the down payment will be kept. For special dates (e.g., Valentine’s Day, Bastille Day, Christmas Eve, New Year’s Eve), bookings are non-cancellable and non-refundable.

Name: The Good Front Room
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Chef Dom Taylor helms this modern Caribbean residency at The Langham, secured after winning the TV series Five Star Kitchen.
Named for the West Indian tradition of a parlour reserved for guests, the concept merges family heritage with classical culinary technique.
The menu features dark rum and raisin pork belly served within the Palm Court, contrasting bold island spices with the room's Victorian grandeur.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Berkeley Rooftop Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located at the pinnacle of The Berkeley in Knightsbridge, this alfresco destination commands sweeping views over Hyde Park and the Belgravia skyline.
The seasonal venue turns the hotel’s pool terrace into a relaxed lounge, furnished with signature striped sunbeds and abundant greenery.
While the heated pool is reserved for residents, evening visitors can access the rooftop for sunset spritzes and a rotating menu of small plates.

Name: American Bar at The Savoy
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within The Savoy, this venue is London's longest-surviving cocktail bar and a past winner of the World's Best Bar award.
The Art Deco interior features white-jacketed bartenders, Terry O'Neill photographs, and a pianist playing American jazz seven nights a week.
Its legacy is anchored by the Hanky Panky, a signature fernet-based cocktail created on-site by head bartender Ada Coleman in the early 1900s.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Apicius
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within the historic Hôtel de Talhouët-Roy, this Michelin-starred destination is helmed by chef Mathieu Pacaud.
The interiors pair 18th-century grandeur with contemporary design, creating a sophisticated backdrop for haute French gastronomy.
Its most distinct feature is the sprawling garden terrace, a rare open-air sanctuary for dining in the heart of the 8th arrondissement.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: No-show fee of €50 if the reservation is guaranteed by credit card.

Name: Café du Coin
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Restaurateur Florent Ciccoli oversees this corner bistro situated in the Popincourt neighborhood of Paris's 11th arrondissement.
The kitchen presents a rotating chalkboard menu of affordable, market-driven French plates served within a relaxed dining room centered around a long bar.
A meal often begins with the house signature pizzetta, a crisp tart topped with seasonal ingredients like olives, anchovies, or fresh herbs.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Ze Kitchen Galerie
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Paris's 6th arrondissement, Ze Kitchen Galerie is a Michelin-starred restaurant led by chef William Ledeuil.
The menu merges French culinary techniques with Southeast Asian ingredients like galangal, turmeric, and wasabi.
The dining room features colorful paintings by jazz musician Daniel Humair and a windowed kitchen that allows guests to watch the staff at work.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Wine Vault at The Dorchester
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Hidden within the working kitchens of The Dorchester, this modern tasting room serves as a private enclave for oenophiles.
A bespoke handcrafted walnut table anchors the space, surrounded by a collection of over 1,000 bottles.
Private tastings for up to 12 guests offer a rare glimpse behind the scenes, often led by the Head of Wines.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Beaufort Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Recognized by 50Best Discovery, this Art Deco venue within London’s The Savoy serves as a counterpart to the hotel’s American Bar.
The space is defined by a jet-black and burnished gold interior scheme that frames an extensive selection of champagne and original cocktails.
Constructed on the hotel’s original cabaret stage, the room honors this history with its theatrical layout and conceptual menus.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: This bar operates a walk-in policy. A limited number of online reservations are available for up to two people only.

Name: Arpège
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in Paris, this three-Michelin-starred destination is led by Chef Alain Passard, who shifted his culinary focus from rotisserie meats to vegetables in 2001.
The menu relies on produce delivered daily from the chef's own gardens, treating plants with the same reverence typically reserved for fine proteins.
A signature amuse-bouche is the hot-cold egg, featuring a warm yolk and cold cream seasoned with maple syrup and sherry vinegar.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Once the reservation is confirmed, you have the possibility to modify it up to a period of 2 working days before the date of the reservation. In case of cancellation of your reservation within a period of 2 days before it, your credit card will not be charged. In case of cancellation of your reservation in a shorter period of time or in case of a no-show, we inform you that we will debit the following sums: for lunch, the sum of 200 euros per cover multiplied by the number of covers of the reservation; for the reservation of a dinner, the sum of 400 euros per cover multiplied by the number of covers of the reservation. In the event that the number of guests is less than the number indicated at the time of booking or its subsequent update, we also reserve the right to debit the bank details provided with the sum of 200 euros multiplied by the number of absent guests.

Name: Pavillon Ledoyen
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a Neoclassical pavilion in the Jardins des Champs-Élysées, this three-Michelin-starred destination is the culinary laboratory of chef Yannick Alléno.
The kitchen reimagines French haute cuisine through a patented "Extraction" technique that concentrates flavors into sauces of remarkable purity and depth.
A standout dish is the signature "Badaboum" egg, served with caviar and smoked cream to create a surprise burst of flavor.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Aldehyde
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Marais just steps from the Seine, this Michelin-starred restaurant is the work of Tunisian-born chef Youssef Marzouk.
The kitchen merges classical French technique with North African heritage to create precise, aromatic tasting menus.
Named after a molecule found in coriander, the venue centers on an open kitchen where the chef plates courses inspired by his childhood memories.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Claridge's Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by the David Collins Studio, this Art Deco space sits within the ground floor of the historic Mayfair hotel.
The bar is defined by its extensive collection of vintage champagnes and rare spirits, served alongside classic cocktails.
Order the signature Flapper, a champagne-based tribute to the 1920s, to enjoy amidst the room's red leather banquettes.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Bar Nouveau
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Marais, this intimate venue is a tribute to the Art Nouveau movement from bartender Rémy Savage and his partners.
The split-level concept offers two distinct experiences, with a ground floor focusing on pre-industrial techniques and a basement dedicated to modern technology.
The menu features a variation of the Ramos Gin Fizz made with vanilla yogurt, peat, and St-Germain liqueur.

Name: L'Ambroisie
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Anchored in the historic Place des Vosges, this bastion of French gastronomy was established by Bernard Pacaud and is now led by chef Shintaro Awa.
The kitchen maintains an uncompromising dedication to classical techniques and sourcing, prioritizing timeless excellence over fleeting culinary trends.
Dining in the tapestry-lined salon features the celebrated feuillantine of langoustines with sesame and curry sauce, a dish that defines the restaurant’s precise aesthetic.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Credit card imprint required. Please note that in the event of a no-show or late cancellation (less than a week before the booking date), 400 € per person will be charged to the credit card provided.

Name: Nomicos
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in the 16th arrondissement of Paris, this Michelin-starred restaurant is the personal showcase of Chef Jean-Louis Nomicos, who brings his Mediterranean roots to the capital.
The contemporary dining room features glass bubbles by artist Etienne Gillabert, creating a luminous backdrop for the chef's technical, flavor-focused cuisine.
A defining highlight is the macaroni with black truffles and duck foie gras, a signature creation that has become a permanent fixture on the menu.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Casa Pregonda
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Paris’s 2nd arrondissement, this Spanish restaurant from chef Alexandre Giesbert serves cuisine inspired by the Balearic island of Menorca.
The white and wood-paneled interior evokes a Mediterranean seaside home, focusing on seafood and simple preparation.
A standout meal includes the signature creamy tortilla or bluefish tuna crudo paired with a gin pomada.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Le Petit Cler
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Le Petit Cler is a relaxed bistro on the pedestrian Rue Cler, operated by the family behind the nearby institution La Fontaine de Mars.
The kitchen prepares traditional French fare at accessible prices, fostering a lively atmosphere that serves as a reliable local canteen.
Claim a table on the terrace to enjoy a croque madame or roasted duck breast while watching the daily activity of the market street.

Name: Aux Lyonnais
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Overseen by Alain Ducasse, this historic bistro in Paris’s 2nd arrondissement occupies a former 1890s coal depot turned culinary landmark.
The spirited dining room preserves a 1900s aesthetic with vintage tilework and mirrors, acting as a faithful embassy for traditional Lyonnais bouchon culture.
Expect hearty regional staples like the signature pike quenelles in creamy Nantua sauce, delivering a genuine taste of Lyon without leaving the capital.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Red Room
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by Bryan O'Sullivan Studio, this secluded wine bar sits behind a velvet curtain within Mayfair’s The Connaught.
The menu draws from the hotel's substantial cellar, offering rare vintages by the glass alongside a curation of works by female artists.
A pink onyx bar and rose-veined marble fireplace anchor the room, featuring original pieces by Louise Bourgeois and Jenny Holzer.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Red Room operates a no reservation policy for all-day dining and drinks.

Name: Benoit
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Alain Ducasse oversees this historic venue in the 4th arrondissement, which remains the only traditional bistro in Paris to hold a Michelin star.
The interior preserves its 1912 character through original woodwork, red velvet banquettes, and etched glass partitions.
A meal here often finishes with the signature profiteroles, delivered to the table with a pitcher of warm chocolate sauce.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Lunch: $10 per person cancellation fee for cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations or no-shows.

Name: Café de l'Homme
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a wing of the Musée de l'Homme, this contemporary brasserie was reimagined by interior designers Gilles & Boissier.
The atmosphere balances Art Deco heritage with modern warmth, serving as a sophisticated backdrop for Chef Wilfried Graux’s seasonal French gastronomy.
While the interior features six-meter-high cedar walls, the expansive terrace commands a direct view of the Eiffel Tower, offering a front-row seat to its nightly sparkle.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: When making a reservation, we require a credit card authorization of 50 euros per person. In the event of cancellation made less than 24 hours before the start of the reservation or in case of no-show, this amount will be charged.

Name: Pizza Popolare
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Victor Lugger and Tigrane Seydoux, this 2nd arrondissement venue is a key destination for the Big Mamma Group.
The kitchen prioritizes Neapolitan authenticity, utilizing ingredients sourced directly from Italian producers to maintain high quality at accessible price points.
Illuminated bottles line the walls, creating a spirited backdrop for the communal tables and the signature, famously affordable Margherita.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If you’re unable to attend your reservation, please cancel it using the link provided in your confirmation email. This allows other guests to enjoy the experience. In the case of a no-show, a fee may apply in accordance with our booking policy.

Name: GrandCœur
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Tucked within the cobblestone courtyard of the Centre de Danse du Marais, this Parisian brasserie is the creation of Mirazur chef Mauro Colagreco.
The kitchen delivers a Mediterranean-inflected menu balancing seasonal vegetable-forward plates with elevated French classics in a room defined by exposed stone.
Diners gather on the expansive terrace of this former 17th-century coaching inn to enjoy dishes like the signature stuffed lamb confit.

Name: Alan Geaam
Master_Aurora_Insights: Located in Paris’s 16th arrondissement, this Michelin-starred restaurant is the personal atelier of self-taught Chef Alan Geaam. The kitchen bridges the gap between French gastronomy and the chef’s Lebanese heritage, replacing heavy sauces with vibrant, memory-laden flavors. Service is notably intimate in the compact dining room, where Geaam often delivers dishes himself, presenting plates accented with ingredients like pomegranate molasses.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Credit card hold required to secure reservation. Fees apply for no-shows or late cancellations.

Name: L'Arôme
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Led by Chef Thomas Boullault, this Michelin-starred restaurant sits in the heart of Paris's 8th arrondissement.
The intimate space centers on an open kitchen where the team crafts a seasonal menu highlighting refined land and sea pairings.
Boullault’s deep connection to the Sologne region is best expressed through his founding of the annual World Championship of Lièvre à la Royale.

Name: Bellefeuille
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in the Saint James Paris, the city's only château-hotel, this Michelin-starred destination is helmed by chef Grégory Garimbay.
Designer Laura Gonzalez has created a winter-garden atmosphere where nature-inspired panoramas and potted palms blur the line between indoors and out.
The dining room features black-and-beige tiling and woodwork, anchored by a period fireplace that reflects the surrounding greenery in an antique mirror.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Auberge Nicolas Flamel
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set in Paris’s oldest stone house, this Marais destination is steered by chef Grégory Garimbay, who trained under Alain Ducasse.
The dining room contrasts its medieval 1407 architecture with a modernist open kitchen and a menu of contemporary French gastronomy.
The signature Alchimiste tasting menu highlights technical precision with seasonal plates served beneath original exposed wooden beams.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations require a credit card guarantee. A cancellation fee applies for cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance.

Name: Form Fitness
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in Lurin, this studio is led by Sébastien Martinon, a former high-level judoka who has cultivated a disciplined training ground.
The space is defined by its indoor-outdoor layout, allowing members to move seamlessly between air-conditioned weight rooms and open-air functional zones.
A dedicated exterior CrossFit area serves as the anchor, enabling athletes to complete their regimen under the Caribbean sun.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A 10-hour notice is required for cancellation of any class. Late cancellations (less than 10 hours before class) are subject to a $10 fee, and no-shows are subject to a $15 fee.

Name: SKY2.0
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Anchoring the Dubai Design District, this standalone open-air venue was conceived by French architect Michelle Sarfati and Sky Management CEO Chafic El Khazen.
The dome-shaped structure features a curved layout and advanced technology that immerses guests in a distinct visual environment.
Curved LED screens line the semi-open interior, synchronizing with live acrobatic performances to transform the space throughout the night.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Le Bistrot du Praz
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set in the village of Le Praz, this alpine bistro is helmed by Antoine Fouchard and recognized by the Michelin Guide.
The menu focuses on hearty French classics updated with contemporary techniques and lighter ingredients.
A terrace overlooks the lake, serving as a backdrop for specialties like the open raviole of veal with poached egg.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Due to too many no-shows, a deposit of €50 per guest is requested to confirm your reservation (automatically refunded if the reservation is honored).

Name: Offshore Café
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Established in 1986, this surf-inspired outpost in the Swiss Alps serves as a long-standing hub for Verbier’s freeriding community.
The venue offers a relaxed, high-energy alternative to traditional chalet dining, defined by its eclectic décor and unpretentious atmosphere.
An iconic pink VW Beetle anchors the interior, creating a memorable backdrop for the daily ritual of hearty breakfasts and post-slope gatherings.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Toy Room
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Luca Maggiora and Jordan Rocca, this London-born nightclub brings a dedicated hip-hop concept to Dubai’s late-night circuit.
The interiors are defined by a playful aesthetic, merging neon signage with graffiti artwork and an intimate, high-energy atmosphere.
A signature element is the presence of Frank, a life-sized teddy bear mascot who roams the dancefloor and poses for photos with guests.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservation not refundable. Deadline to enter 1:30. If you are coming later, you must inform us otherwise your table may be given to someone else.

Name: Shed. Goomah
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in the heart of Verbier, Switzerland, Shed. Goomah is a casual dining destination housed within the Shed Hotel.
The menu pairs Neapolitan-style pizzas with substantial burgers, serving them in a space defined by its relaxed, social atmosphere.
Diners can expect stone-baked pies with blistered crusts as a signature offering, providing a distinct alternative to the village's ubiquitous cheese-heavy alpine fare.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: O Beach
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated within the Habtoor Grand Resort in Dubai Marina, this beach club marks the Middle Eastern debut for Ibiza entrepreneur Tony Truman.
The venue channels a high-energy Balearic spirit, offering a day-to-night programme of theatrical entertainment and poolside events.
A 4,000-square-foot swimming pool anchors the space, flanked by signature circular beds and commanding views of the Ain Dubai wheel.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Deposits and tickets are non-refundable under any circumstances. However, bookings may be moved to another date within the same year if requested at least 7 days prior to the original reservation date, subject to availability. Each booking may be changed once only. Late arrivals (after 14:00 for loungers, 15:00–16:00 for other areas) are treated as no-shows with deposits forfeited.

Name: BASE
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Anchored in the Dubai Design District and hosting top-tier talent, BASE is an open-air amphitheater that brings a festival atmosphere to the city.
The space is defined by its industrial framework and tiered layout, ensuring every guest maintains a direct line of sight to the stage.
Signature elements include massive pyrotechnic shows that light up the night sky, paired with a custom sound system for an immersive sensory experience.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Members may cancel at any time with one month's notice. Members may pause for up to four months in a given calendar year without penalty. Unless explicitly stated otherwise, all fees including event-related fees and membership fees are non-refundable.

Name: Soho House
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Nick Jones, this network of private clubs for creatives spans converted warehouses in the Meatpacking District, Lower East Side, and Dumbo.
Interiors deploy the group’s signature aesthetic, merging exposed brick and industrial shells with plush velvet seating and vintage furnishings.
While Dumbo offers waterfront views, the original Meatpacking flagship is best known for its heated rooftop swimming pool and striped loungers.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Room reservations must be cancelled by 6pm local time two days prior to arrival to avoid a fee equivalent to the total cost of the stay, except for Babington House and Soho Beach House Miami which require seven days' notice, and Soho Farmhouse which requires 14 days' notice. Prepaid reservations require a deposit of the full stay rate at the time of booking. Restaurant bookings must be cancelled at least four hours in advance. Spa treatments, personal training sessions, and studio classes must be cancelled at least 24 hours in advance to avoid a 100% cancellation charge.

Name: Ciel Spa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on the 69th floor of the SLS Dubai in Business Bay, this high-altitude spa features interiors by Bishop Design.
The light-filled venue centers on thermal therapy with herbal steam rooms, experience showers, and jacuzzis overlooking the skyline.
A signature Oud Silk Mood massage anchors the menu, offering a grounding ritual to balance the venue's soaring elevation.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: The full price of the service booked will be charged unless cancelled 24 hours in advance.

Name: Shed. Burgers
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by a team of Swedish friends who brought their food truck concept to the Swiss Alps, this Verbier destination offers a refined take on fast food.
The menu focuses on high-quality, locally sourced ingredients, delivering fusion-style burgers in a space that serves as a relaxed alternative to formal dining.
A signature highlight is the Mamba, a tribute to Kobe Bryant featuring a patty made from native Val d'Hérens beef.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Romi
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within the lush gardens of the Tropical Hotel in St. Jean, this open-air destination is the culinary vision of Chef Juna Rorimpandey.
The menu offers a sophisticated exploration of Indonesian flavors, merging traditional techniques with the island’s chic, relaxed atmosphere.
Diners gather on the palm-shaded patio for signature dishes like the slow-cooked beef rendang, a rich curry originating from Sumatra.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Honeycomb Hi-Fi
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Dubai, this listening bar and izakaya is a collaboration between VKD Hospitality and creative director Serge Becker.
The venue combines a record store, book shop, and dining room into a space designed specifically for high-fidelity audio appreciation.
A bespoke Ojas sound system anchors the experience, playing curated vinyl sets that complement a menu of cold and hot Japanese dishes.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: To secure all reservations, a credit card is necessary. Cancellations are accepted up to 24 hours before the reservation. Beyond that timeframe, a fee of AED150 per guest will be charged.

Name: Eddy's Ghetto
Master_Aurora_Insights:
A beloved fixture in Gustavia, St Barth, this family-run restaurant is the creation of local legend Eddy Stakelborough.
Hidden within a lush tropical garden, the open-air space offers a laid-back respite, serving a confident fusion of French and Creole flavors.
Diners enjoy signature plates like the green mango salad with crispy prawns amidst the verdant, timber-framed setting that belies its playful "Ghetto" moniker.
