Name: L'Altiplano
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Overseen by chef Paul Stradner within Courchevel’s Le K2 Palace, L'Altiplano brings the vibrancy of Peruvian cuisine to the French Alps.
The kitchen specializes in Nikkei-influenced sharing plates and charcoal-grilled specialties, served in a warm, timber-lined setting that encourages communal dining.
A classic charcoal grill anchors the experience, turning out dishes such as scallop ceviche and bao de cerdo that pair fresh seafood with smoky intensity.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If you wish to change the reservation date or the number of diners, your request will be honored as long as it is made with a minimum of advance notice, and if there are seats available. In the event that you have been asked for a guarantee card at the time of booking, you will receive an email and a sms where you must reconfirm or cancel the reservation in the links provided for this purpose. Your reservation will only be guaranteed when it has been reconfirmed.

Name: Attiko
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched on the 31st floor of W Dubai Mina Seyahi, this rooftop lounge and restaurant is a project by Sunset Hospitality Group.
The space transitions from a sunset vantage point to a late-night venue, offering a Pan-Asian menu within a wrap-around terrace.
Interiors by Swiss Bureau frame sweeping views of Palm Jumeirah and Bluewaters Island, best enjoyed with the signature bluefin tuna carpaccio.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Nama
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the artistic village of Deià, Mallorca, this Asian-fusion standout is the work of owner Namali Schleberger.
The kitchen steers away from typical tapas, presenting vibrant Thai and Sri Lankan flavors within wabi-sabi interiors designed by Claudia Ornelas.
A dinner reservation on the lantern-lit terrace reveals the venue’s defining asset: a panoramic vista of the UNESCO-protected Tramuntana mountains.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Cove Beach
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated at the Woods Bagot-designed La Vie in JBR, this beach club brings a Mediterranean aesthetic to the Dubai coastline.
The space is defined by a bohemian atmosphere, linking a restaurant and lounge with pools that face the Arabian Gulf.
A central feature is the Rosé Lounge, a dedicated setting for sunset rituals and clear views of the sea.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Bookings policy: Latest booking time is 12:00 PM. We will hold reservations for 30 minutes ONLY after the booking time of the reservation. Restaurant reservations are limited to a 2-hour period (subject to extension based on availability) with no pool / beach access.

Name: Reunion Resort
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by Kingwood International Resorts, this 2,300-acre Florida destination comprises a collection of upscale villas and vacation homes.
The grounds are defined by extensive leisure facilities, including a five-acre water park, tennis centre, and the rooftop Eleven restaurant.
Uniquely, it is the only property in the world to feature signature golf courses designed by Jack Nicklaus, Arnold Palmer, and Tom Watson.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: One night’s room and tax is due at time of reservation confirmation. Reservation must be cancelled 72 hours prior to arrival to avoid deposit’s forfeiture. If booking less than 72 hours from arrival, the deposit will be non-refundable.

Name: Black Tap Verbier
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Black Tap Verbier is a high-altitude outpost of the New York-based burger brand founded by Chris Barish, located at Col des Gentianes in the Swiss Alps.
The restaurant introduces an urban American dining concept to the ski slopes, providing a direct alternative to traditional regional fare.
Situated at nearly 3,000 meters, the venue serves the brand's signature CrazyShakes alongside panoramic views of the surrounding peaks.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Core Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Jennie Enterprise, this private community occupies four floors of the Coca-Cola Building with interiors by m2atelier and a lobby by Peter Marino.
The modern atmosphere eschews traditional dress codes for a relaxed environment focused on cultural programming and global connection.
A standout feature is the wraparound terrace overlooking Central Park, complemented by chef Michele Brogioni’s Italian culinary program and residential-style suites.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: NeueHouse
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in a 1913 industrial landmark in New York’s Madison Square district, this private work and social club is operated by Convene Hospitality Group.
Interiors by David Rockwell merge raw, non-corporate aesthetics with high-touch hospitality, creating a refined sanctuary for creative leaders.
A signature element is the ground-floor "Spanish Steps," an amphitheater-style gathering space that hosts cultural programming and fosters community connection.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Auto-Renewal Cancellation: Thirty (30) days prior notice.

Name: Ti Corail
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on the sands of Grand Cul-de-Sac, this stationary food truck is helmed by chef Yann Vinsot, an alumnus of Cheval Blanc and Le Toiny.
The open-air shack offers a relaxed counterpoint to the island’s formal dining scene, serving daily catches and garden-fresh produce in a barefoot setting.
Patrons sit at one of just five tables steps from the lagoon to enjoy daily specials like grilled local catch seasoned with Caribbean spices.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Lunch: $10 per person cancellation fee for cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations or no-shows.

Name: Red Leopard Room
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Hidden just off the lobby of W Dubai Mina Seyahi, this intimate speakeasy is a collaboration with House of Negroni.
The space is defined by rich scarlet tones and plush velvet seating, creating a sophisticated, moody escape from the marina’s bustle.
A heavy burgundy curtain marks the entrance, where the menu charts the Negroni’s evolution from its early 1900s roots to modern interpretations.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Club Boudoir
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Dubai Marine Beach Resort & Spa, this established venue holds a listing with The World’s Finest Clubs.
The space references the French Renaissance with a baroque scheme of heavy velvet drapery and oversized crystal chandeliers.
A curved mirrored bar anchors the room, reflecting the oil paintings and red lighting that characterize the late-night setting.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Neera
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Emirati sisters Hend and Hana Al Mheiri, this private members’ club occupies a discreet 20,000-square-foot space within Al Habtoor City.
The two-story venue functions as a versatile cultural hub, offering seven distinct spaces that range from a formal tea room to a high-energy South American restaurant.
A standout feature is the rooftop terrace, Olival, where members can enjoy traditional Lebanese mezze and shisha under the open sky.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Refund policies for events are governed by the contract terms with members, with a minimum 48-hour notice required for cancellations. Late cancellations (within 24 hours of booking) may incur a fee as periodically set by the Club.

Name: Nusr-Et Steakhouse
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in Istanbul by butcher-turned-restaurateur Nusret Gökçe, this steakhouse collection has expanded from Turkey to major metropolises including Dubai and Miami.
The dining room prioritizes high-energy theatricality, presenting a menu of heavily marbled, dry-aged beef served with elaborate showmanship.
Servers carve the signature "Spaghetti" striploin tableside before finishing the dish with the brand's recognizable, forearm-rolling salt-sprinkling ritual.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Siddharta Lounge by Buddha-Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched atop Grosvenor House in Dubai Marina, this rooftop venue by the Buddha-Bar group features interiors by LW Design centered around a pool deck.
The space transitions from a daytime retreat to a spirited evening lounge, serving a sharing-style menu that merges Mediterranean ingredients with Asian techniques.
Tiered seating maximizes 360-degree views of the skyline and Palm Jumeirah, providing a dramatic backdrop for signature maki rolls and coastal bites.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Bla Bla
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located at The Beach opposite JBR, this expansive day-to-night destination was created by Mohammad Islam with interiors by the award-winning Bishop Design.
The complex integrates a dedicated beach club, a restaurant, and The Tent nightclub into a seamless social hub defined by its sheer scale.
Its twenty distinct bars, including a Tiki lounge and a Japanese-style rooftop, offer an endless exploration of styles in a single venue.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Tables are available for 2 hours. A minimum spend applies for groups of 6 and above (50% deposit required) and for reservations after 10pm. VIP tables have a minimum spend starting from AED 5,000.

Name: Vault
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched on the 71st and 72nd floors of the JW Marriott Marquis, this venue offers a commanding perspective of the city.
The setting pairs a relaxed ambiance with a serious collection of premium cigars and fine international spirits.
Entry involves passing through heavy vault doors to reach a black onyx bar framed by caged gold shelving.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Bling
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Anchored within the FIVE Palm Jumeirah, this nightclub is a high-energy destination from the FIVE Hotels and Resorts group.
The interior combines antique candelabras with modern murals, while Afrobeat and hip-hop soundtracks set the tempo for the crowd.
A drive-in dancefloor serves as the centerpiece, allowing guests to park supercars directly amidst the action and champagne rituals.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For VIP table booking and tickets, 100% Refund if client cancels the order 48 hours before the starting time of the event. 50% refund if client cancels the order 24 hours before the starting time of the event. 0% refund in case of no show up or cancellations in less than 30 minutes before the starting time of the event. 0% refund after the event starting time has passed.

Name: Black Ginger
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within The Slate resort in Phuket, this Michelin-recommended Thai restaurant is led by Chef Anongrat Meklai.
The venue occupies a traditional Ayutthaya-style mansion that appears to float above a dark, still lagoon.
Guests reach the dining hall via a rope-pulled barge that ferries them across the torch-lit waters to the entrance.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: All reservations require a deposit of THB1,000 per person for May - September and THB2,000 per person for October - April, which will be deducted from your final bill. Any remaining deposit will not be refunded. Any cancellations or no-shows will incur a forfeiture of the deposit, applied without prior notice. Your reservation will only be held for 15 minutes.

Name: WHITE Beach
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Anchored on the sands of Atlantis The Palm, this beach club is a collaboration between operator Addmind Hospitality and DSA Architects.
The design employs whitewashed timber, woven textures, and turquoise accents to create a Mediterranean atmosphere distinct from the hotel's main structure.
An infinity pool with in-water loungers faces the city skyline, providing a clear vantage point of the mainland from the island.

Name: Soho Garden
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated at the Meydan Racecourse, this entertainment precinct is operated by Sekoya Management and designed to mirror the urban diversity of London’s Soho.
The site functions as a cosmopolitan playground, housing distinct venues that range from relaxed outdoor beer gardens to dedicated club spaces like Code.
An expansive terrace offers uninterrupted views of the Downtown Dubai skyline, serving as the backdrop for sets by international headliners.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: All ticket sales are final. Tickets are non-refundable, non-transferable, and non-exchangeable.

Name: La Petite Plage
Master_Aurora_Insights:
With outposts in Saint-Tropez and Saint-Barthélemy, this restaurant and cocktail bar is a collaboration between the Annie Famose group and Michelin-starred chef Eric Frechon.
The venue is defined by its relaxed holiday atmosphere, blending bohemian decor with a menu of fresh Mediterranean summer cuisine.
A signature design element is the sand-covered floor, allowing guests to dine barefoot in an elegant setting that mimics a beach cabana.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Your table will be held for 15 min after your reservation time. A credit card imprint is required to confirm your reservation. Cancellation fees may apply for no-shows or late cancellations.

Name: BOA Lounge & Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated atop the V Hotel in Al Habtoor City, this dual-story venue operates as both a nightclub and a lounge.
The space is defined by its contemporary interiors and capacity for 1,000 guests, serving as a focal point for the district's late-night circuit.
A standout feature is the open-air terrace, which provides commanding views of the Dubai Water Canal and the Arabian Gulf.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Holborn Dining Room
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within the Rosewood London, this grand brasserie features interiors by designer Martin Brudnizki, defined by red leather banquettes and antique mirrors.
The kitchen focuses on refined British standards, offering a menu that champions seasonal produce and traditional craftsmanship without pretension.
A dedicated Pie Room stands out as a unique culinary destination, turning out intricate savory pastries just steps from the city’s largest gin bar.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Nightjar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
A subterranean icon in Shoreditch, this speakeasy-style bar from Edmund Weil and Roisin Stimpson is a globally acclaimed fixture of London’s cocktail renaissance.
The intimate, low-lit space evokes the glamour of the Prohibition era with nightly live jazz and blues setting a sophisticated, transportive tone.
Expect a theatrical cocktail menu spanning historical eras, featuring elaborate garnishes and unique vessels like the signature Name of the Samurai.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We require card authentication for some bookings. Please let us know 6 hours before the start of your booking if you wish to cancel your table. After this a £10 per person cancellation fee may apply. Different cancellation policies may apply for special events and these will be described in the confirmation emails.

Name: Cinnamon Kitchen
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a former East India Company warehouse in Devonshire Square, this modern Indian restaurant is the work of chef Vivek Singh.
The kitchen applies traditional spice techniques to seasonal British ingredients, serving innovative plates in a space that pairs industrial brickwork with polished modern touches.
A defining feature is the open tandoor grill, set beneath a canopy of 5,000 mother-of-pearl tiles that reflect the room’s brass lighting.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations made within 24 hours of the reservation may result in a cancellation fee or loss of deposit. No-shows may be subject to a no-show fee.

Name: Grind
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched on Old Street Roundabout, this prominent venue was established by David Abrahamovitch in a converted mobile phone shop.
The industrial space bridges coffee culture and nightlife with an aesthetic defined by subway tiles, exposed brick, and neon signage.
Its standout feature is the professional recording studio hidden upstairs, built by the legendary Miloco team, cementing its status as a creative hub.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Please note, we can only hold your reservation for 10 minutes, and can only seat you once everyone has arrived. At all times, we keep a few tables free for walk-ins. For larger bookings, semi-private space or full venue hire, please email the restaurant directly.

Name: Camino
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on Antwerp's Muntplein square, Camino is an Asian-inspired restaurant operated by chef David Copmans.
The kitchen focuses on Korean comfort food, serving a rotating menu of small and large sharing plates paired with a selection of natural wines.
Diners can sit on the large outdoor terrace and order the signature pork belly rice bowl.

Name: The Old Blue Last
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the Shoreditch site of London’s first purpose-built theatre, this Victorian corner pub is owned and operated by Vice Media.
It functions as a raw, unvarnished testing ground for emerging talent, maintaining a rebellious energy that defies the neighborhood’s gentrification.
The intimate upstairs live room is legendary for hosting early, chaotic sets from acts like Arctic Monkeys and Florence + The Machine.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We regret that tickets cannot be exchanged or refunded after purchase. If the event is cancelled, please contact us for information on receiving a refund. Tickets are sold subject to the venue or promoter's right to alter or vary the programme due to events or circumstances beyond its control without being obliged to refund monies or exchange tickets.

Name: Gloria
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Victor Lugger and Tigrane Seydoux, this Shoreditch trattoria channels the atmosphere of a 1970s Capri holiday.
The maximalist interior features marble surfaces and peach-satin lampshades, setting the stage for generous portions of Italian comfort food.
A signature ritual involves the carbonara, which is mixed tableside within a hollowed-out wheel of pecorino cheese before serving.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We kindly ask that any cancellation to your reservation be made no less than 48 hours prior. For no shows or late cancellations, you will be subject to a fee of £20 per person that will be applied to the credit card on file.

Name: Shoreditch House
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the upper levels of the Tea Building, this East London club is a key Soho House outpost with interiors originally by Tom Dixon.
The converted warehouse retains its industrial character with exposed brick and concrete, featuring a two-lane bowling alley and comprehensive gym facilities.
A 16-metre heated rooftop pool offers direct views of the City skyline, anchoring the property's outdoor space throughout the year.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: You may cancel your booking up to 18:00 local time two days before your arrival date. Any cancellation request received after this deadline will be subject to a fee equivalent to the total cost of the stay. Prepaid reservations are charged a deposit equivalent to the full stay rate at the time of booking.

Name: Elliot's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Anchored in Borough Market, this restaurant and natural wine store is the work of chef Brett Redman and Samantha Lim.
The kitchen centers on a wood-fired grill, turning out a daily changing menu defined by ingredients sourced directly from the surrounding stalls.
An enduring signature, the wood-roasted Isle of Mull scallops with wild garlic butter, exemplifies the kitchen's rigorous commitment to simple, produce-led cooking.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Card details are required for all bookings and a cancellation fee will be charged in the event of a short-show or late cancellation. Please read the relevant policy displayed during the booking process.

Name: Dark Sugars
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Fatou Mendy, this Brick Lane cocoa house brings West African cocoa culture to East London.
Set to a soundtrack of African beats, the space showcases handmade truffles and pearls crafted from Ghanaian cocoa.
A signature hot chocolate is finished with a mound of shavings sliced directly from giant blocks of chocolate.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Lardo
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by chef Elena Reygadas, Lardo is a Mediterranean restaurant situated in the Condesa neighborhood of Mexico City.
The all-day eatery centers around a large wood-fired oven, producing a menu of shared plates and seasonal ingredients.
The daily offerings highlight her background in baking, featuring signature pastries, crusty sandwiches, and pizzas served along a bar that encircles the room.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Merchants Tavern
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a historic bank on St. John’s Water Street, this spirited venue is helmed by celebrated chef Jeremy Charles and partner Jeremy Bonia.
The kitchen champions Newfoundland’s ingredients through nose-to-tail dishes, fresh pasta, and local seafood served within a grand room of high ceilings and leather banquettes.
A meal here is incomplete without the signature vinegar pie, a regional classic that delivers a delicate balance of sweet and tart.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Nicolas Rouzaud at The Connaught
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on Mount Street, this streetside patisserie serves as the dedicated retail outpost for The Connaught’s Executive Pastry Chef Nicolas Rouzaud.
The glass counter displays a rotation of classical French gateaux and sharing tarts that highlight seasonal fruit and precise technique.
A standout creation is the Connaught Hound, a sculpted mousse cake designed to resemble the hotel’s greyhound emblem.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Mast Market
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by brothers Rick and Michael Mast, this design-forward brand operates a production facility and market in New York’s Westchester County.
The minimalist space focuses on organic pantry staples, offering house-milled heritage flours and fresh butter alongside their single-origin cocoa products.
Signature chocolate bars are wrapped in thick, patterned papers that have led to artistic collaborations with the Metropolitan Museum of Art.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We stand behind the quality of our products and we are unable to accept returns or exchanged for perishable food items. However, if you have any concerns about your order, please don’t hesitate to contact us. If your order is damaged or lost in transit, we will replace it. Please reach out to us via orders@mastmarket.com or (914) 733-9020 within 24 hours of receipt, with a detailed description and a photo of the damaged item. If you have an issue with items purchased from an independent retailer, please contact the retailer directly regarding their refund policy. For nonperishable items, we accept returns of unopened items in their original packaging with no visible signs of product use within 30 days of purchase. To start a return, you can reply to your order confirmation email or email us directly to orders@mastmarket.com. Please include your order # and let us know which products you want to return. Once the item is returned, we will process a refund to the original payment method.

Name: Mare Street Market
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a converted council block in London Fields, this modern marketplace is led by Barworks founder Marc Francis-Baum.
The industrial warehouse combines retail and hospitality, hosting a deli, florist, and podcast studio alongside its dining spaces.
In a clever twist on interior design, the eclectic furnishings and vintage chandeliers from Pure White Lines are all available for purchase.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations and changes must follow the instructions provided in your booking confirmation. We reserve the right to refuse, cancel, or amend a reservation at our discretion.

Name: Rochelle Canteen
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Melanie Arnold and Margot Henderson, this understated Shoreditch canteen occupies the converted bike shed of the historic Rochelle School.
The kitchen delivers unpretentious, seasonal British cooking within a secluded walled garden that offers a rare sense of calm.
Arrival requires buzzing a gate to enter, before settling at a communal table for dishes like monkfish liver pâté with pickles.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Macbeth
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Jamie Allan, the chef behind The Plimsoll, has revived this storied Hoxton venue, shifting its focus from live music to a food-forward public house.
Restored by Studio Hatcham Architects, the interior features a new English oak bar alongside the building's original tiled mural of Macbeth and Banquo’s ghost.
The kitchen serves a Portuguese-inspired menu of small plates, including percebes and piri-piri roasted meats, available until late in the evening.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Adhere to our 'no refund policy' under any circumstances outside of event cancellation.

Name: The Promenade at The Dorchester
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the heart of The Dorchester in Mayfair, this all-day dining salon features interiors by acclaimed designer Pierre-Yves Rochon.
The open setting serves a modern British menu ranging from breakfast to evening cocktails amidst potted palms and plush seating.
A resident pianist accompanies the signature afternoon tea and the Crêpes Suzette, which are flambéed tableside.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Smokestak
Master_Aurora_Insights:
David Carter transformed his street-food operation into this permanent Shoreditch fixture, earning a Michelin Bib Gourmand for its mastery of wood-fired cooking.
The industrial interior resembles a dark engine room, filled with the heavy scent of oak smoke and the heat of a massive custom smoker.
Order the signature brisket bun, a rich assembly of slow-smoked beef and pickled red chilli served inside a soft milk bun.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Manteca
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Chefs Chris Leach and David Carter lead this Bib Gourmand-awarded Italian restaurant in Shoreditch.
The kitchen focuses on whole-animal butchery and hand-rolled pasta, pairing fire-cooked cuts with robust flavors in a simple, energetic setting.
Do not miss the brown crab cacio e pepe, a signature dish where savory crab meat transforms the classic peppery sauce.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We kindly request at least 72-hours notice for cancellations. In the event of a cancellation with less notice, we regrettably request a charge of £50 per person.

Name: E. Pellicci
Master_Aurora_Insights:
This Grade II–listed café in Bethnal Green has been owned and operated by the Pellicci family since 1900.
The dining room is defined by its heritage Art Deco interior, featuring intricate wood marquetry crafted by carpenter Achille Capocci in 1946.
Patrons visit for the homemade lasagne and classic English breakfasts served with vocal hospitality by the current owners.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Book Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a restored Victorian warehouse in Shoreditch, this venue is operated by the Mothership Group and serves as a cultural anchor for East London.
The space functions as a hybrid destination, transitioning from a daytime workspace and café into a vinyl-led bar and club after dark.
A defining feature is the integration of social play and music, anchored by a dedicated ping-pong area and a rotating lineup of vinyl DJs.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: No refunds under any circumstances outside of event cancellation.

Name: Tatar Bunar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Chef Alex Cooper brings the flavors of his youth to Shoreditch in this venue, praised by critic Grace Dent for its honest approach.
The interiors evoke a rustic warmth with wooden paneling and handcrafted pottery that sets the stage for a communal dining experience.
The menu highlights the Bessarabia region with grill-fired meats and dumplings served alongside a rare selection of Ukrainian wines.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Hoxton Square
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Laid out in 1709, this Shoreditch garden square was the crucible of the Young British Artists movement and remains a hub for the creative community.
The central lawn is ringed by converted Victorian industrial warehouses and modern infills, including a notable structure by DOS Architects.
A defining feature is the contrast between the mature plane trees and the nightlife of venues like the basement bar Happiness Forgets.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: January – November Bookings: If a booking is cancelled (by registered post or email only) 2 months in advance of the Access Time, we will refund 90% of the deposit. More than 1 month in advance of the Access Time, but less than 2 months, any deposit paid will not be refunded. Less than 1 month in advance up until the Access Time, any deposit paid will not be refunded and we will issue an invoice for immediate payment of the contracted balance. December Bookings: If a booking is cancelled (by registered post or email only) More than 4 months in advance of the Access Time, we will refund 90% of the deposit. More than 3 months in advance of the Access Time, but less than 2 months, any deposit paid will not be refunded. Less than 2 months in advance up until the Access Time, any deposit paid will not be refunded and we will issue an invoice for immediate payment of the contracted balance.

Name: The Jago
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the former Passing Clouds site in Dalston, this cultural centre is directed by Kwame Otiende and Aaron Edwards.
The community-led space functions as a platform for diverse expression, programming global live music alongside local workshops and arts initiatives.
Its moniker references Arthur Morrison’s Victorian novel about the nearby Old Nichol slum, rooting the venue in local history.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We currently operate a first come, first served venue policy. No need for Reservations unless you are a big group of over 30 or would like to hire our upstairs lounge.

Name: The Connaught Cigar Merchants
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Tucked within The Connaught, this cigar lounge features interiors by Bryan O'Sullivan Studio and a collection overseen by Adam Lajca, a Master of Havana Cigars.
Deep jade walls and an intricately carved Pippy Oak ceiling frame the room, creating a contemporary club atmosphere.
The humidor houses rare vintage sticks, including Cuban cigars once rolled for Fidel Castro, available to pair with Connaught Scotch.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cigar Merchants operates a no reservation policy.

Name: The Connaught Grill
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within Mayfair’s The Connaught, this intimate restaurant is a modern revival of a historic venue, overseen by chef Jean-Georges Vongerichten.
The kitchen champions seasonal British produce cooked over a wood-burning grill, serving a menu of heritage dishes with contemporary flair.
A standout design element is the atmospheric dining room, lined with rare wall panels handcrafted by George Nakashima Woodworkers.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If you cancel less than 24 hours before you’re due to dine with us or fail to arrive without giving us notice, there is a charge of £75 per guest, made to the credit card you gave to secure your booking.

Name: The Spatisserie
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Tucked inside the spa at The Dorchester, this hybrid space serves as both a dining room and a post-treatment retreat.
The defining feature is the relaxed dress code, which encourages guests to linger over lunch or afternoon tea while still wearing their white robes.
Interiors are finished in soft pinks with pearl chandeliers, a soothing backdrop for the signature cocktail of pear juice, elderflower, and Laurent-Perrier champagne.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Senza Fondo
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located near Piazza Navona, this casual trattoria is the brainchild of Diana Russo and Luciano Ruffino, who established Rome’s first all-you-can-eat venue dedicated to traditional local cuisine.
The concept reimagines the Roman meal with a bottomless formula that allows diners to sample unlimited portions of regional staples in a relaxed setting.
Guests can order endless rounds of the city’s four defining pastas, including carbonara and amatriciana, alongside thin-crust pizza and homemade suppli.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We kindly request at least 24 hours notice for cancellations. For groups of 7+ we hold a separate cancellation notice of 7 days prior to your booking. For any amendments in large groups we hold a 48 hour notice period. A deposit of £20 per head is required for bookings of 7 or more.

Name: Parcafé
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Serving single-estate beans from Difference Coffee Company, this wood-clad café sits adjacent to the ballroom of The Dorchester in Mayfair.
The daily menu offers artisanal espresso and fresh juices alongside house-made pastries, salads, and sandwiches.
A La Marzocco machine anchors the space, where baristas prepare drinks to be enjoyed with views of Hyde Park.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Popolo
Master_Aurora_Insights:
This independent Shoreditch kitchen is led by chef Jon Lawson, whose precise cooking has secured the venue a Michelin Bib Gourmand.
The menu presents regional Italian small plates with distinct Moorish and Middle Eastern influences, distinguishing it from typical trattoria fare.
Diners at the ground-floor concrete counter can watch the team prepare daily specialities, including the signature fried olives with labneh.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Lunch: $10 per person cancellation fee for cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Larger parties are subject to a 72 hour cancellation policy.

Name: Padella
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founders Tim Siadatan and Jordan Frieda established this Shoreditch location as a larger sequel to their Borough Market original.
The space centers on a marble counter where chefs hand-roll fresh dough for a concise menu of value-driven plates.
Diners watch the preparation of the signature Pici Cacio e Pepe, a dish of thick noodles and peppercorns that defines the kitchen's straightforward approach.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: On the day of your booking we'll keep your table for 10 minutes after your slot, so please make sure you are on time. A limited amount of tables are available for bookings, you can reserve a table up to 4 weeks in advance. For large bookings (6 or more), please email shoreditch@padella.co.

Name: The Royal Oak
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set in the Wiltshire village of Swallowcliffe, this 18th-century inn is co-owned by television presenter James May.
The interiors pair historic architecture with a considered, modern aesthetic featuring pale timber furniture and an airy atmosphere.
A light-filled oak orangery extends the dining space, providing a bright backdrop for a menu that champions local produce.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A £10 per person holding deposit is required for all bookings on Thursday and Friday evenings, and for all reservations on Saturdays and Sundays.

Name: Moro
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London's Exmouth Market, this pioneering restaurant is the creation of husband-and-wife chefs Sam and Sam Clark.
The kitchen interprets the Moorish culinary traditions of Southern Spain and North Africa, serving rustic, spice-laden dishes in a communal, open-plan space.
A wood-fired oven anchors the dining room, turning out the kitchen's signature sourdough bread and wood-roasted meats.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Burger & Beyond
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Tom Stock and Craig Povoas, this Essex-born operation evolved from a market food truck into a permanent fixture in London's dining scene.
The kitchen focuses on dry-aged beef patties served in brioche buns, accompanied by American-style sides and cocktails.
A signature item is the Bougie Burger, featuring two dry-aged beef patties, cold smoked American cheese, steak sauce, and marrownaise.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Alain Ducasse at The Dorchester
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within The Dorchester, this three-Michelin-starred restaurant presents contemporary French cuisine overseen by chef Alain Ducasse.
The dining room, designed by Patrick Jouin and Sanjit Manku, pairs natural textiles with bespoke details for a calm, modern atmosphere.
A semi-private Table Lumière sits shielded by a curtain of 4,500 fiber-optic strands, offering a distinct setting for signatures like the hand-dived scallop with Kristal caviar.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: In the event that the booking is not honoured in whole or in part by the client, or cancelled with less than 48 hour-notice, a fee of £250 per person will be charged on the credit card provided. The same fee will be charged in case of a non-arrival. Please note that the manager reserves the right to release the table if the guests have not arrived within 15 minutes after the reservation time, and the above charges are applicable.

Name: Callooh Callay
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Richard Wynne in Shoreditch, this acclaimed cocktail bar draws its name and surrealist ethos from Lewis Carroll’s *Jabberwocky*.
The interior pairs exposed brick with eccentric furnishings, setting the stage for ambitious, often conceptually themed drink lists.
A mirrored wardrobe door serves as the portal to the Jubjub, an intimate back room with its own distinct menu and bartender residency.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Aline Lebanese Kitchen
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Mayfair, this restaurant is an ode to owner Tarek Farah's mother, Aline, serving contemporary Lebanese comfort food.
The menu focuses on responsibly sourced ingredients transformed into vibrant mezzes, grilled meats, and flatbreads within a modern, thirty-seat space.
A standout detail is the Reqaqat Jebneh (crisp cheese rolls), a signature starter that embodies the venue's commitment to authentic family recipes.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Charlie's at Brown's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Overseen by Michelin-starred chef director Adam Byatt, this Mayfair dining room is located within the historic Brown’s Hotel.
The menu foregrounds British provenance, utilizing classical techniques to present a contemporary evolution of traditional hotel dining.
A trolley navigates the wood-panelled space, serving roast beef or the catch of the day tableside.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Credit or debit card details are required to make a reservation. Your card will not be charged unless you fail to arrive to your reservation without notice, or cancel your booking within 24/48 hours of your reservation.

Name: The Rivoli Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by Tessa Kennedy to resemble a golden jewellery box, this intimate Art Deco lounge sits within The Ritz London.
The interior features alabaster, gold leaf, and rich woods that create a gilded setting for Head Mixologist Michele Saladino’s creations.
A standout detail is the biodynamic cocktail menu, where drinks are crafted according to natural rhythms and served beneath glowing glass relief panels.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Credit card details must be provided at the time of booking reservations. To avoid charges, The Ritz must receive all amendments or cancellations two days (48 hrs) before arrival. On the day of arrival, if you are a “no-show,” 100% of the full payment will be charged to your credit card if you have provided us with your credit card.

Name: Mariage Frères
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 1854 by Henri and Édouard Mariage, France’s oldest tea house is a Parisian institution known for its blending expertise.
The company presents hundreds of varieties in signature black canisters against floor-to-ceiling wooden apothecary shelving.
Its flagship Marais location features a dedicated tea museum and serves the best-selling Marco Polo blend, a secret composition of fruit and flowers.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Artesian
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within The Langham, this four-time "World's Best Bar" winner is currently led by head bartender Giulia Cuccurullo.
The David Collins Studio interiors blend Victorian heritage with modern touches, defined by high ceilings and signature purple leather chairs.
Its name honors the 360-foot-deep well beneath the hotel, a historic anchor for a venue known for its avant-garde mixology.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Savoy Grill
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London’s Savoy Hotel, this Gordon Ramsay-operated dining room has served patrons like Winston Churchill for over a century.
The interior features a 1920s Hollywood Regency design, providing a polished setting for classic British and French cuisine.
The kitchen prepares the signature Beef Wellington and the Omelette Arnold Bennett, a smoked haddock dish created at the property.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: In the event that the booking is not honoured or is cancelled with less than 48 hours' notice a cancellation fee of £30 per person will be charged to the card.

Name: Gallery at The Savoy
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated at the heart of The Savoy, this all-day dining space marries British heritage with modern flair under the guidance of a team known for warmth and craft.
A central marble catwalk draws the eye to a bar framed by sky-high palms, while antique mirrors and dancer-figure silhouettes adorn the warm, sienna-hued room.
The menu features a signature chicken tikka pie and Escoffier-inspired sole tacos alongside the hotel’s historic afternoon tea.

Name: Thames Foyer
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated beneath a glass-domed atrium, this central venue has been reimagined as The Gallery to serve as the hotel's social heart.
The all-day dining concept balances historic character with contemporary energy, offering a relaxed setting for meetings and meals.
The Afternoon Tea service includes over 30 rare blends, while a new Twilight Tea ritual provides a distinct evening interpretation of the custom.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations require 48 hours' notice; otherwise, a £90 per-person fee will apply for late cancellations or no-shows. Credit card details are required to secure the reservation.

Name: Le Cercle des Caves
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the 2nd arrondissement, this private club and restaurant serves as a discreet gathering place for Parisian society.
The interior evokes a classic English study, featuring deep leather armchairs, dim lighting, and walls lined with antique books.
A unique culinary residency program sees a new chef take over the kitchen every two weeks, ensuring a constantly evolving menu.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: The Reservation may be cancelled or modified up to forty eight (48) hours before the reserved date and time for the catering service in question, without penalty. After this deadline, even in the event of cancellation or no-show, the full amount of the Deposit paid will be retained as a penalty.

Name: Le Metro
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on Boulevard Saint-Germain in the Latin Quarter, this Parisian brasserie operates adjacent to the Cluny-La Sorbonne station.
The venue functions as a traditional neighborhood fixture, featuring a street-side terrace that offers a direct view of the area's constant activity.
A visit is best punctuated by bistro staples, such as escargots or a croque madame, enjoyed while observing the movement of the Left Bank.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Mandarin Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within London's Mandarin Oriental Hyde Park, this venue features contemporary interiors by designer Adam D. Tihany.
The space combines a lively social atmosphere with a modern aesthetic, serving an innovative cocktail list amidst glass and metallic accents.
A rectangular, catwalk-style bar anchors the room, flanked by high stools and illuminated to create a central focal point for evening drinks.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Bocconcino
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on Mayfair’s Berkeley Street, this polished Italian restaurant is the work of restaurateur Mikhail Gokhner.
The split-level interior merges the warmth of a traditional trattoria with a spirited atmosphere, often animated by live music and DJs on the lower floor.
Head Chef Marco Corsica’s menu features fresh seafood and handmade pasta, yet the wood-fired pizzas cooked in an open oven remain the standout signature.

Name: The Pie Room
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated within the Holborn Dining Room at Rosewood London, this specialized kitchen is directed by Head Chef Ilona Perczyk and Pie Maker Laszlo Kiss.
Serving as a production space by day and a private dining venue by night, it showcases the team’s precise pastry work through a glass facade.
A discreet street-side hatch allows pedestrians to purchase takeaway provisions, including the kitchen's signature hand-raised pork pie, directly from the window.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Palm Court at The Langham
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in The Langham, London, this venue is recognized as the birthplace of the afternoon tea tradition in 1865.
The space features Art Deco interiors and crystal lighting, offering a polished setting for light meals and live piano music.
A dedicated tea sommelier oversees the service, which is presented on custom Langham Rose china created by Wedgwood.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Maroush
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 1981 by Marouf and Houda Abouzaki, this Edgware Road institution is credited with introducing Lebanese dining to London.
The bustling dining room is defined by its spirited energy and late-night hospitality, drawing a diverse crowd for traditional service.
A signature visit involves lingering over elaborate mezze spreads while live musicians and belly dancers perform a nightly ritual.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Pachamama
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying a 19th-century building by Gustave Eiffel near the Bastille, this Parisian venue reimagines the dinner club with a South American soul.
The interior by Cyril Peret pairs original industrial ironwork with lush vegetation and distressed walls to evoke a faded colonial hacienda.
A grand central staircase connects the vibrant ballroom to upper-level dining areas serving Nikkei cuisine.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Fumoir
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within Claridge’s in Mayfair, this intimate Art Deco hideaway was opened in 1929 and later refined by architect Thierry Despont.
The windowless, velvet-clad space serves as a discreet sanctuary, defined by its moody 1930s glamour and capacity for just twelve seated guests.
Patrons sip signature Fumoir Negronis beneath an original Lalique glass panel installed when the room debuted as a smoking lounge.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: The Fumoir operates a no reservations policy.

Name: The Terrace at Rosewood
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Tucked inside the Edwardian courtyard of Rosewood London, this open-air venue offers a quiet respite from the noise of High Holborn.
The setting undergoes a complete design overhaul twice a year, transitioning between a foliage-filled summer terrace and a chalet-style winter hideaway.
The menu features signature pies from the adjoining Pie Room and curated cocktails, served on heated banquettes amidst the property’s restored stonework.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Scarfes Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within the Rosewood London, this art-filled salon is a collaboration between the hotel’s creative team and renowned British caricaturist Gerald Scarfe.
The atmosphere evokes a convivial drawing room where velvet armchairs and a roaring fireplace set the stage for nightly live jazz.
Specially commissioned illustrations by the bar’s namesake adorn the marble walls, watching over guests as they sip inventive cocktails from the latest thematic menu.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Scarfes Bar only accepts reservations for in-house guests and parties of six or more. Tables will be released after 15 minutes if guests do not arrive. Each table is allocated for a duration of 1.5 hours.

Name: The River Restaurant by Gordon Ramsay
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the historic Savoy Hotel, this seafood-focused dining room is operated by chef Gordon Ramsay.
The kitchen highlights British provenance through a menu of fresh catches, ranging from dressed crab and ceviche to classic grilled fish.
A central raw bar serves as the interior’s focal point, displaying oysters and caviar against a backdrop of panoramic river views.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Bookings of 6+ guests require card details to confirm your reservation. In the event that the booking is not honoured or is cancelled with less than 48 hours' notice a cancellation fee of £30 per person will be charged to the card. Please note that special terms & conditions may apply for key seasonal dates.

Name: La Môme
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Twin brothers Ugo and Antoine Lecorché have launched their first international outpost of the Riviera-based La Môme within The Berkeley.
The dining room channels Côte d’Azur chic with Slim Aarons photography, live piano music, and a menu straddling French and Italian traditions.
Service is theatrical, with waiters carrying freshly laid tabletops above their heads to replace courses between signature dishes like the Black Angus tagliata.

Name: L'Epicerie
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within the working kitchens of Claridge’s, L’Epicerie is an intimate private dining room and chef’s table for just 14 guests.
The space functions as a culinary theatre where the boundary between chefs and diners dissolves amidst copper lighting and constant action.
A marble pass serves as the stage for signature rituals, including the presentation of a theatrical canard à la presse or freshly baked soufflé.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Blacks Club
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a 1732 Georgian townhouse built by Christopher Wren’s apprentice John Meard Jr., this Soho sanctuary was once the residence of Charles Fortnum.
Founded as a bohemian counterpoint to the traditional White’s Club, the venue operates as a supper club where conversation takes precedence over business.
The candlelit interiors are loosely based on Dante’s Divine Comedy, featuring dark wood paneling, roaring open fires, and hidden feasting rooms.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations 7 days in advance will receive a full refund. Cancellations 7 days to 24 hours in advance will receive a 50% refund. Cancellations for events starting within 24 hours are non-refundable. Event date of a confirmed booking can be changed to another date within 6 months from the original date, at no cost.

Name: The Rosebery
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the Mandarin Oriental Hyde Park, this Knightsbridge salon revives a 1920s tea room once frequented by Lord Rosebery.
The G&A Designs interior blends Victorian heritage with modern flair, hosting a service led by Executive Pastry Chef Emmanuel Bonneau.
Beyond classic scones, the menu distinguishes itself with rare Butterfly Pea Flower tea and unexpected pairings of sake or Alsatian wine.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A cancellation fee of £50 per person applies if the booking is cancelled within 72 hours of the reservation time.

Name: The Drawing Room at Brown's Hotel
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within Mayfair’s Brown’s Hotel, London’s first hotel established in 1837, this wood-paneled salon serves as the property’s dedicated tea lounge.
The interior balances Victorian weight with modern lightness, offsetting original mahogany wainscoting and antique fireplaces with bold contemporary art.
Accompanied by a resident pianist, the venue’s signature afternoon tea service honors a tradition famously enjoyed by Queen Victoria herself.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Credit or debit card details are required to secure a reservation. Cancellations made within 24 hours of the reservation, or no-shows, are subject to a charge of £30 per person. Tables may be released 15 minutes after the reservation time.

Name: Cedric Grolet at The Berkeley
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within The Berkeley, this is the first London outpost from Cédric Grolet, the French pâtissier named the World's Best Pastry Chef in 2018.
Designed by Rémi Tessier, the space functions as a laboratory where chefs craft hyper-realistic fruit creations in full view of guests.
A standout exclusive is the trompe-l'œil scone, which reimagines the British classic with a marmalade center and a delicate, sculpted shell.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If you fail to arrive for your reservation without notice, or cancel your booking within 72 hours of your reservation, the full amount per person will apply. If you have not confirmed your reservation 24 hours before booking, we reserve the right to cancel the reservation and resell the table. We may release the table after 15 minutes of the reservation time.

Name: Sketch
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a converted 18th-century townhouse, this Mayfair destination is the brainchild of restaurateur Mourad Mazouz and chef Pierre Gagnaire.
The Gallery operates as a dynamic art space, currently transformed by the sculptural installation "The Gathering" by British artist Jonathan Baldock.
Most visits conclude with a trip to the white, egg-shaped toilet pods, a permanent design fixture that creates a distinct, immersive ritual.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Athenaeum
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on Piccadilly in Mayfair, this contemporary British dining room operates within the five-star Athenaeum Hotel & Residences.
The kitchen serves a seasonal, sustainably minded menu that champions local produce in a space designed for all-day dining.
Its signature "Fancies & Foliage" afternoon tea draws inspiration from the hotel’s Patrick Blanc-designed living wall and the flora of Green Park.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations of 6 or more guests require a credit card number to secure the booking. A £20 cancellation fee per person will be charged should the booking be cancelled with less than 24 hours' notice.

Name: Scoff at The Savoy
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Awarded Pastry Opening of the Year 2025 by La Liste, Scoff is a scone boutique at The Savoy led by chef Nicolas Houchet.
The concept elevates the afternoon tea staple into a standalone dessert, offering oversized bakes filled with creams and compotes.
Rotating menus feature inventive flavours such as salted caramel popcorn or tiramisu, each finished with elaborate garnishes.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We do not offer refunds or exchanges on perishable goods from Scoff.

Name: Mirror Room
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within the Rosewood London, this all-day dining salon serves as the hotel's central social hub.
The jewel box interior is defined by floor-to-ceiling decorative mirrors, low lighting, and plush lounge seating.
Executive Pastry Chef Mark Perkins crafts the signature Art Afternoon Tea, interpreting works by masters like Monet into sculptural patisserie.

Name: Restaurant 1890
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within The Savoy, this Michelin-starred restaurant from Gordon Ramsay honours Georges Auguste Escoffier, who joined the property in 1890.
The kitchen executes a modern French tasting menu that updates classic recipes with contemporary techniques and seasonal ingredients.
With just 26 seats, the gold-hued space overlooks the hotel’s entrance and features a wine list with four distinct pairing tiers.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We require a deposit of £100 p/p. We have 72-hour cancellation policy, if cancelled within that you will forfeit the deposit paid.

Name: Garrick Theatre
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Commissioned by W.S. Gilbert and designed by Walter Emden, this Victorian playhouse stands on Charing Cross Road.
The auditorium features an Italian Renaissance aesthetic with polished walnut panelling and marble accents throughout the space.
A hidden feat of engineering lies beneath the stalls, where the foundations bridge an underground river discovered during excavation.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Tickets cannot be refunded. Subject to availability, exchanges and upgrades can be made for the same show in the same theatre, for tickets at the same price or higher than your original booking. To request an exchange, please complete our exchange form at least 48 hours before the performance. No refunds or exchanges will be offered as a result of a cast member’s unavailability. In the event of a cancellation, an exchange or refund will be offered.

Name: Opera Tavern
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Set within a converted pub in Covent Garden, this tapas bar and dining room is operated by the Salt Yard Group.
The kitchen bridges Spanish and Italian traditions with a menu of charcoal-grilled meats, seasonal sharing plates, and artisan charcuterie.
While the daily specials showcase market produce, the signature mini Ibérico pork and foie gras burger remains the standout dish.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Card details are required to secure your booking. A cancellation fee of £25 per person applies to cancellations made within 24 hours of the reservation time.

Name: Tom's Kitchen
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched on the 62nd floor of The Langham Jakarta, this European brasserie is the first Asian outpost from celebrated British chef Tom Aikens.
The space channels a refined yet relaxed atmosphere with leather banquettes and parquet flooring, centred around a lively open kitchen and wood-fired grill.
Floor-to-ceiling windows frame dramatic views of the SCBD skyline, while the menu highlights nostalgic British classics like chicken Kiev and dry-aged porterhouse steak.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Theatre Royal Drury Lane
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Covent Garden, London's oldest theatre site was recently restored by composer Andrew Lloyd Webber and architects Haworth Tompkins.
The Grade I-listed landmark serves as an all-day venue, inviting visitors to enjoy its Regency interiors without a show ticket.
A highlight is the Grand Saloon, where afternoon tea is served beneath crystal chandeliers with access to the columned portico terrace.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Tickets are non-refundable unless the event is cancelled. Full-price tickets for long-running productions may be exchanged for tickets of equivalent or higher value up to 48 hours before the performance for a £3 fee, subject to availability. One-off events, lottery, day seats, and promotional tickets are non-exchangeable.

Name: Lima Cantina
Master_Aurora_Insights:
This Covent Garden establishment from Virgilio Martínez and the Gonzalez brothers has rebranded from Lima Floral to the more casual Lima Cantina.
The kitchen focuses on charcoal-grilled meats and sharing plates, serving as an informal counterpoint to the group's Fitzrovia original.
A signature draw is the Pollo a la Brasa, marinated for twenty-four hours and roasted in a bespoke rotisserie oven.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Casa Malevo
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London’s Connaught Village, this rustic Argentinian restaurant is the work of chef Diego Jacquet.
The dining room channels the warmth of a private home with rough brick walls, vintage photographs of gauchos, and a glass-roofed conservatory.
Menus focus on traditional staples like hand-cut empanadas and grilled sweetbreads, while the downstairs private room offers a secluded space for group feasts.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We require a deposit payment in advance to secure bookings of 6 or more in either the Main Restaurant or our Private Room. Advance notification of at least 48 hrs is required to cancel a reservation and secure a refund of your deposit.

Name: Kastner & Ovens
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Anne-Marie Kastner and Sue Ovens, this compact London staple serves wholesome takeaway from intimate outposts in Covent Garden and Spitalfields.
The daily changing offering focuses on quality over complexity, with vibrant salads and hot dishes heaped high on rustic counter displays.
Locals willingly queue for the dense, flaky sausage rolls or the comforting potato bake, proving that simple, home-style cooking remains a perennial draw.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Coal Rooms
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Occupying the Grade II-listed former ticket office at Peckham Rye station, this restaurant reclaims a 1930s heritage site for modern dining.
A bespoke coal-fired grill anchors the open kitchen, driving a menu focused on dry-aged butchery and smoke-infused seasonal produce.
Original 1930s windows illuminate the dining room, creating a striking backdrop for the signature Sunday roasts and grilled specialties.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Monmouth Kitchen
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Anchoring the Seven Dials neighbourhood, this vibrant spot is a key player in the Edwardian Hotels culinary portfolio.
The menu splits its attention between Italian antipasti and Peruvian small plates, encouraging a shared approach that highlights the best of both cuisines.
For a definitive taste, order the sea bass ceviche with avocado, corn and red onion, a fresh counterpoint to the room’s sleek, contemporary design.

Name: Mr Chow
Master_Aurora_Insights: Established in London in 1968 by painter and restaurateur Michael Chow, this dining institution bridges the gap between authentic Beijing cuisine and the international art scene. The dining room is defined by crisp white linens, original artwork, and a disciplined service style that treats the meal as a performance. Every evening features a live noodle-pulling show, a kinetic ritual that accompanies classics like the Green Prawns and Beijing Duck.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Stanfords
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Established in 1853 by Edward Stanford, this Covent Garden institution is the world’s largest map and travel bookshop, having supplied explorers like Ernest Shackleton and Captain Scott.
The specialist retailer stocks a vast collection of maps, maritime charts, and travel literature, serving as a primary resource for adventurers.
Its modern Mercer Walk location features signature design elements, including giant globes and a floor printed with a detailed map of London.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Stanfords will accept back all goods that have been purchased from us and that are returned in their original condition within 21 days. Stanfords will also accept back all goods that are faulty (Faulty goods must be reported to Stanfords within 48 hours of goods being delivered. Faulty goods reported after this period would be addressed at our discretion.) or that are deemed by you to be not of satisfactory quality, not fit for their purpose or not matching their description, regardless of whether the product has been used or not. Shipping charges will not be refunded. Under the Distance Selling Regulations, you have a right to cancel your order for any item purchased on this website for a full refund. Your right to cancel does not apply to items that have been used or fitted by you. In addition the right to cancel does not apply to software that has been opened or unsealed. No refunds or exchanges can be given on items made to your specification, such as print-on-demand and made to measure items, unless there is a manufacturing defect, or the goods are not as ordered.

Name: The Salisbury
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Built by John Cathles Hill in 1899, this Grade II-listed Covent Garden landmark is a definitive example of the late-Victorian gin palace.
The interior is a masterclass in Art Nouveau opulence, featuring curvilinear mahogany fittings, red velvet banquettes, and elaborate gold chandeliers.
Notable for its appearance in the film Victim, the space retains original "SS" monograms etched into the glass, referencing its origins as Salisbury Stores.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For standard, non-event bookings, no deposit is required. For large groups or special events, a deposit is required. Cancellations must be made at least 48 hours in advance to avoid a charge.

Name: Homeslice
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Ry Jessup and Mark Wogan, this London staple evolved from a mobile oven into permanent sites including a flagship in Neal’s Yard.
The kitchen specializes in wood-fired, 20-inch pizzas served whole or by the slice, pairing classic techniques with globally inspired, seasonal ingredients.
Order the signature mushroom, ricotta, pumpkin seeds, and chilli pie, a crisp combination that exemplifies the brand’s rustic ethos.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Neal's Yard is walk-in only.

Name: Joe Allen
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by the late restaurateur Joe Allen in 1965, this theatre-district staple maintains outposts in New York and London.
The brick-lined canteen serves as a post-performance hub for the stage community, offering American classics to stagehands and stars alike.
Its interior features the "Wall of Flops," a collection of posters from ill-fated productions that closed within days of their premieres.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Dinner: $25 per person cancellation fee for late cancellations within 12 hours or no-shows. Lunch: $10 per person cancellation fee within 12 hours. Larger parties are subject to a 72-hour cancellation policy.

Name: Dishoom
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by cousins Shamil and Kavi Thakrar, this Covent Garden mainstay is a loyal homage to the disappearing Irani cafés of Bombay.
The interior channels a 1949 narrative with bentwood chairs, sepia-toned portraits, and low-hanging fans that cultivate a bustling, democratic atmosphere.
While the Bacon Naan Roll commands the morning queue, the House Black Daal, simmered for 24 hours, remains the kitchen’s defining culinary achievement.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Dishoom is primarily a walk-in restaurant, but reservations are available for groups (and for all sizes at certain times/locations). For group bookings, a deposit is required which is redeemed against the final bill. This deposit is fully refundable if the reservation is cancelled at least 24 hours in advance. Late cancellations or no-shows may result in the forfeiture of the deposit.

Name: Big Easy
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed within the Foster + Partners-designed Crossrail Place, this expansive venue is the flagship of Paul Corrett’s London-based barbecue and seafood group.
The dockside warehouse aesthetic provides a rustic backdrop for lively communal dining, accompanied by a soundtrack of nightly live blues.
Menus feature fresh Nova Scotian lobster and wood-smoked barbecue, served alongside an extensive selection of whiskies and frozen cocktails.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: For parties under 20 guests, no card details are taken; guests are asked to inform the restaurant of cancellations as soon as possible. Tables are held for 15 minutes. For parties of 20 to 50 guests, a 72-hour cancellation notice is required. For parties of 50 to 100 guests, 7 days notice is required. Cancellations within these periods incur a charge equal to the deposit paid.

Name: Apollo Theatre
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Standing on Shaftesbury Avenue, this Grade II listed venue was designed by architect Lewin Sharp for owner Henry Lowenfeld.
The structure holds the distinction of being the first theatre built in London during the Edwardian era, defined by its Portland stone French Renaissance facade.
It remains Sharp’s only complete theatre commission, featuring an intimate Louis XIV style auditorium known for London's steepest balcony.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Tickets cannot be exchanged or refunded. In the event of a performance being cancelled, alternative performances or a refund will be offered. If there is a material change to the performance, tickets may be exchanged or refunded. Tickets may be returned for resale up to 24 hours before the performance, but will only be sold after all other tickets have been sold. Latecomers may be admitted during a suitable break but admission is not guaranteed.

Name: Vardo
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated in Chelsea’s Duke of York Square, this cylindrical pavilion from the Caravan team occupies an award-winning structure by Nex Architecture.
The kitchen serves a nomadic, globally inspired menu spanning from morning coffee to evening shared plates, reflecting a well-travelled culinary ethos.
Uniquely, the building features floor-to-ceiling curved glass walls that retract into the basement, transforming the dining room into an open-air terrace.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Milk Train
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London’s Covent Garden, this dessert café is the brainchild of Mike Tran and features an award-winning interior by Formroom.
The space channels a whimsical train-station aesthetic with Art Deco cues and playful "Mind the Gap" floor markings.
Signature soft-serve cones are wrapped in clouds of candy floss, creating a surreal, floating treat that defines the brand’s playful identity.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND
