Name: The Tamil Crown
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Recognized in the UK's Top 50 Gastropubs, The Tamil Crown is a South Indian restaurant from the team behind The Tamil Prince, housed in a converted Islington pub.
The two-story venue maintains its traditional English pub character while serving regional curries and small plates.
A weekly Sunday service features an Indian-inspired roast, pairing options like masala chicken with turmeric roast potatoes and Yorkshire puddings.

Name: SUMI
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Notting Hill, SUMI is a modern Japanese restaurant from sushi master Endo Kazutoshi, serving as the casual sister to his Michelin-starred Endo at the Rotunda.
The menu focuses on precise sushi and sashimi presented in an understated dining room defined by pale wood and Japandi design.
Signature items like fatty tuna nigiri and temaki hand rolls anchor the offering, which guests can enjoy on the outdoor terrace.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Tableau
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the Forbes Five-Star Wynn Tower Suites in Las Vegas, Tableau is an American fine-dining restaurant.
The conservatory-like space serves as a daytime destination, offering a menu of breakfast, brunch, and lunch dishes crafted from market-fresh seasonal ingredients.
Guests dine indoors or on the poolside patio, enjoying morning favorites just steps from the private Tower Suites elevator.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Parsons
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London’s Covent Garden, Parsons is a compact seafood restaurant from Will Palmer and Ian Campbell, the team behind the neighboring wine bar The 10 Cases.
The dining room focuses on straightforward fish cookery paired with a wine list divided into coastal and classic varieties.
The daily changing menu highlights freshly landed whole fish alongside signature staples like salt cod fritters and octopus stew.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Straits Kitchen
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Straits Kitchen is the flagship restaurant at the Pan Pacific London hotel, led by executive chef Adam Bateman.
The dining room pairs floor-to-ceiling views of the City with a menu that blends Southeast Asian flavors and British ingredients.
A signature dish is the dry-aged Gressingham duck, prepared using Western cooking techniques and served with Peking-style pancakes.

Name: Tofu Vegan
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by restaurateur Zhang Chao of Xi'an Impression, Tofu Vegan is a completely plant-based Chinese restaurant with several locations across London.
The kitchen bypasses modern meat substitutes in favor of centuries-old culinary practices, utilizing massaged tofu, seitan, and mushrooms to recreate regional dishes.
A signature item is the twice-cooked mock fish, which incorporates a strip of seaweed into flattened bean curd to deliver a briny flavor.

Name: Pinna
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Led by Chef Achille Pinna and the team behind Lita, Pinna is a Michelin-recognized Sardinian restaurant in London's Mayfair.
Occupying a former bank, the dining room centers around a fireplace and serves Italian fare rooted in the chef's island heritage.
The menu highlights handmade pastas like andarinos with venison ragu, alongside a signature ricotta cannoli flavored with prickly pear and pistachio.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Nippon
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Nippon, the formal Japanese name for Japan, is an East Asian island nation recognized with 26 UNESCO World Heritage sites.
The archipelago is characterized by its mountainous volcanic terrain, historic Shinto shrines, and modern urban centers like Tokyo.
A defining cultural practice is hanami, the centuries-old spring ritual of gathering to view seasonal cherry blossoms.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: To avoid a $100 cancellation fee charge per person, any cancellations or reductions in the party size must be made at least 24 hours in advance.

Name: The Meat and Wine Co
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by Seagrass Boutique Hospitality Group, The Meat and Wine Co is an African-inspired steakhouse brand with locations across Australia and London.
The menu integrates South African culinary heritage with contemporary influences, focusing on steaks, seafood, and seasonal ingredients.
Designed by architecture firm COOOP, select locations feature interiors with structural elements inspired by traditional African Tata Somba dwellings.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: If you cancel within 24 hours of your reservation, arrive with fewer guests than booked, or do not attend, a $50 per person fee will apply. For bookings with a set menu or beverage package, the final guest count confirmed 24 hours prior will be charged as a minimum.

Name: Roketsu
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by Chef Daisuke Hayashi, Roketsu is a Michelin-recognized Japanese restaurant in London's Marylebone neighborhood.
The kitchen offers Kyoto-style kaiseki and kappo tasting menus, focusing on seasonal ingredients and precise Japanese cooking methods.
Guests dine in a Sukiya-style room at a ten-seat counter crafted from 100-year-old hinoki wood, watching dishes prepared over binchō charcoal.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Our Cancellation and No-Show policies apply to all dining areas, with a charge of £50 per person. Cancellations made within 24 hours of your reservation time will incur the above charge.

Name: Randall & Aubin
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London's Soho, Randall & Aubin is an Anglo-French seafood brasserie led by Chef Ed Baines.
The restaurant focuses on sustainably sourced seafood, classic steaks, and champagne, operating in a space that first opened as a butcher shop in 1911.
Diners eat at marble tables surrounded by the original white tiled walls and a large disco ball suspended from the ceiling.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations for parties of four or more must be made at least 12 hours prior to the reservation time to avoid a £25 charge per person.

Name: NIJŪ
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in a Mayfair townhouse, NIJŪ is a Japanese restaurant directed by third-generation sushi chef Endo Kazutoshi of the Michelin-starred Endo at The Rotunda.
The menu focuses on ‘katei ryori’ or home-style cooking, presenting an informal approach to traditional Japanese fare.
Beyond a heavy velvet curtain, the space features an open sushi counter serving seared otoro topped with caviar and an adjoining cocktail bar named Nipperkin.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Deposits are non-refundable if cancellation occurs within 72 hours of your reservation.

Name: Cobi's
Master_Aurora_Insights: Cobi's is a Southeast Asian restaurant at 2104 Main St, Santa Monica, CA 90405, conceived by Australian-born restaurateur Cobi Marsh, who built the concept around the intersection of food, design, and music into one singular hospitality experience. The menu spans Thai, Indonesian, and Indian dishes, with the dining room and two patios regularly packed through the night; signature offerings include beef rendang, curry puffs filled with curried split peas and potatoes, kanpachi crudo in coconut milk with finger lime, and wood-grilled prawns in ginger and yellow bean sauce.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Permit Room
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by Macaulay Sinclair, Permit Room is an all-day bar and café concept from the Indian restaurant group Dishoom, operating in multiple UK cities.
The spaces reference the historic permit rooms of Bombay, establishing a neighborhood environment that shifts from morning chai to evening cocktails.
The menu pairs Dishoom’s signature House Black Daal with new additions like Permit Room Fried Chicken, served amid mid-century vintage laminate tables.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: 24-hour cancellation policy. For parties of 12 or more, a £50 deposit is required, which is refundable if cancelled at least 24 hours before the booking. The restaurant will hold your table for up to 15 minutes if you are running late.

Name: Ogam Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Ogam Bar is a Korean restaurant and cocktail spot in London's Islington neighborhood, founded by award-winning bartender Taeyeol Kim.
The intimate space focuses on the concept of anju, pairing traditional small plates like fried chicken and tteokbokki with craft drinks.
The bar serves its own house-made makgeolli, a natural, unpasteurized rice wine brewed in small batches by Kim himself.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We kindly ask you for a 24hr cancellation notice. No show and same day cancellations have a massive impact on our small business and we will not take future reservations from those customers.

Name: Ai Fiori
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by the Altamarea Group, Ai Fiori is a restaurant within The Langham on Fifth Avenue that earned three stars from The New York Times.
The kitchen focuses on modern interpretations of French and Italian Riviera cuisine, emphasizing seasonal ingredients and regional traditions.
The menu features signature handmade pastas, such as the Trofie Nero prepared with seafood.

Name: Chang
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Situated on the historic market square in Grünwald, Germany, Chang is a Michelin-recognized restaurant owned and operated by Alexander Wasowski.
The kitchen focuses on Asian fusion, combining traditional Thai and Japanese specialties with European culinary techniques.
Diners can order the signature lobster soup, which is prepared with wild-caught shrimp and fresh ginger.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Scully
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London's St James's Market, Scully is the debut solo restaurant from former NOPI head chef Ramael Scully.
The dining room eschews traditional formality, pairing a Motown soundtrack with an eclectic, pantry-led tasting menu.
A prominent fermentation wall displays the kitchen's collection of house-made pickles, syrups, and preserves, which form the foundation of the chef's Asian-influenced dishes.

Name: Gucci Osteria da Massimo Bottura
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within the Gucci Garden on Florence's Piazza della Signoria, this Michelin-starred restaurant is a collaboration between the fashion house and chef Massimo Bottura.
The dining room features green walls, velvet seating, and custom boiserie, providing a backdrop for contemporary variations on Italian classics.
A notable dish is the chef's signature tortellini served in a Parmigiano Reggiano cream.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A credit card is required to reserve. For the Florence location, a fee of €120 per person applies for no-shows or cancellations made less than 48 hours in advance. For the Tokyo location, 100% of the cancellation fee is charged for cancellations on the day of the reservation, or JPY 5,000 per person for a la carte reservations.

Name: Zoilo
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by Chef Patron Diego Jacquet, Zoilo is a Michelin-listed modern Argentine grill located in London's Marylebone neighborhood.
The menu centers around fire-led cooking, pairing seasonal British produce with traditional Argentine techniques and regional specialties.
Guests can dine at the U-shaped bar counter overlooking the open kitchen, surrounded by bright red studded banquettes and a checkerboard floor.

Name: Taka
Master_Aurora_Insights: Taka (also known as Taka Sushi) is a fine Japanese restaurant located at 555 Fifth Avenue near the corner of Market Street in San Diego's historic Gaslamp Quarter, operating nightly for dinner with a price point in the upper-mid range. Taka's kitchen fuses Western and Japanese cuisines, with signature dishes including baked black cod marinated in saikyo miso served with steamed rice and organic vegetable sauté, and New York prime beef with oroshi yuzu ponzu and sesame miso, alongside traditional sashimi and nigiri preparations.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Sambal Shiok
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by chef Mandy Yin, Sambal Shiok evolved from a street food pop-up into a permanent Malaysian restaurant in North London.
The kitchen focuses on Kuala Lumpur-style fare, anchoring its concise menu around complex, deeply spiced broths.
The signature laksa features a rich coconut soup base and thick rice noodles, typically ordered alongside the crispy fried chicken with peanut sauce.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Card details are required for all online bookings. If a table is cancelled with less than 24 hours' notice, payment of £10 a head will be charged to the card.

Name: Roostiq
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by restaurateur Zoilo Álvarez, Roostiq is a farm-to-table Spanish restaurant with outposts in Madrid's Chueca neighborhood and Marbella.
The kitchen relies entirely on fire, embers, and smoke to prepare seasonal ingredients sourced directly from the restaurant's own organic farm.
Signature menu items include charcoal-grilled wagyu picaña, wood-fired pizzas, and pork crackling alongside flame-grilled broad beans.

Name: Ukai
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Originating in Japan, the Michelin-recognized Ukai group operates a collection of dining destinations specializing in teppanyaki and traditional kaiseki cuisine.
Each location features a specific setting, often incorporating historic Japanese architecture, landscaped gardens, and curated European antiques.
At the group's teppanyaki outposts, chefs prepare signature dishes like salt-steamed abalone and premium wagyu beef on iron griddles directly in front of diners.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: 50% cancellation fee if cancelled one day before the reservation; 100% cancellation fee if cancelled on the day of the reservation.

Name: Phat Phuc Noodle Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Recognized as a London culinary institution, Phat Phuc Noodle Bar is a Vietnamese street-food stand tucked into a Chelsea courtyard.
The casual outdoor shack channels the energy of Southeast Asian night markets and provides a relaxed contrast to the area.
The menu centers on steaming bowls of traditional pho and a signature spicy coconut laksa served with rice noodles.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Portrait by Richard Corrigan
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Perched on the top floor of London's National Portrait Gallery, The Portrait is a modern British restaurant helmed by Michelin-starred chef Richard Corrigan.
The space offers an all-day dining format with a menu focused on seasonal British ingredients and classic European techniques.
Expansive windows provide guests with panoramic views of Trafalgar Square and the Houses of Parliament.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We ask that all cancellations be made at least 24 hours prior to your reservation time. No-shows or late cancellations will incur a charge of £20 per person, applied to the card on file. For security reasons, we may request identification on arrival that matches the credit card provided and may hold this ID for the duration of your visit. Management reserves the right to refuse admission at any time.

Name: The Starman
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on London's Heddon Street, The Starman is a David Bowie-inspired pub situated steps from where the artist was photographed for his 1972 Ziggy Stardust album cover.
The venue updates the traditional British public house format, pairing Neapolitan pizzas and elevated comfort food with craft cocktails and late-night DJ sets.
A large replica of the historic album photograph anchors the interior, displayed prominently beside the main bar.

Name: Pollini
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Awarded three forks by Gambero Rosso, this Italian restaurant by chef Emanuele Pollini sits within Ladbroke Hall, an arts and social club in London's Notting Hill.
The kitchen prepares regional Italian dishes, incorporating seasonal produce and British coastal seafood into its changing menus.
Signature plates like spaghetti gambero rosso are served in a dining room anchored by a floating chandelier from designer Nacho Carbonell.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Vatavaran
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Vatavaran is a contemporary Indian restaurant in London's Knightsbridge neighborhood, created by Michelin-starred chef Rohit Ghai and hospitality expert Abhishake Sangwan.
The concept draws inspiration from the Himalayas, focusing on traditional regional dishes prepared over an open-flame Sigri grill.
The earth-toned interiors span four distinct levels, featuring the Shikhar cocktail bar and the Brook and Meadow private dining rooms.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Bistro Na's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by Chef Tian, Bistro Na's is a Michelin-recognized Chinese restaurant located in the San Gabriel Valley city of Temple City, California.
The kitchen specializes in Chinese imperial cuisine, focusing on the royal Manchu dishes of the Qing Dynasty.
Diners frequently order the signature crispy shrimp, a dish prepared with a sweet, crunchy batter over plump meat.

Name: Xi'an Impression
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London's Holloway neighborhood, Xi'an Impression is a compact Chinese restaurant co-founded by chef Guirong Wei, who was featured on Netflix's Chef's Table: Noodles.
The kitchen specializes in the regional street food of Shaanxi province, focusing on the northwestern culinary traditions of its namesake city.
The signature biang biang noodles consist of wide, hand-pulled ribbons of dough tossed in a tangy, garlicky chili oil.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: OISO
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by Chef William, OiSO Korean Street Food is a casual dining spot located in the Virginia suburb of Annandale.
The kitchen prepares made-from-scratch Korean comfort fare, maintaining a straightforward approach to traditional street snacks and hearty bowls.
Signature menu items include the tightly rolled bulgogi kimbap and a crisp mozzarella donkatsu, served alongside warming portions of rose tteok-bokki.

Name: Sasa Sushi
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Designed by Layer 02 Design, Sasa Sushi is a family-run Japanese restaurant located inside a 2,700-square-foot Grade II listed building in London's Clerkenwell neighborhood.
The interior preserves original architectural elements like a cast iron fireplace while introducing clean lines and natural wood finishes.
A blue sushi bar crafted from traditional timber anchors the main dining room beneath a historic roof dome.

Name: The Benjamin Hollywood
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Ben Shenassafar and Jared Meisler, The Benjamin Hollywood is an Art Deco-inspired restaurant featuring a menu by Spago alum Johnny Cirelle.
The kitchen focuses on classic American fare, serving updated versions of familiar staples like steak frites and burgers in a dark wood-paneled room.
Guests sit in olive green mohair booths under frosted glass chandeliers to drink the signature Ben’s Martini, served with potato chips.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: TAKA
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London's Marylebone Village, TAKA is a contemporary Japanese restaurant led by Chef Taiji Maruyama and founders Andrey and Anastasia Datsenko.
The kitchen applies traditional Japanese cooking techniques to seasonal British produce across a menu of small plates, sushi, and grilled dishes.
Signature offerings include an A5 Wagyu katsu sando and Loch Duart salmon tataki, served within a space designed by B3 Designers.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Steak 48
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by restaurateurs Jeffrey and Michael Mastro, Steak 48 operates multiple steakhouses in cities including Beverly Hills, Chicago, and Charlotte.
The venues update the traditional steakhouse format by featuring distinct dining rooms and a glass-enclosed show kitchen.
The menu highlights USDA Prime cuts and Japanese A5 Wagyu alongside signature sides like Alaskan king crab and rock shrimp mac and cheese.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A credit card is required to hold the reservation, with some locations or special events requiring a deposit. Cancellations must be made at least 48 hours in advance. Late cancellations or no-shows are subject to a per-person cancellation fee that varies by location and date (typically $25 to $75 per person, and up to $150 per person for holidays).

Name: Pizza Union
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Bobby Hashemi and designed by architecture practice I-AM Associates, Pizza Union is a fast-casual pizza bar with multiple locations across London.
The concept focuses on all-day convenience, offering a streamlined menu of fire-baked, Roman-style thin and crispy pizzas alongside a few salads.
The stripped-back interiors feature communal wooden tables, industrial finishes, and bright neon signage.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Herbsaint
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Central Business District of New Orleans, Herbsaint is the flagship restaurant from James Beard Award-winning chef Donald Link.
The kitchen prepares French-inspired Southern fare, applying traditional European bistro techniques to regional Louisiana ingredients and local seafood.
A permanent fixture on the menu is the signature Muscovy duck leg confit, which arrives served over citrus-accented dirty rice.

Name: RedFarm
Master_Aurora_Insights:
RedFarm is a modern Chinese restaurant with two locations in New York City, developed by chef Joe Ng and restaurateur Ed Schoenfeld.
The menu focuses on unconventional dim sum and market-driven dishes that incorporate local ingredients into regional Chinese recipes.
The kitchen serves signature Pac-Man dumplings and Katz's pastrami egg rolls, establishing a highly visual approach to plating.

Name: Suzi Tros
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London's Notting Hill, Suzi Tros is a modern Greek bistro from Christina Mouratoglou and Adrien Carré, the restaurateurs behind the Michelin-listed neighboring establishment Mazi.
The kitchen focuses on seasonal small plates and charcoal-grilled dishes inspired by the traditional eateries of Thessaloniki.
The restaurant takes its name, which translates to "Suzy, you eat," from a line in the 1960s Greek comedy film Pariziana.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: We kindly ask you to confirm your booking no later than 4pm on the day and if you’re running late please contact us otherwise your table might be released after 20 minutes.

Name: Opso
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Andreas Labridis and chef Nikos Roussos, OPSO is a modern Greek restaurant situated in the London neighborhood of Marylebone.
The kitchen focuses on contemporary sharing plates, utilizing seasonal ingredients sourced directly from Greece.
Athens-based architecture firm K-Studio designed the two-story interior, blending regional and British design elements into a light-filled dining room.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Top Cuvée
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Top Cuvée is a London restaurant and wine bar in Highbury, founded by Brodie Meah, formerly of Dinner by Heston, and Max Venning of Three Sheets.
The kitchen draws inspiration from Parisian bistros, pairing seasonal small plates with a focus on natural and low-intervention wines.
The dining experience centers on a concise, one-page wine list and an adjoining bottle shop that originated as a neighborhood delivery service.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Topa at Provisions
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Led by chef Simon Shand of Michelin-starred Leroy, Topa is a Basque-inspired residency inside the Provisions deli on North London's Holloway Road.
The shop transforms into an evening pintxo bar, serving a rotating menu of small plates from a compact open kitchen.
Guests dine at repurposed wine barrels, pairing traditional Patxaran and tonic with bites like salt hake brandade and sauteed mushrooms with raw egg yolk.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The Hunter's Moon
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in South Kensington, The Hunter's Moon is a pub and dining room from Lunar Pub Company founders Hubert Beatson-Hird and chef Oliver Marlowe.
The venue operates as a casual front bar and a rear restaurant serving a daily-changing menu of modern European fare.
The dining room features dark sage walls and green leather booths, where guests order dishes like duck breast with confit pommes sarladaise.

Name: Blue Hill
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Blue Hill is a Michelin-starred restaurant in New York's Greenwich Village, founded by Chef Dan Barber.
The daily tasting menu highlights seasonal harvests sourced from local growers and the affiliated Stone Barns Center for Food and Agriculture.
Situated three steps below street level, the dining room occupies a landmark nineteenth-century townhouse that once operated as a speakeasy.
Master_Cancellation_Policy:
Blue Hill at Stone Barns: All sales are final and reservations cannot be canceled. The menu price is prepaid during booking.
Family Meal at Blue Hill (New York City): A credit card is required to hold the reservation. A cancellation fee of $50 per person applies for cancellations made within two days of the reservation (five days for the private Garden Room).

Name: Los Fuegos
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within Miami Beach's Faena Hotel, Los Fuegos is an Argentinian steakhouse helmed by Michelin-recognized chef Francis Mallmann.
The menu centers on South American live-fire cooking, delivering a contemporary asado experience in a dining room defined by leopard prints and red upholstery.
An open wood-fired kitchen anchors the space, where signature dishes like skirt steak and wood-oven empanadas are prepared over glowing embers.

Name: Ria's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Ria's is a Detroit-style pizza and natural wine bar located on All Saints Road in London's Notting Hill, founded by Ria and Dave Morgan-Ratcliffe.
The neighborhood spot pairs deep-dish, square-cut pizzas with a rotating selection of natural wines sourced from small producers.
The pizza dough is made using regenerative flour and undergoes a 72-hour fermentation process, resulting in a light base with a crispy edge.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Bookings can be changed or cancelled up to 24 hours before the reservation. If you do not show up to your reservation, or do not cancel within this timeframe, all bookings will be subject to the terms of booking found in your confirmation email and no-show fee's will apply. We’ll always hold your table for 15 minutes! If you are running later than that, we can’t promise a table – we’ll still do our best to seat you but there may be a delay.

Name: Hippocampus
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Housed in a restored 17th-century building within the UNESCO-protected Old Town of Kotor, Boutique Hotel Hippocampus is a Wild Beauty Award-winning destination.
The property retains its original medieval stone walls while integrating modern furnishings and Mediterranean design elements across its 13 guest rooms.
A rooftop terrace provides an elevated vantage point for observing the surrounding mountains and ancient city fortifications.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Reservations can be cancelled free of charge up to 12 hours before the reserved time, while groups of 6 or more must cancel at least 24 hours in advance, and special events require 48 hours' notice. A late cancellation or no-show will result in a fee of EUR 30.00 per person. Tables are held for 20 minutes past the reservation time, after which the reservation is considered a no-show and the fee applies. The restaurant may require a credit card hold to secure reservations, particularly on weekends or busy days, to cover potential cancellation fees.

Name: Macchialina
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Miami Beach, Macchialina is a rustic Italian taverna helmed by James Beard-nominated chef Michael Pirolo and sommelier Jacqueline Pirolo.
The casual neighborhood restaurant focuses on handmade pastas and seasonal ingredients, offering a relaxed approach to regional Italian cooking.
The signature Cavatelli Macchialina anchors the daily menu, combining baby meatballs, porchetta, and pecorino in a traditional preparation.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: $50 per person credit card hold required, free cancellation up to 24 hours in advance.

Name: Kuon Omakase
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by chef Aki Fukada, Kuon Omakase is an 11-seat Japanese restaurant located in the Darling Square precinct of Sydney.
The culinary offering centers on a 20-course Edomae-style tasting menu that changes daily based on seasonal market catches.
Diners sit directly at the kitchen counter to watch the chef prepare and serve each piece of sushi and sashimi.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A deposit of $100 per person is required to confirm your booking. Deposits are non-refundable if cancellation occurs within 72 hours of your reservation.

Name: Two Fifteen
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within New York's Public Hotel, Two Fifteen is a cocktail bar created by hotelier Ian Schrager and nightlife operator Nur Khan.
The space features burlesque-inspired interiors with a minimal black color palette, crystal chandeliers, and a modern fireplace set beneath a large blue glass installation.
Mixologist Charlotte Voisey crafted the four-stage drink menu, which includes a made-to-order Gold Bellini garnished with raspberry and edible gold.

Name: Bufón
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located on the Lower East Side, Bufón is a modern European restaurant from chefs Quang Nguyen and Dina Fan, the culinary team behind Demo.
The wine-forward corner spot pairs a classic white-tablecloth dining room with a menu of bistro fare that incorporates international ingredients.
Signature dishes include raw clams dressed with lime juice and fish sauce, alongside a thinly sliced picanha au poivre.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Slim's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Slim's is a steakhouse by restaurateur Stephen Starr, located within Miami's Bal Harbour Shops.
Designed by the firm GACHOT, the space features a checkerboard marble floor and art deco-inspired murals by illustrator Christoph Niemann.
The menu includes a signature cheesesteak made with hand-cut Wagyu, black truffle, foie gras, and Cooper Sharp cheese on a sesame roll.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Le Grand Bain
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Belleville neighborhood of Paris, Le Grand Bain is a Michelin-recognized restaurant founded by British chef Edward Delling-Williams.
The dining room centers on a menu of seasonal small plates designed for sharing.
Guests can observe the culinary team at work in the semi-open kitchen while pairing dishes with selections from a cellar of over 300 organic and biodynamic natural wines.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Match 65 Brasserie
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by Philippe Kayadjanian, Match 65 Brasserie is a French restaurant situated on Manhattan's Upper East Side.
The neighborhood bistro features a traditional Parisian dining environment with its soft lighting, compact interior, and outdoor terrace seating.
The kitchen focuses on classic French staples like moules and steak tartare, alongside a tuna tartare named the best in the city by Foursquare.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: La Noxe
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Conceived by Kinfolk founder Jey Perie, La Noxe is a cocktail lounge tucked inside the 28th Street subway station in New York City.
The 600-square-foot space channels Mediterranean influences through a dimly lit, red-tinted room with velvet seating.
Visitors gain entry by pressing a single buzzer at street level before descending a staircase into the 30-person venue.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Cucina Alba
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Chelsea's Lantern House, Cucina Alba is a modern Italian restaurant operated by Prince Street Hospitality with a menu by Chef Adam Leonti.
The concept focuses on coastal Italian cuisine, serving signature items like fresh-milled focaccia and handmade pastas in a bright, relaxed environment.
Designed by GRT Architects, the dining room features pale oak millwork, lemon-yellow accents, and Thomas Heatherwick's faceted bay windows.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Or'esh
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in New York City's SoHo neighborhood, Or'esh is a Levantine restaurant developed by Catch Hospitality Group and Michelin-starred chef Nadav Greenberg.
The menu focuses on regional Mediterranean dishes prepared entirely through live-fire cooking over wood and coal.
Named after the Hebrew words for light and fire, the open kitchen revolves around a custom-built grill that anchors the main dining room.

Name: Nipotina
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in London's Mayfair, Nipotina is a neighbourhood Italian restaurant from restaurateur Samyukta Nair and Turin-born chef Somaia Hammad.
The dining room draws inspiration from traditional Italian architecture, incorporating soft clay plaster walls, green shutters, and earthy tones.
The menu features the Triangoli all'Aragosta, a signature dish of fresh, handmade pasta filled with lobster and a touch of spice.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Bookings will only be secured and confirmed through a valid credit or debit card. The payment link will be valid for 24 hours. A fee of £50 per person will apply for late cancellation within 24 hours before the booking or no show. We will release the table should guests fail to arrive within 15 minutes from the reservation time.

Name: Dogon
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by James Beard Award-winning chef Kwame Onwuachi, Dōgon is an Afro-Caribbean restaurant inside the Salamander Washington DC hotel.
The menu honors the West African lineage that helped shape the capital, blending Nigerian, Jamaican, Trinidadian, and Creole culinary traditions.
Designed by Modellus Novus, the dining room references the night sky, complementing signature dishes like lobster escovitch and blue crab with hoe cakes.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: $100 per person fee for cancellations within 24 hours or no-shows. Credit card required to hold reservation.

Name: Aux Prés
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Aux Prés is a vintage bistro in the Saint-Germain-des-Prés neighborhood of Paris, operated by Michelin-recommended chef Cyril Lignac.
The restaurant pairs a traditional setting with a menu that blends Gallic culinary roots with Asian and South American influences.
The dining room features red banquette seating, smoked-glass mirrors, and floral wallpaper, serving as the backdrop for shared cuts of meat like rib of beef.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Please note that in the event of a no-show or late cancellation on the day of booking (less than 72 hours before the booking date), 50 € per person will be charged to the credit card provided. After 15 minutes' delay, your table will no longer be guaranteed.

Name: Flagler Steakhouse
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located at The Breakers in Palm Beach, Flagler Steakhouse is an American chophouse overseen by Executive Chef Anthony Sicignano.
The menu focuses on traditional steakhouse fare, anchored by a selection of USDA prime cuts and seafood.
Designed by Adam D. Tihany, the space features exposed beamed ceilings and a red, white, and blue color palette with views of the golf course.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: La Goulue
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 1972 by restaurateur Jean Denoyer, La Goulue is a traditional French bistro with locations on New York's Upper East Side and in Palm Beach.
The dining rooms feature a Parisian aesthetic and serve as steady gathering places for neighborhood residents.
The menu centers on classic French fare, highlighted by the signature Le Soufflé au Fromage made with Gruyère, Parmesan, and white truffle oil.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Guests will be charged $40 per guest for no show.

Name: La Mercerie
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located inside the Roman and Williams Guild in Soho, La Mercerie is a French restaurant helmed by Chef Marie-Aude Rose.
The space functions as both a dining room and a homeware showroom, offering a menu centered on everyday French culinary traditions.
Diners sit on velour banquettes and can purchase the exact tableware, linens, and furniture used during their meal.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations must be made at least 24 hours in advance. A $60 fee applies for late cancellations or no-shows.

Name: Zou Zou's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Zou Zou's is an Eastern Mediterranean restaurant in Manhattan West Plaza, operated by Quality Branded and helmed by chefs Madeline Sperling and Juliana Latif.
The dining room centers around an open kitchen that prepares wood-fired dishes inspired by the Levant region.
A notable menu item is the duck borek, featuring finely ground duck piped into layers of yufka dough and shaped into a spiral.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations within 24 hours incur a $25 per person fee.

Name: Blue Ribbon Brasserie
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in 1992 by French-trained chefs Bruce and Eric Bromberg, Blue Ribbon Brasserie is a restaurant located in New York City's SoHo neighborhood.
The space built its reputation as a late-night industry hangout, offering an eclectic menu that draws off-duty chefs and locals alike.
A staple on the diverse menu is the signature beef marrow, served with toast and oxtail marmalade.

Name: Marius et Janette
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Recognized by the Michelin Guide, Marius et Janette is a seafood restaurant situated in the 8th arrondissement of Paris.
The dining room features a yacht-style mahogany interior complete with copper portholes, fishing rods, and nets.
The menu changes daily based on the fresh catch, highlighting house specialties like linguine with lobster and grilled seabass.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Born and Raised
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Born and Raised is a Michelin-recognized steakhouse in San Diego operated by the local hospitality group CH Projects.
Housed in a former 1930s drugstore, the multi-level space features a blend of mid-century modern and Art Deco design alongside a rooftop patio.
The restaurant emphasizes traditional service, utilizing carts for the table-side preparation of various dishes and cocktails.

Name: Kosaka
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in New York City's Greenwich Village, Kosaka is a Michelin-starred Japanese restaurant led by Chef Masatomo Soma.
The minimalist dining room features a traditional aesthetic, centered around a twelve-seat counter dedicated to Edomae sushi.
The chef's nigiri often conceals subtle flavor accents, such as a shiso leaf hidden beneath rosy seabass or a touch of yuzu kosho under kinmedai sourced from Chiba.

Name: da Toscano
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Relocated to the century-old Iroquois Hotel in Midtown Manhattan, da Toscano is an Italian restaurant run by Chef Michael Toscano and hospitality veteran Caitlin Toscano.
The kitchen focuses on regional Italian cooking, offering a menu of seasonal ingredients, handmade pastas, and chilled seafood.
Menu staples include thinly sliced octopus carpaccio and pappardelle served with a foie gras duck ragu.

Name: Loring Place
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in New York's Greenwich Village, Loring Place is a modern American restaurant led by Michelin-recognized chef Dan Kluger.
The kitchen centers its approach on seasonal, locally sourced ingredients, utilizing a wood-fired oven to anchor the vegetable-forward menu.
The menu features handmade pastas and a signature Washington Squares grandma-style pizza, alongside a distinct preparation of butternut squash fries.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Saint Urban
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by chef Jared Stafford-Hill, Saint Urban is a wine-focused restaurant in New York City's Flatiron District.
The concept centers on a rotating format, with the kitchen and wine program shifting focus each month to highlight a different global region.
Designed by architecture firm Bentel & Bentel, the dining room incorporates winemaking details and draws from a cellar of 3,000 bottles.

Name: Buccan
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by James Beard-nominated chef Clay Conley, Buccan is a Michelin-recognized restaurant located in the center of Palm Beach.
The kitchen focuses on seasonally inspired American cuisine, presenting global flavor profiles in a shared small-plate format.
The space features an open kitchen and a living room-style lounge, while the menu is anchored by the signature short rib empanada.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: SHŌTŌ
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Washington, D.C., SHŌTŌ is a contemporary Japanese izakaya developed by restaurateur Arjun Waney, the founder of international concepts Zuma and Coya.
The culinary program centers on robata-grilled skewers, sushi, and Wagyu beef served within a modern, high-ceilinged environment.
A large, chandelier-like art installation constructed entirely from volcanic rock hovers directly over the main dining room.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A $25 per person charge applies for cancellations made within 24 hours of the reservation or for no-shows.

Name: Sweet Linda
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Recognized by Time Out New York, Sweet Linda is a cocktail bar and dinner destination in the East Village.
The interior pairs glowing amber arches and mirrored accents with neon lighting to form a dimly lit space for late-night dining.
The menu features dishes like scallop crudo in habanero broth alongside bourbon cocktails such as the turmeric-honey Midwest Henna.

Name: Hiyakawa
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Miami's Wynwood neighborhood, Hiyakawa is a Michelin-recognized Japanese restaurant helmed by chef Masayuki Komatsu.
The minimalist dining room focuses on traditional Washoku cuisine and omakase experiences guided by kikubari, the Japanese practice of anticipating guest needs.
To ensure precise execution, the kitchen prepares a maximum of fifty meals each evening.

Name: Kawa Omakase
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in North Dallas, Kawa Omakase is a Japanese dining counter led by owner-chef Bit “Sunny” Ko.
The restaurant focuses on a dual offering of seasonal tasting menus and hand rolls wrapped in crisp nori.
Guests enter through a corridor displaying sake before experiencing signature bites like A5 Wagyu finished with yuzu kosho or snow crab accented with shiso.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations within 72 hours of the reservation and no-shows will be charged the full tasting menu price per person.

Name: Yingtao
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in New York's Hell's Kitchen, Yingtao is a Michelin-starred contemporary Chinese restaurant founded by Bolun Yao and led by chef Emily Yuen.
The tasting menu adapts Yao's grandmother's home recipes by merging cross-regional Chinese ingredients with French culinary techniques.
The multi-course meal unfolds around an open kitchen to the backdrop of a curated hip-hop soundtrack.

Name: Jams
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located within 1 Hotel Central Park, Jams is a seasonal American restaurant helmed by James Beard Award-winning chef Jonathan Waxman.
The dining room reflects a Californian influence with an open kitchen, exposed brick walls, and reclaimed oak accents.
The menu is anchored by Waxman’s signature wood-grilled chicken, a dish known for its charred skin and tarragon butter.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Wild Cherry
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Wild Cherry is a restaurant in New York City's West Village, operated by Lee Hanson and Riad Nasr of the Frenchette Group.
Housed within the renovated Cherry Lane Theatre, the venue functions as a supper club for theatergoers and neighborhood diners.
The dining room occupies the theater's former practice space, operating within a building now owned by the entertainment company A24.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Icca
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in New York City's Tribeca neighborhood, Icca is a Michelin-starred Japanese restaurant helmed by Chef Kazushige Suzuki.
Hidden behind a cocktail bar, the dining room presents a contemporary omakase experience focused on seasonal seafood.
The venue operates with a dual-concept format, offering guests a choice between a traditional sushi tasting and an Italian Kappo menu.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations, reschedules, or any changes to the reservation must be made 72 hours prior to the reservation date. Any reservations past the 72-hour grace period are strictly non-refundable with no exceptions. Cancellations for parties of 4 guests or more must be made a week in advance. Reservations are prepaid.

Name: Paros
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Paros Tribeca is a Greek restaurant in New York City led by Top Chef contestant George Pagonis and his brother Nicholas.
The 3,500-square-foot dining room draws design cues from the Cycladic architecture of the Aegean islands with a blue and white palette.
The menu centers on daily imported seafood and regional specialties like lamb shank braised in a clay pot with orzo and grated mizithra cheese.

Name: The Otter
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located inside The Manner Hotel in New York's SoHo neighborhood, The Otter is a seafood restaurant helmed by chef Alex Stupak.
The kitchen focuses on straightforward coastal dishes made with ingredients from selected purveyors, offering seating in the main dining room or on a dog-friendly patio.
Signature menu items include the Otter Martini and a dressed seafood platter featuring chilled oysters, razor clams, shrimp, and tuna tartare.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: E&O Kitchen and Bar
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located near San Francisco's Union Square, E&O Kitchen and Bar is a modern Asian restaurant led by Executive Chef Sharon Nahm.
The three-story venue focuses on California Asian cuisine, drawing inspiration from Southeast Asian spice markets to create regional, shareable plates.
Guests dine under high ceilings, sharing family-style dishes next to a prominent bar display.

Name: Shinji
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Shinji by Kanesaka is a Michelin-starred Edo-style sushi restaurant in Singapore, serving as an extension of Chef Shinji Kanesaka's original Ginza establishment.
The offering centers on a traditional omakase menu that highlights precise preparation techniques and seasonal seafood.
Guests dine within a minimalist interior designed by Junzo Irikado, featuring a main sushi counter crafted from wood flown directly from Japan.

Name: The Tyger
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Helmed by chef Paul Donnelly, The Tyger is a Southeast Asian restaurant at the border of Soho and Chinatown in New York City.
The menu offers a contemporary interpretation of regional food traditions within a bright space featuring an outdoor patio.
The dining room is anchored by a large tiger painting and a colorful floral mural, complementing signature dishes like the Nasi Goreng crispy squid ink fried rice.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A credit card is required upon reserving a table. A penalty is charged to no-shows and diners who cancel less than 6 hours before the reservation time.

Name: Lucky's
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Lucky's Soho is a 50-seat Manhattan outpost of the Montecito-founded American steakhouse, brought to Lafayette Street by restaurateur Sarah Meyer Simon.
The dark, one-room space channels a neighborhood energy, swapping traditional steakhouse portraits for monochromatic wallpaper illustrating boisterous nightclub dancers.
The menu centers on family-named classics like Gene's Filet, a 10-ounce cut served with red wine and fresh horseradish sauce.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Everyone must be present to be seated and after 15 minutes the next available party that’s all there will be seated. We will do our best to seat you next, but it’s important to show up at your scheduled time. We have limited tables for larger parties.

Name: Eighty Six
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the West Village, The Eighty Six is a steakhouse from Catch Hospitality Group with interiors by Rockwell Group.
Occupying a former Jazz Age speakeasy, the dining room channels the aesthetic of a vintage train car through jewel-toned velvets, lacquered wood, and hand-painted mirrored panels.
The signature smoked martini is finished tableside with hyper-chilled distilled water poured over a frozen olive to form an icicle.

Name: Zuma
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by chef Rainer Becker, Zuma NYC operates as a contemporary Japanese izakaya in Midtown Manhattan.
The two-story space centers on a double-height main dining room, an open robata grill, and a dedicated sushi bar serving signature dishes like sliced yellowtail with green chili relish.
Designed by Studio Glitt, the interior utilizes solid pieces of quarried rock and natural tree trunks to define the dining areas.

Name: Kagawa Ippuku
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Kagawa Ippuku is a Tokyo udon restaurant that has earned the Michelin Guide Bib Gourmand for three consecutive years.
The eatery specializes in Sanuki-style udon, known for its firm, chewy noodles and clear, savory broth.
A signature dish is the rich curry udon, featuring a French-inspired roux supervised by the Michelin-starred restaurant Kitajima-tei.

Name: Bourbon Steak
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Bourbon Steak is a contemporary American steakhouse concept by Michelin-starred chef Michael Mina, operating in multiple cities across the United States.
The menu centers on prime cuts of beef and seasonal seafood, accompanied by a wine list and tableside cocktail preparations.
Signature steaks are slow-poached in a blend of beef tallow, clarified butter, and aromatic herbs before being finished on a wood-fired grill.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Grace period of 15 minutes for each reservation. Reservations of 6 or more will require a credit card hold. In the case of no show or cancellation within 24 hours of the reservation you will be charge $15 per guest as a no show/cancellation fee.

Name: True Food Kitchen
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded in Phoenix by integrative medicine expert Dr. Andrew Weil and restaurateur Sam Fox, True Food Kitchen is an American health-conscious restaurant chain.
The menu is strictly guided by Dr. Weil's anti-inflammatory food pyramid, prioritizing sustainable and responsibly sourced ingredients.
Signature staples like the Organic Tuscan Kale Salad and the Ancient Grains Bowl anchor a seasonally rotating selection.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: Sumibiyaki Arashi
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Led by chef Peter Ho, Sumibiyaki Arashi is a Michelin-starred yakitori restaurant located in Vancouver.
The 14-seat dining counter presents a multi-course omakase menu that integrates Japanese culinary methods with the chef's Taiwanese heritage.
During the service, various cuts of poultry and vegetables are grilled over binchotan, a traditional white charcoal known for its high heat and minimal smoke.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancellations or changes to your reservation must be made at least 72 hours in advance via email at sumibiyaki.arashi@gmail.com. A charge of $175 per person will apply to late cancellations, changes made within 72 hours, or no-shows. Please note: To preserve the flow of our omakase experience, we begin on time. Guests who arrive more than 20 minutes late may miss courses already served. If you arrive more than 30 minutes late, your reservation will be considered a no-show.

Name: Sushi Sugawara
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Tokyo's Ginza district, Sushi Sugawara is an Edomae sushi restaurant helmed by Grand Chef Hideki Sugawara, who brings over three decades of culinary experience to his practice.
The menu focuses on orthodox preparations, relying on seasonal seafood sourced daily from the Toyosu market paired with carefully blended vinegared rice.
Guests dine at a nine-seat cypress counter set within a wooden interior.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A cancellation fee of ¥29,700 per person is charged for no-shows without notice, cancellations made on the day of the reservation, a decrease in the number of guests on the day of the reservation, or failure to arrive within 30 minutes of the reservation time. Cancellations must be made by the day before the reservation.

Name: Sushi Shin
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Nishiazabu Sushi Shin is a two-Michelin-starred sushi restaurant in Tokyo helmed by Chef Shintaro Suzuki.
The Edomae omakase menu relies on precise preparation, adjusting the balance of seasoning in the rice for each specific cut of seafood.
Staff use different brushes to apply soy sauce to various nigiri, ensuring the oils from fatty tuna do not alter the flavor of lighter fish.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: Cancel your reservation at least 72 hours before the dining start time to receive a full refund.

Name: Pizza Bianco
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by James Beard Award-winning chef Chris Bianco, Pizzeria Bianco is a wood-fired pizza restaurant in Phoenix, Arizona.
The restaurant played a central role in the American artisanal pizza movement through its strict focus on regional ingredients and naturally leavened dough.
The signature Pizza Rosa features a distinct topping combination of red onion, Parmigiano-Reggiano, fresh rosemary, and crushed pistachios.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: NONE FOUND

Name: The French Laundry
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Chef Thomas Keller operates The French Laundry, a three-Michelin-starred restaurant located in Yountville within California's Napa Valley.
The dining room occupies a two-story stone cottage built in 1900 that previously functioned as a saloon and a steam laundry.
The daily nine-course tasting menu frequently features the signature Oysters and Pearls, a dish of pearl tapioca sabayon topped with white sturgeon caviar.

Name: Wayfare Tavern
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Wayfare Tavern is chef Tyler Florence's flagship restaurant, recently relocated to a new space in San Francisco's Financial District.
The dining room features a traditional British pub-style aesthetic focused on regional American comfort food and seasonal plates.
Service begins with complimentary warm popovers before moving to the kitchen's signature organic buttermilk fried chicken.

Name: The French Laundry
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Chef Thomas Keller operates The French Laundry, a three-Michelin-starred restaurant located in a historic stone building in Yountville, California.
The kitchen prepares two distinct nine-course tasting menus daily, focusing on classic French techniques and seasonal ingredients sourced from its own culinary garden.
Meals frequently begin with Oysters and Pearls, a signature dish combining a pearl tapioca sabayon with white sturgeon caviar.

Name: Kinjo
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in the Vrilissia neighborhood of Athens, Kinjo is a Japanese restobar helmed by chef Nikos Politakos that holds two stars from the FNL Best Restaurant Awards.
The kitchen focuses on omakase dining and precise fish preparation, utilizing traditional curing methods such as shiozuke and kombujime.
A signature dish is the chawanmushi, a steamed egg custard prepared with house-made dashi, mushrooms, and sea urchin.

Name: Ginza Ukai Tei
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Operated by the Ukai Group, Ginza Ukai Tei is a Michelin-starred teppanyaki restaurant located in Tokyo.
The menu incorporates European dishes alongside Japanese teppanyaki, served in a space decorated with antique furnishings and a Jean-Michel Folon sculpture.
A signature element of the meal is the abalone, which is steamed directly on the iron griddle under a mound of salt.

Name: The Henry
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Developed by Sam Fox’s Fox Restaurant Concepts, The Henry operates as an all-day neighborhood restaurant and coffee bar with locations in cities like Phoenix, Dallas, Los Angeles, and Miami.
The space features a living-room-inspired design with open kitchens, bookshelves, and industrial accents, accommodating both morning coffee runs and evening dinners.
The integrated XV Coffee Bar serves the signature Go North, a chilled blend of espresso, cocoa, and cream.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A credit card hold is required for parties of 5 or more. A cancellation fee of $50 per person will incur if cancelled within 24 hours of the reservation.

Name: Rimrock Cafe
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Located in Whistler Creekside, British Columbia, Rimrock Café is a restaurant founded in 1986 and now operated by longtime chefs Chris McKinney and Steve Maile.
Set within a mountain cabin, the kitchen focuses on fresh coastal seafood, premium game meats, and an extensive wine list.
A 440-pound marlin caught off the coast of Hawaii hangs in the dining room, inspiring the establishment's signature fish logo.
Master_Cancellation_Policy: A credit card is required to secure reservations, and late cancellations or no-shows may incur a fee. For special events, full prepayment is required and will be forfeited for any modifications, cancellations, or no-shows within 72 hours of the reservation.

Name: Press Club

Operated by Sidecar Hospitality on San Francisco's Yerba Buena Lane, Press Club is a wine bar and lounge designed by BCV Architecture + Interiors.

Name: Zoi Vendome
Raw Text: Zoi Vendome is a preventive check-up center in Paris near Place Vendome, at 12 rue Volney, 75002.
Master_Source_text: Zoi Vendome is a preventive check-up center in Paris near Place Vendome, at 12 rue Volney, 75002.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Zoi Vendôme is a preventive health check-up center founded by entrepreneur Paul Dupuy, housed in a 20,000-square-foot Haussmannian building steps from Place Vendôme and designed by Mexico City studio Sala Hars. 
The flagship Zoi Life check-up runs about four hours, covering 181 biomarkers, four imaging exams, microbiota analysis, and a 24-hour neurotransmitter and cortisol profile. 
Membership includes 12 months of follow-up via the Zoi app and an annual return visit to measure progress.

Name: Zak The Baker
Raw Text: Zak the Baker is a kosher bakery-cafe in Wynwood, Miami, from founder Zak Stern, a 2023 James Beard Awards finalist for Outstanding Bakery and a Michelin Bib Gourmand.
Master_Source_text: Zak the Baker is a kosher bakery-cafe in Wynwood, Miami, from founder Zak Stern, a 2023 James Beard Awards finalist for Outstanding Bakery and a Michelin Bib Gourmand.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Established in 2012, Zak the Baker is an independent artisan kosher bakery and cafe in Wynwood, founded by Zak Stern following apprenticeships at organic farms in Sweden, France, and Israel. 
The operation spans a bread program using natural leavens and preferments, a pastry department specializing in viennoiserie and enriched breads, and a scratch kitchen focused on local ingredients. 
Savory staples include a salmon BLT on croissant, while the flourless dark chocolate cookie with whole toasted almonds is a signature sweet.

Name: Zimmis
Raw Text: Zimmi's is a West Village French restaurant opened in December 2024, led by proprietor Jenni Guizio with chef Maxime Pradie, and profiled by The New Yorker.
Master_Source_text: Zimmi's is a West Village French restaurant opened in December 2024, led by proprietor Jenni Guizio with chef Maxime Pradie, and profiled by The New Yorker.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Zimmi's is a Provençal-inspired restaurant in New York's West Village, opened by hospitality veteran Jenni Guizio and chef Maxime Pradié.
The intimate bistro focuses on traditional French fare, elevating humble ingredients with careful technique and long cooking times.
A signature dish is the pastasciutta, which features fresh tagliatelle tossed in a savory ragout of chicken liver, heart, and gizzard.

Name: Zitz Sum
Raw Text: Zitz Sum is chef Pablo Zitzmann's Coral Gables restaurant, a MICHELIN Bib Gourmand and 2022 New York Times 50 Best selection.
Master_Source_text: Zitz Sum is chef Pablo Zitzmann's Coral Gables restaurant, a MICHELIN Bib Gourmand and 2022 New York Times 50 Best selection.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Colombian chef Pablo Zitzmann grew Zitz Sum from a dumpling pop-up into a 30-seat restaurant tucked into the ground floor of an office building in Coral Gables. 
The menu centers on Japanese and Italian flavors, dumplings, and dishes cooked over charcoal, with a monthly a la carte and a weekly six-course omakase tasting menu. 
The beverage program focuses on prime and obscure sakes alongside biodynamic old and new world wines.

Name: ZeyZey
Raw Text: ZeyZey is a pop-up concert venue and culinary hub in Miami's Little River, opened in summer 2023 by Grassfed Culture Hospitality.
Master_Source_text: ZeyZey is a pop-up concert venue and culinary hub in Miami's Little River, opened in summer 2023 by Grassfed Culture Hospitality.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
ZeyZey is a 15,000-square-foot pop-up music venue and culinary hub from Grassfed Culture Hospitality, the team behind Michelin-starred Los Félix. 
The venue features outdoor live performances on Fridays and Saturdays, vinyl DJs, and late-night dance parties in an indoor disco, with music spanning Afro-Cuban funk, Brazilian disco, salsa, cumbia, and electronic fusions. 
Food vendors operate from small huts around the space, and entry typically requires a ticket or RSVP.

Name: Y7 Yoga (Los Angeles)
Raw Text: Y7 Studio's Los Angeles outposts in West Hollywood and Silver Lake are part of the music-driven yoga brand, now owned by FitLab following a 2025 acquisition.
Master_Source_text: Y7 Studio's Los Angeles outposts in West Hollywood and Silver Lake are part of the music-driven yoga brand, now owned by FitLab following a 2025 acquisition.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Founded by Sarah Larson Levey and recently acquired by FitLab, Y7 Studio operates multiple Los Angeles locations, including outposts in West Hollywood and Silver Lake.
The brand focuses on hip-hop yoga, offering intense, music-driven vinyasa flows in a dark, mirrorless environment.
Each studio is heated to 80 to 90 degrees using infrared technology to induce a heavy sweat during the candlelit sessions.

Name: Zou Zous
Raw Text: Zou Zou's is an Eastern Mediterranean restaurant at Manhattan West by Quality Branded, led by chef Madeline Sperling within the Pendry Hotel.
Master_Source_text: Zou Zou's is an Eastern Mediterranean restaurant at Manhattan West by Quality Branded, led by chef Madeline Sperling within the Pendry Hotel.
Master_Aurora_Insights:
Zou Zou's is an Eastern Mediterranean restaurant inside the Pendry Manhattan West hotel, operated by Quality Branded, the group behind Don Angie and Bad Roman. 
Chef Madeline Sperling, formerly of Gramercy Tavern and The NoMad, leads the kitchen in a 75-seat AvroKO-designed space built around a wood-fired hearth. 
The shareable menu draws from Lebanon, Israel, Turkey, Egypt, Syria, and Jordan, with highlights like a five-dip mezze platter, Moroccan fried chicken, and fire-roasted leg of lamb.
